articles.title: Through NASA’s Lens: Capturing Space Shuttle Endeavour’s Move to LA
articles.author: Dede Dinius

paras.en: As a new exhibit opens showcasing NASA’s space shuttle Endeavour, NASA photographers look back at the final mission. These photographers documented the iconic images shared around the world on Sept. 21, 2012, while millions watched space shuttle Endeavour fly on top of the agency’s 747 Shuttle Carrier Aircraft for the last time.
paras.zh: 随着美国宇航局奋进号航天飞机的新展览开幕，美国宇航局摄影师回顾了最后的任务。这些摄影师记录了 2012 年 9 月 21 日在全世界分享的标志性图像，当时数百万人观看了奋进号航天飞机最后一次在该机构的 747 航天飞机运载机上飞行。

paras.en: Endeavour’s new home at the California Science Center in Los Angeles will reopen the weekend of Nov. 13, displayed upright in launch position, ready to inspire the next generation of space explorers.
paras.zh: 奋进号位于洛杉矶加州科学中心的新家将于 11 月 13 日周末重新开放，以发射位置直立展示，准备激励下一代太空探索者。

paras.en: “Chasing Endeavour’s final ferry flight over Southern California was, without a doubt, a leading highlight of my 37-year career at NASA,” said Lori Losey, lead videographer at NASA’s Armstrong Flight Research Center in Edwards, California. “I advocated for two chase aircraft to be used in the LA area so we could dedicate one aircraft to photo and one to video. It was this beautiful dance of alternating altitudes and swapping positions between landmarks to maximize both of us capturing the legendary imagery.”
paras.zh: “毫无疑问，追逐奋进号在南加州上空的最后一次渡轮飞行是我在 NASA 37 年职业生涯中的一个主要亮点，”位于加利福尼亚州爱德华兹的 NASA 阿姆斯特朗飞行研究中心的首席摄像师洛里·洛西 (Lori Losey) 说道。 “我主张在洛杉矶地区使用两架追逐飞机，这样我们就可以将一架飞机专门用于拍照，另一架飞机用于录像。这是一种交替高度和在地标之间交换位置的美丽舞蹈，以最大限度地提高我们捕捉传奇图像的能力。”

paras.en: Two photographers and one videographer, all based at NASA Armstrong, had a leading hand in preparing the Endeavour’s flight to Los Angeles, and in deciding where else the aircraft would fly around California on its final journey. Agency pilots planned the route to fly across some of California’s most iconic landmarks and the imagery team strategized about how to best capture the images.
paras.zh: 两名摄影师和一名摄像师均来自美国国家航空航天局阿姆斯特朗，他们在准备奋进号飞往洛杉矶的航班以及决定飞机在最后一次旅程中绕加州飞行的其他地点方面发挥了主导作用。该机构的飞行员规划了飞越加州一些最具标志性地标的路线，图像团队则制定了如何最好地捕捉图像的策略。

paras.en: “The most fun thing about this project was seeing the excitement of the people on the ground as we flew over the different landmarks,” said Jim Ross, NASA Armstrong’s lead photographer. “People in the Los Angeles area really came out and supported the Endeavour flyover. We saw so many supporters at Griffith Park and Disneyland.”
paras.zh: “这个项目最有趣的事情是当我们飞越不同的地标时看到地面上人们的兴奋，”美国宇航局阿姆斯特朗的首席摄影师吉姆·罗斯说。 “洛杉矶地区的人们真的站出来支持奋进天桥。我们在格里菲斯公园和迪士尼乐园看到了很多支持者。”

paras.en: Photographer Carla Thomas said seeing the standing-room-only crowd below the California State Capitol in Sacramento filled her with pride. After joining the agency in the wake of the Challenger tragedy, she reflected on the opportunity to document NASA’s return to flight.
paras.zh: 摄影师卡拉·托马斯表示，看到萨克拉门托加州议会大厦下面挤满了站着的人群，她感到非常自豪。在挑战者号悲剧发生后加入该机构后，她反思了记录美国宇航局重返飞行的机会。

paras.en: Endeavour was escorted by NASA Armstrong’s F/A-18s and an F-15, which carried the photo and video teams in the back seats. Like many flight efforts, this journey took a significant amount of preplanning with the California Science Center, as well as groups like the Federal Aviation Administration, the Los Angeles International Airport, and NASA’s Johnson Space Center in Houston.
paras.zh: 奋进号由 NASA 阿姆斯特朗的 F/A-18 和一架 F-15 护航，摄影和视频团队坐在后座上。与许多飞行工作一样，这次旅程需要加州科学中心以及美国联邦航空管理局、洛杉矶国际机场和美国宇航局休斯顿约翰逊航天中心等组织的大量预先规划。

paras.en: “The planning was my favorite part of this effort — it was fun and exciting to plan the shots,” Thomas said. “I flew the entire route with the LAPD (Los Angeles Police Department) in one of their helicopters. We had to make sure this was going to work and find any obstacles. Planning for the Hollywood sign was challenging, because it’s on the side of a hill with power lines and radio antennas, but we worked through these issues in the planning process.”
paras.zh: “计划是这项工作中我最喜欢的部分——计划镜头既有趣又令人兴奋，”托马斯说。 “我乘坐 LAPD（洛杉矶警察局）的一架直升机飞完了整个路线。我们必须确保这一切顺利进行并找到任何障碍。好莱坞标志的规划具有挑战性，因为它位于有电线和无线电天线的山坡上，但我们在规划过程中解决了这些问题。”

paras.en: The space shuttle’s flight path included other California landmarks: Dodger Stadium, the Getty Center, the Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum, NASA’s Ames Research Center in Silicon Valley, the Golden Gate Bridge, NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Pasadena, and the Santa Monica Pier.
paras.zh: 航天飞机的飞行路线包括其他加州地标：道奇体育场、盖蒂中心、洛杉矶纪念体育馆、美国宇航局硅谷艾姆斯研究中心、金门大桥、美国宇航局帕萨迪纳喷气推进实验室和圣莫尼卡码头。

paras.en: Endeavour helped begin assembly of the International Space Station by delivering its first components to orbit and went on to complete 25 missions. The space shuttle will soon be seen, along with some of the images from the final flight, in its permanent home inside the new Samuel Oschin Air and Space Center at the California Science Center in Downtown Los Angeles.
paras.zh: 奋进号通过将第一批部件送入轨道，帮助开始组装国际空间站，并继续完成了 25 项任务。很快人们就会在洛杉矶市中心加州科学中心的新塞缪尔·奥钦航空航天中心内看到这架航天飞机以及最后一次飞行的一些图像。

articles.title: NASA’s Hubble Offers Cosmic Sampler of Targets for Roman

paras.en: A gallery of gravitational lenses captured by NASA’s Hubble Space Telescope showcases the diversity of this cosmic phenomenon and lays the groundwork for follow-up observations by the new Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局哈勃太空望远镜捕获的引力透镜画廊展示了这种宇宙现象的多样性，并为新的南希·格雷斯·罗马太空望远镜的后续观测奠定了基础。

paras.en: Gravitational lensing, first predicted by Albert Einstein, occurs when the gravity of a massive foreground object, such as a galaxy or cluster of galaxies, bends, warps, and magnifies the light from a more distant background object. The effect is similar to that of a giant lens in space that allows astronomers to view objects much farther away than any telescope could see on its own.
paras.zh: 引力透镜最早由阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦预言，当一个巨大的前景物体（例如星系或星系团）的引力弯曲、扭曲和放大来自更远的背景物体的光时，就会发生引力透镜效应。这种效果类似于太空中巨型透镜的效果，使天文学家能够观察到比任何望远镜本身所能看到的更远的物体。

paras.en: The lenses in this image formed from the precise alignment of a distant background galaxy with the mass of a foreground galaxy, creating distorted and magnified images of the background galaxy that appear as arcs around the foreground galaxy.
paras.zh: 该图像中的透镜是由遥远的背景星系与前景星系的质量精确对准而形成的，从而创建了背景星系的扭曲和放大的图像，这些图像在前景星系周围显示为弧形。

paras.en: Astronomers will use these observations of a large and varied population of gravitational lenses to construct lens models that will help determine how much mass is in the lensing system’s foreground galaxy – and potentially prove or dispel a theory about dark matter. Astronomers study the amount of distortion of the lensed background galaxies to determine the quantity and distribution of mass in the foreground galaxy, including its invisible dark matter.
paras.zh: 天文学家将利用对大量不同引力透镜的观测来构建透镜模型，这将有助于确定透镜系统的前景星系中有多少质量，并有可能证明或推翻有关暗物质的理论。天文学家研究透镜背景星系的畸变量，以确定前景星系质量的数量和分布，包括其不可见的暗物质。

paras.en: Hubble views the cosmos primarily in visible and ultraviolet light with some infrared coverage, providing a comprehensive, high-resolution view of individual objects. Roman sees primarily infrared light and some visible, over a much larger field of view to create panoramas of the universe. While Hubble gets a better view of individual lenses, Roman will be able to capture more lenses with its wider field-of-view. If Roman finds a particularly interesting lens, researchers may use Hubble to take follow-up observations using its visible and UV prowess for individual objects.
paras.zh: 哈勃主要通过可见光和紫外光观察宇宙，并覆盖一些红外光，提供单个物体的全面、高分辨率视图。罗曼主要看到红外光和一些可见光，在更大的视野范围内创建宇宙全景图。哈勃望远镜可以更好地观察单个镜头，而罗曼将能够以其更宽的视野捕捉更多的镜头。如果罗曼发现了一个特别有趣的镜头，研究人员可能会利用哈勃望远镜利用其可见光和紫外线能力对单个物体进行后续观察。

paras.en: With Hubble's high-resolution imaging and precise models, researchers should also be able to detect small imperfections in these gravitationally lensed galaxy arcs that would indicate the presence of small clumps of dark matter. Researchers could use these previously undetected clumps to confirm the cold dark matter theory, which predicts the existence of many small dark matter clumps of between a million to a billion solar masses. In contrast, the dark matter halo of our Milky Way galaxy is around 1.3 trillion solar masses.
paras.zh: 借助哈勃的高分辨率成像和精确模型，研究人员还应该能够检测到这些引力透镜星系弧中的小缺陷，这些缺陷表明存在小块暗物质。研究人员可以利用这些以前未被发现的团块来证实冷暗物质理论，该理论预测存在许多质量在一百万到十亿太阳质量之间的小型暗物质团块。相比之下，我们银河系的暗物质晕约为 1.3 万亿太阳质量。

paras.en: By studying Hubble lens images in detail, researchers intend to build a super-intelligence tool to efficiently search similar arcs in the upcoming Roman images. The Hubble images are expected to both yield their own results on dark matter and pave the way for analysis of Roman’s larger sample of lenses.
paras.zh: 通过详细研究哈勃透镜图像，研究人员打算构建一个超级智能工具，以在即将发布的罗马图像中有效搜索类似的弧线。哈勃图像预计将产生自己的暗物质结果，并为分析罗曼更大的透镜样本铺平道路。

paras.en: The unique lenses in this image display some of the different characteristics researchers will see as they collect a diverse and numerous assortment of lenses to test in their models. Panel A is an example of an arc-counterarc configuration, in which the lensed background galaxy appears as a duplicated pair of arcs. The lensed galaxy is being magnified by a pair of foreground galaxies whose combined mass bends the light of the background galaxy around them.
paras.zh: 该图像中的独特镜片显示了研究人员在收集各种不同的镜片以在模型中进行测试时将看到的一些不同特征。图 A 是弧反弧配置的示例，其中透镜背景星系显示为一对重复的弧。透镜星系被一对前景星系放大，这对前景星系的总质量使周围背景星系的光线发生弯曲。

paras.en: Panel F is an Einstein Ring, in which the alignment of the background galaxy and approximately spherical mass of the foreground lens are so perfectly situated that the lensed galaxy almost fully encircles the foreground galaxy. Panel I shows a quadruply lensed galaxy, in which the background galaxy is replicated four times, appearing as smeared dots around the foreground galaxy. Panel C also shows a quadruply lensed galaxy, with double knots that are most likely strong star-forming regions in the background galaxy.
paras.zh: 图 F 是爱因斯坦环，其中背景星系和前景透镜的近似球形质量的对齐位置非常完美，以至于透镜星系几乎完全包围了前景星系。图 I 显示了一个四倍透镜星系，其中背景星系被复制四次，在前景星系周围显示为涂抹点。图 C 还显示了一个四透镜星系，其双结很可能是背景星系中强烈的恒星形成区域。

paras.en: Some of the magnified and warped background galaxies appear blue and some appear red. These bluish arcs indicate young stars, while reddish arcs indicate older stars. Roman and Hubble will explore these differences to better understand how galaxies evolved earlier in the universe.
paras.zh: 一些放大和扭曲的背景星系呈现蓝色，一些呈现红色。这些蓝色的弧线表示年轻的恒星，而红色的弧线表示较老的恒星。罗曼和哈勃将探索这些差异，以更好地了解星系在宇宙早期是如何演化的。

paras.en: Most of the foreground lensing galaxies are elliptical galaxies, which are older, denser, and more compact. Lensed images of background galaxies only occur when the mass density of the foreground galaxy reaches a critical point.
paras.zh: 大多数前景透镜星系都是椭圆星系，它们更古老、更密集、更紧凑。仅当前景星系的质量密度达到临界点时，才会出现背景星系的透镜图像。

paras.en: But not all of these foreground galaxies are ellipticals, and researchers can use these differences to explore the evolutionary paths taken by these galaxies. In panel G, the foreground galaxy appears elongated, which may be true or a trick of perspective, and in panels B and F, the foreground galaxies appear to have spiral arms.
paras.zh: 但并非所有这些前景星系都是椭圆形的，研究人员可以利用这些差异来探索这些星系所采取的演化路径。在面板 G 中，前景星系显得被拉长，这可能是真实的，也可能是透视的把戏，而在面板 B 和 F 中，前景星系似乎具有旋臂。

paras.en: Panel D’s foreground galaxy has a visible dust lane, which is rare in a lensing galaxy and the kind of detail that Hubble’s sharp, visible-light vision excels at revealing. The lensed background galaxy could be an Einstein Ring, with the dust lane “breaking” our view of the ring. Because infrared light is less obscured by dust, future Roman infrared observations could help determine whether the arcs form a more complete Einstein ring.
paras.zh: D 组的前景星系有一条可见的尘埃带，这在透镜星系中是罕见的，也是哈勃望远镜敏锐的可见光视觉擅长揭示的细节。透镜背景星系可能是爱因斯坦环，而尘埃带“打破”了我们对环的看法。由于红外光较少被灰尘遮挡，未来的罗马红外观测可以帮助确定这些弧是否形成更完整的爱因斯坦环。

paras.en: These strong lenses were first detected with The Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument at Kitt Peak. Hubble subsequently observed them, and Roman will take further observations. Images like these are an example of the kinds of collaborative efforts that routinely take place between NASA’s Great Observatories to build a comprehensive picture of the cosmos. As Roman joins the family of large space observatories that includes Hubble, the Chandra X-ray Observatory, and the James Webb Space Telescope, a new window opens onto the universe, revealing sights previously hidden while expanding our cosmic knowledge for all of humanity.
paras.zh: 这些坚固的透镜首先是由基特峰的暗能量光谱仪器检测到的。哈勃随后对它们进行了观测，罗曼将进行进一步的观测。像这样的图像是美国宇航局大型天文台之间经常进行的合作努力的一个例子，目的是构建宇宙的全面图景。随着罗曼加入包括哈勃、钱德拉 X 射线天文台和詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜在内的大型太空天文台大家庭，一扇通向宇宙的新窗口打开了，揭示了以前隐藏的景象，同时为全人类扩展了我们的宇宙知识。

paras.en: NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center, Greenbelt, MD
paras.zh: 美国宇航局戈达德太空飞行中心，马里兰州格林贝尔特

articles.title: NASA Ames Stars of the Month: November 2026
articles.author: Aaron McKinnon

paras.en: The NASA Ames Science Directorate recognizes the outstanding contributions of (pictured left to right) Alyssa Villanueva, Steve Howell, and Samuel LeBlanc. Their commitment to the NASA mission represents the entrepreneurial spirit, technical expertise, and collaborative disposition needed to explore this world and beyond.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局艾姆斯科学理事会表彰了（从左到右）Alyssa Villanueva、Steve Howell 和 Samuel LeBlanc 的杰出贡献。他们对 NASA 使命的承诺代表了探索这个世界及其他世界所需的创业精神、技术专长和协作能力。

paras.en: Space Biosciences Star: Alyssa Villanueva
paras.zh: 太空生物科学明星：Alyssa Villanueva

paras.en: Alyssa Villaneuva is an engineer at Blue Marble in the Space Biosciences Division on the LEIA (Lunar Explorer Instrument for space biology Applications) team. Alyssa is recognized for technical excellence, dedication and boundless support to the rest of the team. She goes above and beyond in contributing to LEIA every day and has been essential in all the test efforts, in particular with preparation and execution of engineering validation testing.
paras.zh: Alyssa Villaneuva 是 Blue Marble 空间生物科学部门 LEIA（月球探测器空间生物学应用仪器）团队的一名工程师。 Alyssa 因其卓越的技术、奉献精神以及对团队其他成员的无限支持而受到认可。她每天都在为 LEIA 做出超越性的贡献，并且在所有测试工作中发挥着至关重要的作用，特别是在工程验证测试的准备和执行方面。

paras.en: Steve Howell is recognized for his leadership of scientific teams for numerous international space missions. His pioneering work in astronomical instrumentation have significantly advanced both space- and ground-based telescope imaging. In kind, the Astronomical society has recently recognized Steve’s lifetime of major contributions to the field with the prestigious Catherine Wolfe Bruce Gold Medal from the Astronomical Society of the Pacific.
paras.zh: 史蒂夫·豪威尔因其在众多国际太空任务中领导科学团队而受到认可。他在天文仪器方面的开创性工作极大地推进了太空和地面望远镜成像。天文学会最近以实物形式认可了史蒂夫一生对该领域的重大贡献，并授予太平洋天文学会著名的凯瑟琳·沃尔夫·布鲁斯金奖。

paras.en: Samuel LeBlanc is a research scientist for the Bay Area Environmental Research Institute in the Earth Science Division. Sam is recognized for exceptional technical leadership and innovative thinking in advancing Ames’ flight planning capabilities for NASA airborne science missions. Sam’s contributions have placed Ames at the forefront of airborne science flight planning within and outside the Agency, enabling successful and cost-effective missions that maximize scientific returns.
paras.zh: 塞缪尔·勒布朗 (Samuel LeBlanc) 是湾区环境研究所地球科学部的研究科学家。 Sam 在提升 Ames 的 NASA 机载科学任务飞行规划能力方面因卓越的技术领导力和创新思维而受到认可。萨姆的贡献使艾姆斯处于机构内外机载科学飞行规划的最前沿，使任务能够成功且具有成本效益，从而最大限度地提高科学回报。

articles.title: The trilingual son of Mr Universe makes homecoming - NFL Gameday Guide

paras.en: NFL Gameday Guide: Harry Kane's NFL dream, Amon-Ra St Brown in Germany, Kirk Cousins' return and Jordan Love's flying Green Bay Packers
paras.zh: NFL 比赛日指南：哈里·凯恩的 NFL 梦想、德国的阿蒙-拉·圣布朗、柯克·考辛斯的回归以及乔丹·乐福的绿湾包装工队

paras.en: The NFL plays the eighth of its record nine international games in 2026 when the Detroit Lions face the New England Patriots at Bayern Munich's Allianz Arena, live on Sky Sports from 2pm Sunday; Kirk Cousins meanwhile makes his second debut for the Minnesota Vikings after his trade return
paras.zh: NFL 将于 2026 年进行创纪录的九场国际比赛中的第八场，届时底特律雄狮队将在拜仁慕尼黑的安联球场迎战新英格兰爱国者队，天空体育周日下午 2 点开始直播；与此同时，柯克·考辛斯在交易回归后为明尼苏达维京人队第二次首次亮相

paras.en: Amon-Ra St. Brown. The globe-trotting trilingual son of Mr Universe, named after an Egyptian god, returning for the most special of homecomings to his mother's native land. This time, as one of the stars of the NFL.
paras.zh: 阿蒙-拉·圣·布朗。环球先生的三语儿子，以埃及神的名字命名，周游世界，回到母亲的祖国，进行最特别的回归。这一次，作为 NFL 的球星之一。

paras.en: Some five years ago, St. Brown spoke to Sky Sports about the importance of his German heritage ahead of entering the NFL Draft. And now he gets to honour it by doing what he does best.
paras.zh: 大约五年前，圣布朗在参加 NFL 选秀之前向天空体育谈到了他的德国血统的重要性。现在他可以通过做他最擅长的事情来兑现这一点。

paras.en: The Detroit Lions will play an international game for the first time since November 2015 this Sunday when they host the New England Patriots at Munich's Allianz Arena.
paras.zh: 底特律雄狮队本周日将在慕尼黑安联球场迎战新英格兰爱国者队，这是他们自 2015 年 11 月以来首次参加国际比赛。

paras.en: His mother Miriam hails from Leverkusen and predominantly spoke to the Lions wide receiver and his two brothers in German growing up, while also taking them back to Europe each summer to spend time with their grandparents and play soccer.
paras.zh: 他的母亲米里亚姆来自勒沃库森，在成长过程中主要用德语与狮子队外接手和他的两个兄弟交谈，同时每年夏天也会带他们回到欧洲与祖父母共度时光并踢足球。

paras.en: St Brown even represented the German national team alongside brother Osiris during his sophomore year of high school, and since landing in the NFL, has worn decals of the German flag on his helmet and returned to host football camps in the country.
paras.zh: 圣布朗甚至在高中二年级时与兄弟奥西里斯一起代表德国国家队，自从进入美国国家橄榄球联盟(NFL)以来，他在头盔上贴上了德国国旗的贴花，并回到了该国举办的足球训练营。

paras.en: St Brown sat his SATs in English, German and French, spent time in French academy Lycee International de Los Angeles, spent a semester in Paris and joined his mother in travelling across the world with trips to Spain, Italy, London, France, the Caribbean, his German home from home and beyond. It was his mother Miriam who revealed the Lions would be playing in Munich on a FaceTime call set up by the Lions back in February.
paras.zh: 圣·布朗参加了英语、德语和法语的 SAT 考试，在法国洛杉矶国际高中学习，在巴黎度过了一个学期，并和他的母亲一起环游世界，去了西班牙、意大利、伦敦、法国、加勒比海、他在德国的家和其他地方。他的母亲米里亚姆 (Miriam) 在二月份狮子队建立的 FaceTime 通话中透露，狮子队将在慕尼黑比赛。

paras.en: At long last, he gets to take centre stage overseas as the NFL reaches the final stop on its European tour with the eighth of a record nine international games in 2026.
paras.zh: 随着 NFL 欧洲巡回赛的最后一站在 2026 年迎来创纪录的九场国际比赛中的第八场，他终于登上了海外舞台的中心。

paras.en: - Jay-Z picks himself to headline Super Bowl half-time show
paras.zh: - Jay-Z 选择自己担任超级碗中场秀的主角

paras.en: - Aaron Rodgers backs 16-game 'NFL international week' after Paris history
paras.zh: - 继巴黎历史之后，亚伦·罗杰斯支持举办 16 场“NFL 国际周”

paras.en: - Get latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract
paras.zh: - 获取最新的天空体育优惠或无合同直播

paras.en: St Brown brings one of the NFL's most fascinating backgrounds as a ready-made ambassador for the league's increasing global reach, which will be championed by way of its sixth regular-season matchup in Germany since 2022.
paras.zh: 圣布朗拥有 NFL 最迷人的背景之一，作为联盟日益扩大的全球影响力的现成大使，该联盟将通过自 2022 年以来在德国举行的第六场常规赛对决而获得冠军。

paras.en: His own global connections travel as far as Egyptian nomenclature, after his father John - a three-time Mr World and two-time Mr Universe body-builder - named his son after Amun, the ancient Egyptian deity.
paras.zh: 他自己的全球联系甚至延伸至埃及命名法，他的父亲约翰（三届世界先生和两届宇宙先生健美运动员）以古埃及神阿蒙的名字为他的儿子命名。

paras.en: It is Germany the NFL can thank for one of its most gifted players, with St Brown's parents having met at a fitness trade show in Cologne in 1987.
paras.zh: NFL 应该感谢德国，培养出了最有天赋的球员之一，圣布朗的父母于 1987 年在科隆的一次健身贸易展上相识。

paras.en: His transatlantic ties have naturally forged a love of soccer as he pitches up in the home of Bayern Munich, where Ballon d'Or-winning England captain Harry Kane has often spoken of his own ambitions to step into the world of St. Brown - as an NFL kicker.
paras.zh: 当他在拜仁慕尼黑的主场踢球时，跨大西洋的联系自然而然地培养了他对足球的热爱。金球奖得主英格兰队队长哈里·凯恩经常谈到自己作为一名 NFL 踢球手进入圣布朗世界的雄心。

paras.en: Has he got the leg to do it? Sure. Would it ever happen? Most would say no. Funnily enough, his age by the end of his football career - he is 33 now - is probably a primary reason above all as to why it wouldn't happen.
paras.zh: 他有能力做到这一点吗？当然。它会发生吗？大多数人会说不。有趣的是，他的足球生涯结束时的年龄——他现在 33 岁——可能是这一切不会发生的首要原因。

paras.en: But will we take advantage of the opportunity to shoehorn Kane's name into a headline? Duh. Clicks pay for this writer's coffee (they don't).
paras.zh: 但我们会利用这个机会将凯恩的名字硬塞进头条吗？呃。点击次数可以支付作者的咖啡费（他们不需要）。

paras.en: "If I was going to do it, I would take it seriously. I would probably dedicate six months to a year to training," said Kane earlier this year. "Maybe if I am in the MLS in the future or somewhere like that it might be a thing where you could connect the two maybe with the seasons."
paras.zh: “如果我要这么做，我会认真对待。我可能会花六个月到一年的时间进行训练，”凯恩今年早些时候表示。 “也许如果我将来在美国职业足球大联盟或类似的地方，你可能可以将两者与赛季联系起来。”

paras.en: Regardless, the NFL's global ventures have often amounted to crossover collaboration between its travelling teams and the sporting giants hosting them; last week Atlanta Falcons running back Bijan Robinson caught up with Jude Bellingham ahead of their matchup with the Cincinnati Bengals at the Bernabeu, where the likes of Thibaut Courtois, Marc Cucurella and Raphael Varane were in attendance. As far as growing the game is concerned, it is a no-brainer of an easy win.
paras.zh: 无论如何，NFL 的全球业务往往意味着其巡回赛球队与主办球队的体育巨头之间的跨界合作；上周，亚特兰大猎鹰队跑卫比扬·罗宾逊在伯纳乌与辛辛那提猛虎队的比赛前采访了裘德·贝林厄姆，蒂博·库尔图瓦、马克·库库雷拉和拉斐尔·瓦拉内等人都出席了比赛。就发展游戏而言，轻松获胜是理所当然的。

paras.en: The Lions arrive 6-2 in a fiercely competitive NFC North, St. Brown continuing to be Jared Goff's prized weapon on the outside with a team-high 61 catches for 657 yards (10th most in the league) and five touchdowns within an offense ranked fifth in yards per game and fifth in scoring.
paras.zh: 雄狮队以 6 胜 2 负的战绩来到竞争激烈的 NFC 北区，圣布朗继续成为贾里德·戈夫 (Jared Goff) 在外线的宝贵武器，他以全队最高的 61 次接球推进 657 码（联盟第 10 多）和 5 次进攻达阵，场均码数排名第五，得分排名第五。

paras.en: Detroit have won four straight games, including divisional victories over both the Minnesota Vikings and Green Bay Packers in the last three weeks. Running back Jahmyr Gibbs is also at the heart of their success with an NFL-high 1,132 yards and 11 touchdowns from scrimmage.
paras.zh: 底特律队已经连胜四场比赛，包括过去三周对明尼苏达维京队和绿湾包装工队的分区胜利。跑卫贾米尔·吉布斯 (Jahm​​yr Gibbs) 也是他们成功的核心，他在混战中取得了 NFL 最高的 1,132 码和 11 次达阵。

paras.en: New England are 5-4 and coming off a 45-27 defeat to the Packers during which Drake Maye, struggling to live up to his MVP-contending heights of last season, threw three interceptions.
paras.zh: 新英格兰队以 5 胜 4 负的战绩，以 45 比 27 输给了包装工队，在此期间，德雷克·梅耶 (Drake Maye) 努力达到上赛季 MVP 争夺的高度，并完成了 3 次拦截。

paras.en: The Patriots are battling to swerve a Super Bowl hangover after February's one-sided defeat to the Seattle Seahawks and return to play in Germany for the second time after losing to the Indianapolis Colts in Frankfurt in 2023.
paras.zh: 爱国者队正在努力摆脱 2 月份单方面输给西雅图海鹰队后的超级碗宿醉，并在 2023 年在法兰克福输给印第安纳波利斯小马队后第二次重返德国比赛。

paras.en: Germany remains one of the NFL's largest fanbases outside of North America, with millions of listeners having previously tuned in to the Armed Forces Network radio station based in Frankfurt during World War II.
paras.zh: 德国仍然是 NFL 在北美以外最大的球迷群体之一，二战期间有数百万听众曾收听过位于法兰克福的武装部队网络广播电台。

paras.en: The first broadcast out of AFN Frankfurt was on July 15, 1945 from a confiscated house, after which thousands of US troops remained stationed in Germany.
paras.zh: AFN 法兰克福于 1945 年 7 月 15 日在一座被没收的房屋中进行了首次转播，此后数千名美军仍驻扎在德国。

paras.en: There were later five preseason NFL games in Germany from 1990 to 1994, while the country was also represented by the Hamburg Sea Devils, Rhein Fire, Berlin Thunder, Cologne Centurions and Frankfurt Galaxy in the former World League of American Football/NFL Europe/NFL Europa between 1991 and 2007.
paras.zh: 后来，从 1990 年到 1994 年，德国举办了五场 NFL 季前赛，而在 1991 年到 2007 年期间，该国还代表该国参加了前世界美式橄榄球联盟/NFL 欧洲/NFL 欧洲联盟的汉堡海魔队、莱茵火焰队、柏林雷霆队、科隆百夫长队和​​法兰克福银河队。

paras.en: Is there another player in football who reigns as his position's outright No 1 more so than Fred Warner? Arguably not.
paras.zh: 足球界还有其他球员比弗雷德·华纳更能占据绝对第一的地位吗？可以说不是。

paras.en: The San Francisco 49ers stalwart has occupied top spot among inside linebackers for multiple years now, and remains an unrivalled difference-maker from his role within Raheem Morris' defense.
paras.zh: 这位旧金山 49 人队的中坚力量多年来一直在内线卫中占据榜首，并且在拉希姆·莫里斯的防守中发挥着无与伦比的作用。

paras.en: Warner has been electric in his first campaign back since suffering a season-ending injury in Week Six of 2025, racking up 77 total tackles, five forced fumbles, a fumble recovery, half a sack, 5.5 stuffs and three pass breakups. Few, if any, diagnose the game better than Warner, whose film study is as refined and as expertly-exercised as any player in football.
paras.zh: 华纳在 2025 年第六周因伤赛季报销后的第一个赛季中表现出色，共完成 77 次铲断、5 次强行掉球、1 次掉球恢复、半次擒杀、5.5 次擒抱和 3 次断球。很少有人（如果有的话）能比华纳更好地诊断这项运动，他的电影研究与足球界的任何球员一样精致和熟练。

paras.en: An incredible sequence against the Las Vegas Raiders last week saw him punch the ball from the hands of Brock Bowers, recover Michael Mayers' fumble in the end zone and deny Kirk Cousins on a quarterback sneak with an incredible leaping stop over center Tyler Linderbaum in the space of about 10 minutes.
paras.zh: 上周对阵拉斯维加斯突袭者队的比赛中，他从布洛克·鲍尔斯 (Brock Bowers) 手中接过球，接过了迈克尔·梅耶斯 (Michael Mayers) 在达阵区的失球，并在大约 10 分钟内以令人难以置信的跨越中锋泰勒·林德鲍姆 (Tyler Linderbaum) 的跳跃阻挡了柯克·考辛斯 (Kirk Cousins) 的四分卫偷袭。

paras.en: Wonder why teams are scared to throw over the middle of the field against the 49ers? Fred Warner.
paras.zh: 想知道为什么球队在对阵 49 人队时不敢向中场投球吗？弗莱德·华纳.

paras.en: The Minnesota Vikings would be Super Bowl contenders if they could just figure things out at quarterback, and on Tuesday they rolled the dice once more by trading to bring back Kirk Cousins.
paras.zh: 如果明尼苏达维京人队能够在四分卫位置上解决问题，他们将成为超级碗的竞争者，周二他们再次掷骰子，交易回了柯克·考辛斯。

paras.en: Any scenario in which Justin Jefferson isn't getting the ball thrown his way becomes a major concern; the Vikings had no choice. Kyler Murray could not get it done, the Vikings traded away J.J. McCarthy to the New York Giants and on Monday night Carson Wentz epitomised this hobbling offense, which has failed miserably in its bid to back up Brian Flores' defense.
paras.zh: 贾斯汀·杰斐逊（Justin Jefferson）没有将球传给他的任何情况都会成为一个主要问题；维京人别无选择。凯勒·默里无法完成任务，维京人队交易走了 J.J.麦卡锡前往纽约巨人队，周一晚上卡森·温茨（Carson Wentz）体现了这种步履蹒跚的进攻，在支持布莱恩·弗洛雷斯（Brian Flores）的防守方面惨遭失败。

paras.en: Cousins may be 38 years old, but has been impressive for the Las Vegas Raiders this season and gives Minnesota a significantly better chance of reigniting Jefferson, who has been starved of production.
paras.zh: 考辛斯可能已经 38 岁了，但本赛季在拉斯维加斯突袭者队的表现令人印象深刻，这让明尼苏达队有更好的机会重新点燃一直缺乏生产力的杰弗森。

paras.en: Cousins is 202 of 315, passing for 2,340 yards, 20 touchdowns, eight interceptions, and a passer rating of 97.1 as he re-joins the franchise he played for from 2018-2023. Would be quite the story, huh?
paras.zh: 考辛斯在 2018-2023 年重新加入他效力的球队时，315 次传球中的 202 次，传球 2,340 码，20 次达阵，8 次拦截，传球手评分为 97.1。故事会很精彩吧？

paras.en: Jordan Love is flying, and it feels as though the Green Bay Packers are gathering Super Bowl momentum by the week as their offense begins to takeover.
paras.zh: 乔丹·乐福正在飞翔，感觉绿湾包装工队在本周的进攻开始接管时正在积聚超级碗的动力。

paras.en: Love now leads the NFL in passing yards with 2,618 for 19 touchdowns to six interceptions as the league's most aggressive splash-play merchant.
paras.zh: 乐福现在以 2,618 码的传球码数领跑 NFL，取得 19 次达阵和 6 次拦截，成为联盟中最具攻击性的泼水商人。

paras.en: He ranks first in intended air yards (3,251), intended air yards per attempt (9.5) and completed air yards (1,553) at the heart of the league's second-best passing attack, within which his receivers have notably dropped a league-high 23 passes.
paras.zh: 他在预期空中码数（3,251）、每次尝试预期空中码数（9.5）和完成空中码数（1,553）方面均排名第一，是联盟第二好的传球进攻核心，其中他的接球手在传球中丢掉了联盟最高的 23 次传球。

paras.en: They have become box office viewing, with two No 1 receivers emerging in Christian Watson - third in the league with 879 yards - and Matthew Golden - fourth in the league with 783 yards.
paras.zh: 他们已经成为票房热门，两名第一接球手克里斯蒂安·沃森（Christian Watson）以 879 码排名联盟第三，而马修·戈尔登（Matthew Golden）以 783 码排名联盟第四。

paras.en: Matt LaFleur has typically built his offense around run game foundations that he can tee off from through the air, but even through the NFL's worst rushing attack he is finding success thanks to Love's arm.
paras.zh: 马特·拉弗勒尔（Matt LaFleur）通常围绕跑动比赛基础建立进攻，他可以在空中开球，但即使面对 NFL 最糟糕的冲球进攻，他也能在乐福的帮助下取得成功。

paras.en: Sunday Night Football stages one of the biggest games of the weekend when the Cincinnati Bengals take on the Pittsburgh Steelers in a possible AFC North division decider.
paras.zh: 《周日橄榄球之夜》将上演周末最重要的比赛之一，辛辛那提猛虎队可能会在亚足联北区决胜局中迎战匹兹堡钢人队。

paras.en: Both sit 6-2 with the Steelers holding the head-to-head advantage after their 30-27 win in the reverse fixture back in September, Jaylen Warren starring out of the backfield on that occasion with 176 yards from scrimmage.
paras.zh: 双方战成 6-2 平，钢人队在 9 月份的反向比赛中以 30-27 获胜后保持着正面交锋的优势，当时杰伦·沃伦 (Jaylen Warren) 在距混战 176 码处担任后场主角。

paras.en: But the Bengals have hit their stride with a four-game winning streak over the last month, Joe Burrow rising to MVP contention while playing some of the best football of his NFL career within the league's most potent passing attack.
paras.zh: 但孟加拉虎队在上个月取得了四连胜，取得了大踏步前进，乔·伯罗 (Joe Burrow) 在联盟最有力的传球进攻中打出了他 NFL 职业生涯中最好的一些足球，并跻身 MVP 争夺行列。

paras.en: Across that four-game span, Burrow has completed 77 per cent of passes for 1,215 yards with 18 total touchdowns, three interceptions and a 132.0 passer rating.
paras.zh: 在这四场比赛中，伯罗传球完成率为 77%，推进 1,215 码，总共达阵 18 次，被拦截 3 次，传球评分为 132.0。

paras.en: Cincinnati look like legitimate Super Bowl contenders again, producing their best start through eight games since 2015.
paras.zh: 辛辛那提队看起来再次成为超级碗的合法竞争者，他们在八场比赛中取得了自 2015 年以来的最佳开局。

paras.en: The 'super-team' Los Angeles Rams are not looking so super, and there is growing reason to be concerned over their playoff chances this season.
paras.zh: “超级球队”洛杉矶公羊队看起来并不那么超级，人们越来越有理由担心他们本赛季的季后赛机会。

paras.en: Sean McVay's side were dealt another crushing blow this week when it was revealed Puka Nacua had suffered a right knee injury set to land him on injured reserve and miss at least a month of action, adding to an absentee list already featuring Davante Adams.
paras.zh: 肖恩·麦克维的球队本周再次遭受毁灭性打击，有消息称普卡·纳库亚右膝受伤，这将使他进入伤病预备队并缺席至少一个月的比赛，这又增加了达万特·亚当斯缺席的名单。

paras.en: Rams General Manager Les Snead is typically one of football's most aggressive dealers, but on Tuesday neglected to add receiver help for Matthew Stafford as they enter Sunday's divisional clash against the Arizona Cardinals 5-4.
paras.zh: 公羊队总经理莱斯·斯尼德通常是足球界最具侵略性的经销商之一，但周二，他们在周日以 5-4 对阵亚利桑那红雀队的分区比赛中，却忽略了为马修·斯塔福德增加接球手帮助。

paras.en: McVay is known for his multiple tight end sets, and will now need to lean on as much alongside Kyren Williams and Blake Corum in order to keep this offense afloat
paras.zh: 麦克维以多次近端锋组合而闻名，现在他需要与凯伦·威廉姆斯和布雷克·科鲁姆一起依靠，才能保持进攻的顺利进行

paras.en: - The Jaguars completed trades for Eagles defensive tackle Jordan Davis, Falcons safety Jessie Bates III and Saints defensive tackle Davon Godchaux
paras.zh: - 美洲虎队完成了老鹰队防守截锋乔丹·戴维斯、猎鹰队安全卫杰西·贝茨三世和圣徒队防守截锋达文·戈德肖克斯的交易

paras.en: - Kirk Cousins returned to the Vikings in a trade from the Raiders, who announced No 1 pick Fernando Mendoza as their new starter
paras.zh: - 柯克·考辛斯在突袭者队的交易中回到维京人队，突袭者队宣布状元秀费尔南多·门多萨作为他们的新首发

paras.en: - The Colts traded wide receiver Josh Downs to the Chiefs and Keenan Allen to the 49ers, while keeping running back Jonathan Taylor
paras.zh: - 小马队将外接手乔什·唐斯（Josh Downs）交易至酋长队，将基南·艾伦（Keenan Allen）交易至 49 人队，同时保留跑卫乔纳森·泰勒（Jonathan Taylor）

paras.en: - The Rams announced Puka Nacua is likely to be placed on injured reserve with a knee issue
paras.zh: - 公羊队宣布普卡纳库亚可能因膝盖问题被列入伤病储备名单

paras.en: - The NFL reinstated wide receiver Brandon Aiyuk to the 49ers after he left the team a year ago
paras.zh: - 外接手布兰登·艾尤克 (Brandon Aiyuk) 一年前离开球队后，NFL 将他重新安置在 49 人队

paras.en: - Cardinals quarterback Gardner Minshew is set to undergo season-ending elbow surgery
paras.zh: - 红雀队四分卫加德纳·明修将接受赛季结束的肘部手术

paras.en: - Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow has the chance to become the second player in NFL history with at least three touchdown passes and a passer rating of 115 or higher in five consecutive games behind Russell Wilson when he faces the Steelers on Sunday night
paras.zh: - 孟加拉虎队四分卫乔·布罗（Joe Burrow）有机会成为 NFL 历史上第二位在连续五场比赛中至少有 3 次达阵传球且传球评分达到 115 或更高的球员，仅次于拉塞尔·威尔逊（Russell Wilson），周日晚上对阵钢人队时

paras.en: - Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes needs one touchdown pass against the Falcons to overtake Peyton Manning (327) for the most touchdown passes by a quarterback in his first 10 seasons, including the playoffs
paras.zh: - 酋长队四分卫帕特里克·马霍姆斯在对阵猎鹰队时需要一次达阵传球，才能超越佩顿·曼宁（327次），成为他前 10 个赛季（包括季后赛）中四分卫传球达阵次数最多的球员

paras.en: - With a win at the New York Jets, Josh Allen can surpass Patrick Mahomes (95) for the second-most regular season wins by a starting quarterback in his first nine seasons in NFL history
paras.zh: - 凭借在纽约喷气机队的胜利，乔什·艾伦将超越帕特里克·马霍姆斯（95 场），成为 NFL 历史上前九个赛季中首发四分卫第二多的常规赛胜利

paras.en: - Lions running back Jahmyr Gibbs needs a touchdown in Munich to tie Pro Football Hall of Famer Terrell Davis (61 touchdowns) for the most touchdowns by a player in his first four seasons in NFL history
paras.zh: - 雄狮队跑卫贾米尔·吉布斯 (Jahm​​yr Gibbs) 需要在慕尼黑达阵，追平职业橄榄球名人堂成员特雷尔·戴维斯 (Terrell Davis)（61 次达阵），成为 NFL 历史上前四个赛季达阵次数最多的球员

paras.en: - Packers duo Christian Watson and Matthew Golden have the chance to become the fourth pair of teammates all-time each with at least 900 receiving yards in their team's first 10 games of a season
paras.zh: - 包装工队二人组克里斯蒂安·沃森和马修·戈尔登有机会成为历史上第四对在球队赛季前 10 场比赛中接球码数至少达到 900 码的队友

paras.en: - Myles Garrett needs just half a sack to overtake Jared Allen (128.5 sacks) for the second-most sacks by a player in his first 10 seasons since 1982, when the individual sack became an official statistic
paras.zh: - 迈尔斯·加勒特只需要半个擒杀就超越贾里德·艾伦（128.5次擒杀），成为自1982年以来个人擒杀数成为官方统计数据以来前10个赛季中第二多擒杀的球员

articles.title: UEFA Nations League: All you need to know

paras.en: UEFA Nations League: Format, rules, promotion and relegation explained, and how it affects Euro 2028 qualifying
paras.zh: 欧洲国家联赛：赛制、规则、晋级和降级解释，以及它如何影响 2028 年欧洲杯预选赛

paras.en: The 2026/27 UEFA Nations League is under way, with Portugal defending their title and England chasing a first triumph. But how does the competition work, what are the promotion and relegation rules, and what changes from 2028/29?
paras.zh: 2026/27 赛季欧洲国家联赛正在进行中，葡萄牙卫冕，英格兰则力争首冠。但比赛是如何进行的，升降级规则是什么，与2028/29赛季相比有何变化？

paras.en: The UEFA Nations League is back for its fifth edition, with 54 European countries competing for silverware, promotion and a potentially crucial route to Euro 2028.
paras.zh: 欧洲国家联赛第五届回归，54 个欧洲国家将争夺奖杯、晋级资格以及通向 2028 年欧洲杯的潜在关键途径。

paras.en: Portugal are the defending champions after beating Spain on penalties in the 2025 final, while England are looking to win the competition for the first time under Thomas Tuchel.
paras.zh: 葡萄牙在 2025 年决赛中点球击败西班牙后成为卫冕冠军，而英格兰则希望在托马斯·图赫尔的带领下首次赢得比赛。

paras.en: But there is more than a trophy at stake. Results can determine which division teams compete in during the next campaign, while performances could also have a significant impact on qualification for the European championship.
paras.zh: 但利害攸关的不仅仅是一座奖杯。成绩可以决定下赛季哪些分区球队的参赛资格，而表现也可能对欧洲杯的资格产生重大影响。

paras.en: From how the format works to the promotion and relegation rules, here's everything you need to know about the UEFA Nations League.
paras.zh: 从赛制如何运作到升降级规则，以下是您需要了解的有关欧洲国家联赛的所有信息。

paras.en: The UEFA Nations League is an international competition involving Europe's national teams, designed to replace many of the traditional international friendlies with competitive fixtures.
paras.zh: 欧洲国家联赛是一项涉及欧洲国家队的国际赛事，旨在用竞技比赛取代许多传统的国际友谊赛。

paras.en: First introduced in 2018, the tournament gives nations the opportunity to compete against teams of a similar standard, with promotion, relegation and a trophy on offer.
paras.zh: 该赛事于 2018 年首次推出，让各国有机会与水平相似的球队竞争，并提供晋级、降级和奖杯。

paras.en: The competition is divided into four leagues - A, B, C and D - with League A containing the highest-ranked nations.
paras.zh: 比赛分为四个联赛：A、B、C 和 D，其中 A 联赛包含排名最高的国家。

paras.en: Portugal are the most successful team in the competition, having won the title twice, in 2019 and 2025.
paras.zh: 葡萄牙是本届赛事中最成功的球队，曾于 2019 年和 2025 年两次夺冠。

paras.en: France and Spain have also lifted the trophy, in 2021 and 2023 respectively.
paras.zh: 法国和西班牙也分别于 2021 年和 2023 年捧起奖杯。

paras.en: The 2026/27 Nations League features 54 nations divided into four leagues.
paras.zh: 2026/27 年国家联赛共有 54 个国家参加，分为四个联赛。

paras.en: Leagues A, B and C each contain 16 teams, split into four groups of four. League D consists of six teams, divided into two groups of three.
paras.zh: A、B、C 联赛各有 16 支球队，分为 4 个小组，每组 4 支球队。 D联赛由六支球队组成，分为两组，每组三支。

paras.en: Teams play each opponent in their group twice, home and away, with points determining the final standings.
paras.zh: 球队将与小组中的每个对手进行主客场两场比赛，积分决定最终排名。

paras.en: Three points are awarded for a win and one for a draw.
paras.zh: 获胜可得三分，平局可得一分。

paras.en: The top two in each League A group qualify for the quarter-finals, while the winners of those ties progress to the Nations League Finals in June 2027.
paras.zh: 每个联赛 A 组的前两名有资格进入四分之一决赛，而这些平局的获胜者将晋级 2027 年 6 月的国家联赛决赛。

paras.en: The bottom sides and teams finishing in other promotion and relegation positions will face a different challenge, with their performances determining which league they compete in during the next edition.
paras.zh: 排名垫底的球队和其他升降级球队将面临不同的挑战，他们的表现将决定他们在下一届联赛中参加哪个联赛。

paras.en: Promotion and relegation are central to the Nations League, giving teams something to play for throughout the group stage, regardless of their position in the rankings.
paras.zh: 晋级和降级是国家联赛的核心，让球队在整个小组赛阶段都有机会参加比赛，无论他们在排名中的位置如何。

paras.en: The four group winners in League B will be promoted directly to League A, while the four group winners in League C will move up to League B.
paras.zh: B联赛的4个小组第一名将直接晋级A联赛，C联赛的4个小组第一名将升入B联赛。

paras.en: Teams finishing bottom of their respective groups also face the prospect of dropping down a division.
paras.zh: 各自小组垫底的球队也面临着降级的前景。

paras.en: However, the 2026/27 campaign features a slightly different system as UEFA prepares to change the competition format for 2028/29.
paras.zh: 然而，2026/27赛季的赛制略有不同，因为欧足联准备改变2028/29赛季的比赛形式。

paras.en: The two lowest-ranked fourth-placed teams in League A will be automatically relegated to League B.
paras.zh: A联赛排名最低的两支第四名球队将自动降级至B联赛。

paras.en: The other teams involved in the League A/B promotion and relegation battle will contest play-offs.
paras.zh: 其他参加联赛A/B升降级战的球队将进行附加赛。

paras.en: These will involve the four runners-up from League B against the two lowest-ranked third-placed teams and the two highest-ranked fourth-placed teams from League A.
paras.zh: 乙级联赛的四支亚军将对阵甲级联赛中排名最低的两支第三名球队和两支排名最高的第四名球队。

paras.en: The winners will play in League A in 2028/29, with the defeated teams competing in League B.
paras.zh: 胜者将参加2028/29赛季的A联赛，负队则参加B联赛。

paras.en: A similar system operates between Leagues B and C, with the four bottom-placed teams in League B facing the four runners-up from League C.
paras.zh: B联赛和C联赛之间也有类似的制度，B联赛垫底的四支球队对阵C联赛的四支亚军。

paras.en: The winners will play in League B in the next edition, while the defeated teams will drop into League C.
paras.zh: 胜者将参加下届B联赛，而败者将进入C联赛。

paras.en: When are the 2026/27 Nations League finals?
paras.zh: 2026/27 年国家联赛决赛何时举行？

paras.en: The league phase runs from September to November 2026, with the final two rounds of group matches taking place during the November international break.
paras.zh: 联赛阶段从 9 月持续到 2026 年 11 月，最后两轮小组赛将在 11 月的国际比赛日期间进行。

paras.en: The League A quarter-finals, alongside the League A/B and League B/C promotion and relegation play-offs, will take place between March 25 and March 30, 2027.
paras.zh: A联赛四分之一决赛以及A/B联赛和B/C联赛升降级附加赛将于2027年3月25日至30日期间举行。

paras.en: The Nations League Finals will then be held between June 9 and June 13, 2027.
paras.zh: 国家联赛决赛将于2027年6月9日至13日举行。

paras.en: The tournament will feature two semi-finals, a third-place play-off and the final, with four nations competing to be crowned champions of Europe.
paras.zh: 本届赛事将包括两场半决赛、一场三四名决赛和决赛，四个国家将争夺欧洲冠军。

paras.en: Where will the Nations League final be held?
paras.zh: 国家联赛决赛将在哪里举行？

paras.en: The 2027 UEFA Nations League Finals will take place between June 9 and June 13, 2027.
paras.zh: 2027年欧洲国家联赛决赛将于2027年6月9日至13日举行。

paras.en: The host nation and stadiums are yet to be confirmed by UEFA. The four teams that progress through the quarter-finals in March will compete for the trophy, with the semi-finals, third-place play-off and final deciding the champions.
paras.zh: 主办国和球场尚未得到欧足联确认。 3月份晋级四分之一决赛的四支球队将争夺奖杯，通过半决赛、季军争夺战和决赛决出冠军。

paras.en: When is the Nations League knockout stage draw?
paras.zh: 国联淘汰赛抽签时间是什么时候？

paras.en: The UEFA Nations League knockout stage and play-off draw will take place at 12:00 CET on Friday, November 20, 2026, following the conclusion of the league phase.
paras.zh: 欧洲国家联赛淘汰赛阶段和附加赛抽签将于欧洲中部时间 2026 年 11 月 20 日星期五 12:00 在联赛阶段结束后举行。

paras.en: The draw will determine the quarter-final and promotion/relegation play-off ties, with teams from the same group unable to face each other in the quarter-finals.
paras.zh: 抽签将决定四分之一决赛和升降级附加赛的胜负，同组球队无法在四分之一决赛中交锋。

paras.en: The eight teams finishing in the top two of the four League A groups will progress to the quarter-finals, which will be played over two legs in March 2027.
paras.zh: 甲级联赛四个小组中排名前两名的八支球队将晋级四分之一决赛，并于 2027 年 3 月进行两回合比赛。

paras.en: The four winners will then advance to the Nations League Finals in June 2027, with the semi-finals, third-place play-off and final deciding the champions.
paras.zh: 四支获胜者将晋级 2027 年 6 月举行的国家联赛决赛，通过半决赛、季军附加赛和决赛决出冠军。

paras.en: What about the Home Nations and the Republic of Ireland?
paras.zh: 那么祖国和爱尔兰共和国呢？

paras.en: The Nations League offers plenty of challenges for the five British and Irish nations, with England and Wales competing in League A, while Scotland, Northern Ireland and the Republic of Ireland are in League B.
paras.zh: 国家联赛为英国和爱尔兰的五个国家带来了许多挑战，其中英格兰和威尔士参加 A 联赛，而苏格兰、北爱尔兰和爱尔兰共和国则参加 B 联赛。

paras.en: England face Croatia and Spain, while Wales take on Norway and Portugal.
paras.zh: 英格兰对阵克罗地亚和西班牙，威尔士对阵挪威和葡萄牙。

paras.en: Scotland meet North Macedonia and Switzerland, Northern Ireland face Ukraine and Hungary, and the Republic of Ireland play Kosovo and Austria.
paras.zh: 苏格兰对阵北马其顿和瑞士，北爱尔兰对阵乌克兰和匈牙利，爱尔兰共和国对阵科索沃和奥地利。

paras.en: The results will determine who reaches the knockout stages, earns promotion or faces relegation.
paras.zh: 结果将决定谁进入淘汰赛、晋级或降级。

paras.en: What is changing in the Nations League from 2028/29?
paras.zh: 2028/29 年以来，国家联赛发生了哪些变化？

paras.en: The 2026/27 Nations League is the final edition to feature four divisions.
paras.zh: 2026/27 年国家联赛是最后一个设有四个级别的赛事。

paras.en: UEFA has approved a change to a three-league format for the 2028/29 competition, meaning League D will be scrapped.
paras.zh: 欧足联已批准2028/29赛季比赛改为三级联赛，这意味着D级联赛将被取消。

paras.en: All six teams currently competing in League D will automatically move up to League C.
paras.zh: 目前参加 D 联赛的所有六支球队将自动升级至 C 联赛。

paras.en: The new structure will feature three leagues, each containing 18 teams split into three groups of six.
paras.zh: 新的结构将分为三个联赛，每个联赛包含 18 支球队，分为三组，每组六支。

paras.en: Teams will play six matches in the league phase, with the revised format designed to create a more streamlined competition.
paras.zh: 球队将在联赛阶段进行六场比赛，修改后的赛制旨在打造更加精简的比赛。

paras.en: The composition of each division will be determined by results in the 2026/27 Nations League.
paras.zh: 每个分区的组成将根据 2026/27 年国家联赛的结果确定。

paras.en: League A will contain the eight quarter-finalists from the current edition, the two highest-ranked third-placed teams from League A, the four League B group winners and the four winners of the League A/B play-offs.
paras.zh: A联赛将包含当前版本的八支四分之一决赛球队、A联赛中排名最高的两支第三名球队、B联赛小组的四支球队以及A/B附加赛的四支球队。

paras.en: League B will include the two lowest-ranked fourth-placed teams from League A, the four defeated teams from the League A/B play-offs, the four third-placed teams from League B, the four League C group winners and the four winners of the League B/C play-offs.
paras.zh: B联赛将包括A联赛排名最低的两支第四名球队、A/B联赛附加赛的四支负队、B联赛第三名的四支球队、C联赛小组的四支球队以及B/C联赛附加赛的四支获胜球队。

paras.en: League C will consist of the four defeated teams from the League B/C play-offs, the eight teams finishing third and fourth in League C, and the six teams currently in League D.
paras.zh: C联赛将由B/C联赛附加赛的四支球队、C联赛第三和第四名的八支球队以及目前D联赛的六支球队组成。

paras.en: Does the Nations League affect Euro 2028 qualifying?
paras.zh: 国家联赛会影响 2028 年欧洲杯预选赛吗？

paras.en: The Nations League will play an important role in the qualification process for Euro 2028, which will be hosted by England, Scotland, Wales and the Republic of Ireland.
paras.zh: 国家联盟将在 2028 年欧洲杯的资格赛中发挥重要作用，该赛事将由英格兰、苏格兰、威尔士和爱尔兰共和国主办。

paras.en: The final Nations League rankings will determine the seeding of nations for the European Championship qualifying draw.
paras.zh: 最终的国家联赛排名将决定参加欧洲锦标赛预选赛抽签的国家种子队。

paras.en: The competition will also offer a potential second chance to reach the tournament through the play-offs.
paras.zh: 比赛还将提供通过附加赛第二次进入锦标赛的潜在机会。

paras.en: Twenty-four teams will compete at Euro 2028. Twelve qualifying group winners and the eight best runners-up will secure automatic places, with the remaining runners-up entering the play-offs.
paras.zh: 24支球队将参加2028年欧洲杯。12支预选赛小组第一名和八名成绩最好的亚军将自动获得席位，其余亚军将进入附加赛。

paras.en: Nations League group winners who fail to finish in the top two of their Euro 2028 qualifying group will also be eligible for a play-off place.
paras.zh: 未能进入 2028 年欧洲杯预选赛小组前两名的国联小组冠军也将有资格获得附加赛席位。

paras.en: Those places will initially be allocated to the best-ranked group winners from Leagues A, B and C. If additional places are required, they will filter down to the next-highest-ranked eligible teams.
paras.zh: 这些名额最初将分配给 A、B 和 C 联赛中排名最好的小组获胜者。如果需要额外的名额，他们将筛选到排名次高的合格球队。

paras.en: The system means a strong Nations League campaign could prove decisive for countries who struggle in the traditional qualifying process.
paras.zh: 该制度意味着，对于那些在传统预选赛中苦苦挣扎的国家来说，强大的国家联盟战役可能具有决定性作用。

articles.title: Arsenal survive dominant Barca to earn precious WCL point

paras.en: Barcelona 1-1 Arsenal: Renee Slegers' side withstand onslaught from European champions to snatch point in WCL
paras.zh: 巴塞罗那1-1阿森纳：蕾妮·斯莱格斯的球队顶住欧洲冠军的猛攻，在WCL中夺取积分

paras.en: Match report as Arsenal draw 1-1 with Barcelona at the Spotify Camp Nou; Gunners survived an onslaught from the European champions to earn a point thanks to Frida Maanum's goal against the run of play; Caroline Graham Hansen notched deserved equaliser for hosts
paras.zh: 阿森纳在诺坎普球场 1-1 战平巴塞罗那的比赛报道；凭借弗里达·马努姆（Frida Maanum）在比赛中的进球，枪手在欧洲冠军的猛攻中幸存下来并获得一分；卡罗琳·格雷厄姆·汉森为东道主扳平比分

paras.en: Arsenal managed to withstand Barcelona's dominance to claim an impressive 1-1 draw against the European champions.
paras.zh: 阿森纳顶住了巴塞罗那的统治地位，以 1-1 战平欧洲冠军球队。

paras.en: The Gunners were hoping for a repeat upset of the 2025 Champions League final, and while Frida Maanum's opener gave the underdogs something to cling onto, they were unable to keep out a relentless Barca for 90 minutes.
paras.zh: 枪手希望在 2025 年欧冠决赛中再次爆出冷门，虽然弗里达·马努姆的首开纪录给了弱者一些支持，但他们无法在 90 分钟内抵挡住无情的巴萨。

paras.en: - Got Sky? Watch WSL games LIVE on your phone📱
paras.zh: - 有天空吗？在手机上观看 WSL 比赛直播📱

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream WSL games with no contract📺
paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播 WSL 比赛📺

paras.en: After a start that saw Misa Rodriguez called into action on several occasions early, the Gunners stole the lead as Maanum tucked home a rebound from Caitlin Foord's thwarted effort.
paras.zh: 比赛一开始，米萨·罗德里格斯（Misa Rodriguez）就多次发起进攻，但随着马努姆（Maanum）从凯特琳·福德（Caitlin Foord）受阻的射门中捡到篮板，枪手抢占了领先优势。

paras.en: It was a rare moment of escaping the Barca barrage led by Caroline Graham Hansen, who hit the post with the hosts 18th and final attempt of the first half alone.
paras.zh: 这是逃离卡罗琳·格雷厄姆·汉森带领的巴萨进攻的罕见时刻，她在上半场第 18 次射门，也是最后一次射门击中门柱。

paras.en: The Gunners needed a miracle to withstand another 45 minutes without conceding, and such luck didn't come their way. Hansen finally punished the visitors for leaving her in too much space as she bent a beautiful curling effort beyond the reach of Rodriguez.
paras.zh: 枪手需要奇迹才能再坚持45分钟不失球，但这样的运气并没有降临到他们身上。汉森最终惩罚了客队，因为她给她留下了太多的空间，她漂亮的冰壶动作超出了罗德里格斯的范围。

paras.en: While it seemed as though the equaliser would open the floodgates, Barca appeared to run out of gas shortly after as Alessia Russo missed the best chance for a winner at the Spotify Camp Nou.
paras.zh: 虽然扳平比分似乎会打开闸门，但巴萨似乎很快就耗尽了动力，因为阿莱西娅·鲁索错过了在诺坎普球场获胜的最佳机会。

paras.en: The result means that Arsenal climb back up into the top four places needed to progress straight into the Champions League, while also remaining just two points behind leaders Lyon, who they face off against next week.
paras.zh: 这一结果意味着阿森纳重新回到了直接晋级欧冠联赛所需的前四名，同时也仅落后领头羊里昂两分，他们将在下周对阵里昂。

paras.en: Key moments from the Spotify Camp Nou...
paras.zh: Spotify 诺坎普球场的关键时刻...

paras.en: 5: HUGE WASTE! Foord and Russo fail to make Barca pay on the break.
paras.zh: 5：巨大的浪费！福德和鲁索未能让巴萨在中场休息时付出代价。

paras.en: 7: SAVE! Hansen stings the palms of Misa.
paras.zh: 7：保存！汉森蜇了米萨的手掌。

paras.en: 10: BIG SAVE! Misa at it again to deny Schertenleib from point-blank range.
paras.zh: 10：大优惠！米萨再次尝试从近距离射门挡出舍滕莱布的射门。

paras.en: 22: GOAL! Maanum slots home to give Gunners shock lead.
paras.zh: 22：目标！马努姆（Maanum）主场为枪手带来惊人的领先。

paras.en: 34: WIDE! Guijarro misses glorious chance after brilliant Hansen cross.
paras.zh: 34：宽！汉森精彩传中后，吉哈罗错失良机。

paras.en: 45+3: POST! Hansen gets on the end of a cross this time, but heads onto woodwork.
paras.zh: 45+3：发帖！汉森这次接到了十字架的末端，但头朝木制品。

paras.en: 59: GOAL! Hansen finally breaks Arsenal's resistance.
paras.zh: 59：目标！汉森终于打破了阿森纳的抵抗。

paras.en: 66: OVER! Russo should do better as her first-time effort goes over.
paras.zh: 66：结束！当鲁索第一次努力结束时，她应该会做得更好。

articles.title: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills at least six people, officials say
articles.author: Chantal Da Silva

paras.en: An Israeli airstrike on a hospital in southern Gaza overnight killed at least six people, the Health Ministry in the Palestinian enclave said Thursday.
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦飞地卫生部周四表示，以色列夜间对加沙南部一家医院的空袭造成至少六人死亡。

paras.en: The strike hit a surgery building at Nasser Hospital, with medical staff and patients among those killed, including a surgeon and a 13-year-old boy, health officials said. The Israeli military said it was targeting a Hamas commander and other militants.
paras.zh: 卫生官员称，袭击袭击了纳赛尔医院的一座手术大楼，造成医务人员和患者死亡，其中包括一名外科医生和一名 13 岁男孩。以色列军方表示，其目标是一名哈马斯指挥官和其他武装分子。

paras.en: The strike — the latest despite an ongoing U.S.-backed ceasefire — shattered ceilings and left debris strewn across wards inside the hospital, which is one of the few functioning medical facilities left in Gaza after the destruction of Israel’s yearslong military assault.
paras.zh: 这次袭击是尽管美国支持的停火仍在进行中的最新一次袭击，但医院内的天花板被震碎，病房内散落着碎片。该医院是以色列多年的军事袭击被摧毁后，加沙仅存的少数仍在运转的医疗设施之一。

paras.en: Palestinian surgeon Dr. Rizk Abu Shaira was among those killed, the Health Ministry said. He was featured in the 2026 documentary “American Doctor,” which followed three American doctors helping to provide medical care in Gaza.
paras.zh: 卫生部称，巴勒斯坦外科医生里兹克·阿布·谢拉博士是遇难者之一。他出现在 2026 年纪录片《美国医生》中，该片讲述了三名美国医生在加沙提供医疗服务的故事。

paras.en: Dr. Ayman Abu Obeid, head of the surgery department at Nasser Hospital, said there was no “notice, warning or anything” before the hospital was attacked. “Suddenly, there was fire and shelling and walls were brought down instantly,” he said.
paras.zh: 纳赛尔医院外科主任艾曼·阿布·奥贝德医生表示，在医院遭到袭击之前没有任何“通知、警告或任何事情”。 “突然间，发生了火灾和炮击，墙壁立即倒塌，”他说。

paras.en: He said he was not aware of any “resistance fighters or combatants present — only a medical team treating patients.”
paras.zh: 他说，他不知道有任何“抵抗战士或战斗人员在场——只有一支医疗队在治疗病人。”

paras.en: NBC News also spoke with two surgeons who said they were in the hospital when the missile struck after traveling to Gaza from the U.K. earlier this month to assist with medical care.
paras.zh: NBC 新闻还采访了两名外科医生，他们表示，本月早些时候从英国前往加沙协助医疗护理后，导弹袭击时他们正在医院里。

paras.en: Both Dr. Goher Rahbour, a consultant general and colorectal surgeon, and Dr. Stephan Verborg, a limb reconstruction surgeon, said they were also not aware of any warning from the Israeli military before the strike, which hit the hospital shortly after midnight.
paras.zh: 总顾问兼结直肠外科医生 Goher Rahbour 博士和肢体重建外科医生 Stephan Verborg 博士均表示，他们也不知道以色列军方在午夜过后不久袭击医院之前发出过任何警告。

paras.en: “I heard the impact and I felt the explosion because the whole hospital shook,” Verborg said in a phone interview Thursday. He said he was about 15 to 20 meters away from the point of impact, adding: “You could smell the smoke. You could see the dust.”
paras.zh: “我听到了撞击声，也感觉到了爆炸，因为整个医院都在震动，”维尔堡在周四的电话采访中说。他说他距离撞击点大约 15 到 20 米，并补充道：“你可以闻到烟雾的味道。你可以看到灰尘。”

paras.en: Rahbour said he had been operating with Abu Shaira, whom he described as a “lovely” and “affable” person, earlier that day. He said they had been laughing and joking together Wednesday evening in the hours just before the Palestinian surgeon was killed.
paras.zh: 拉布尔说，当天早些时候，他一直在与阿布·沙伊拉一起做手术，他形容阿布·沙伊拉是一个“可爱”、“和蔼可亲”的人。他说，周三晚上，就在巴勒斯坦外科医生被杀之前的几个小时里，他们在一起有说有笑。

paras.en: Both doctors had traveled to Gaza early this month through the organization IDEALS, a U.K. charity seeking to provide sustainable humanitarian aid to regions affected by conflict or natural disasters. They said they had not seen any indication of a Hamas presence in the hospital.
paras.zh: 两名医生均于本月初通过理想组织前往加沙，理想是一家英国慈善机构，致力于为受冲突或自然灾害影响的地区提供可持续的人道主义援助。他们说，他们没有看到哈马斯出现在医院的任何迹象。

paras.en: Tributes were paid to Abu Shaira. “Dr. Rizq was at the hospital during the entire war,” Dr. Mohammed Zaqout, director general of the Health Ministry in Gaza, could be seen telling a crowd of mourners, surrounding a body covered in a shroud, in a video captured for NBC News on Thursday. “He didn’t abandon his duties for even one day.”
paras.zh: 向阿布沙伊拉致敬。在周四为 NBC 新闻拍摄的一段视频中，加沙卫生部长穆罕默德·扎克特 (Mohammed Zaqout) 博士对围着一具裹着裹尸布的尸体的哀悼者说道：“整个战争期间，里兹克医生都在医院里。” “他一天也没有放弃自己的职责。”

paras.en: Nasser Hospital said a 13-year-old boy, identified as Jihad Naeem Muhammad Abu Tilikh, was also among those killed.
paras.zh: 纳赛尔医院表示，死者中还包括一名 13 岁男孩，他的名字是吉哈德·纳伊姆·穆罕默德·阿布·蒂利赫 (Jihad Naeem Muhammad Abu Tilikh)。

paras.en: The Israeli military and the Israel Security Agency said they struck a senior Hamas member, along with other militants, who they said had “advanced” attacks from the hospital in the southern Gaza Strip overnight. In a later statement, they identified the senior member as Muhammad Abu Ismail, who they said served as the commander of Hamas’ Khan Younis Brigade and had also been responsible for holding hostages in Gaza.
paras.zh: 以色列军方和以色列安全局表示，他们袭击了一名哈马斯高级成员以及其他武装分子，称他们连夜从加沙地带南部的医院“推进”了袭击。在后来的声明中，他们确认这名高级成员是穆罕默德·阿布·伊斯梅尔，他们说他曾担任哈马斯汗尤尼斯旅的指挥官，还负责在加沙扣押人质。

paras.en: The IDF and ISA said Hamas had “established a presence within the hospital complex and used it as a command center” and stored weapons and conducted interrogations and torture from within the medical complex. They shared photos of weapons alleged to have been found within the complex.
paras.zh: 以色列国防军和以色列安全局表示，哈马斯“在医院大楼内建立了存在，并将其用作指挥中心”，并在医疗大楼内储存武器并进行审讯和酷刑。他们分享了据称在建筑群内发现的武器的照片。

paras.en: The IDF and ISA said steps had been taken to “mitigate harm to civilians, including the use of precision munitions and aerial surveillance.” They also later said “advance warnings were issued to the population.” The IDF said it was looking into reports that medical workers, including Abu Shaira, and patients were killed.
paras.zh: 以色列国防军和国际安全局表示，已采取措施“减轻对平民的伤害，包括使用精确弹药和空中监视”。他们后来还表示“已向民众发出提前警告”。以色列国防军表示正在调查有关包括阿布·沙伊拉在内的医务人员和患者被杀的报道。

paras.en: One woman, Tahani Ibrahim Abu Anza, said her brother, Khaled Abu Anza, was killed in the strike, with Nasser Hospital separately confirming his death.
paras.zh: 一名叫塔哈尼·易卜拉欣·阿布·安扎（Tahani Ibrahim Abu Anza）的妇女表示，她的兄弟哈立德·阿布·安扎（Khaled Abu Anza）在空袭中丧生，纳赛尔医院也证实了他的死讯。

paras.en: A number of media outlets, including Israeli media outlet Ynet, reported that a commander in Hamas’ Khan Younis Brigade of that same name was killed in the strike. Asked to confirm that and whether he was directly targeted, the IDF said it would get back on the matter.
paras.zh: 包括以色列媒体Ynet在内的多家媒体报道称，哈马斯汗尤尼斯旅的一名同名指挥官在袭击中丧生。当被要求确认这一点以及他是否是直接攻击目标时，以色列国防军表示将就此事进行回应。

paras.en: Tahani Ibrahim Abu Anza did not directly identify her brother, 53, as a Hamas member, but said she believed he was targeted. He had been at the hospital for physical therapy after undergoing surgery, she said.
paras.zh: 塔哈尼·易卜拉欣·阿布·安扎 (Tahani Ibrahim Abu Anza) 没有直接指认她 53 岁的兄弟是哈马斯成员，但表示她相信他是袭击目标。她说，他在接受手术后一直在医院接受物理治疗。

paras.en: “He did not come to the hospital to engage in combat or resistance. He came for medical treatment,” she said.
paras.zh: “他来医院不是为了战斗或抵抗。他是来接受治疗的，”她说。

paras.en: Hamas condemned the allegations that it was using the hospital for military operations as “lies of the criminal enemy” and called the attack a “war crime.”
paras.zh: 哈马斯谴责有关其利用该医院进行军事行动的指控是“犯罪敌人的谎言”，并称这次袭击是“战争罪”。

paras.en: Hospitals have protected status under international law, but they have been heavily targeted under Israel’s yearslong offensive in Gaza. The Israeli military has repeatedly accused Hamas of operating within medical facilities, a charge the militant group has denied.
paras.zh: 医院享有国际法的保护地位，但在以色列多年来对加沙的攻势下，医院成为了重点攻击目标。以色列军方多次指责哈马斯在医疗设施内开展活动，但该武装组织否认了这一指控。

paras.en: The overnight attack was not the first time that Nasser Hospital itself has been targeted.
paras.zh: 这次夜间袭击并不是纳赛尔医院第一次成为攻击目标。

paras.en: In August 2025, the hospital was hit by a double tap Israeli strike that killed at least 20 people, including journalists and health workers. The deadly attack sparked international outrage.
paras.zh: 2025 年 8 月，该医院遭到以色列两次袭击，造成至少 20 人死亡，其中包括记者和卫生工作者。这起致命袭击引发了国际社会的愤怒。

paras.en: Of Gaza’s 37 hospitals, just two are considered to be “fully functioning,” while 18 are partially functioning and 17 are considered nonfunctioning after much of the enclave’s healthcare system was devastated under Israel’s offensive, according to data published by the World Health Organization.
paras.zh: 根据世界卫生组织公布的数据，加沙的 37 家医院中，只有 2 家被认为“完全运转”，18 家部分运转，17 家被认为无法运转，因为飞地的大部分医疗系统在以色列的攻势下遭到破坏。

paras.en: Israeli strikes have continued in Gaza despite a ceasefire agreement reached in October of last year.
paras.zh: 尽管去年十月达成停火协议，以色列仍在加沙继续发动袭击。

paras.en: More than 1,600 people have been killed since the truce came into effect, according to the Palestinian Health Ministry in the enclave. Israel says four of its soldiers have been killed in that time.
paras.zh: 据飞地的巴勒斯坦卫生部称，自停火协议生效以来，已有 1,600 多人死亡。以色列称，当时有四名士兵被杀。

paras.en: Both Israel and Hamas have accused each other of violating the ceasefire.
paras.zh: 以色列和哈马斯都指责对方违反停火协议。

paras.en: More than 74,600 people, including thousands of children, have been killed overall in Gaza since Israel launched its offensive in the enclave following the Hamas-led Oct. 7, 2023, attacks, in which some 1,200 people were killed and around 250 taken hostage.
paras.zh: 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯领导的袭击造成约 1,200 人死亡，约 250 人被扣为人质，自以色列在加沙飞地发动进攻以来，已有超过 74,600 人丧生，其中包括数千名儿童。

paras.en: In a statement, Medical Aid for Palestinians, which supports several departments at Nasser Hospital, said the overnight attack was “yet another indication that the so-called ‘ceasefire’ has brought neither safety nor an end to Israel’s attacks on Gaza’s healthcare system.”
paras.zh: 支持纳赛尔医院多个部门的巴勒斯坦人医疗援助组织在一份声明中表示，夜间袭击“再次表明所谓的‘停火’既没有带来安全，也没有结束以色列对加沙医疗系统的袭击。”

paras.en: The latest strikes come as Palestinians contend with heavy rains and desperate conditions in the enclave as the colder months set in, prompting a fresh wave of outcry over the lack of progress in advancing the peace deal between Israel and Hamas.
paras.zh: 最近的袭击发生之际，随着寒冷的月份到来，巴勒斯坦人在飞地内面临大雨和严峻的条件，引发了新一波对以色列和哈马斯之间和平协议进展缺乏进展的强烈抗议。

articles.title: Ukraine faces new Starshield disruptions as Trump envoys meet with Putin
articles.author: Henry Austin

paras.en: Hours after an American delegation touched down in Moscow for peace talks, Ukraine’s President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said his country’s military had experienced a renewed wave of “significant disruptions” to the Starshield satellite internet service, hampering its ability to defend itself against Russia.
paras.zh: 在美国代表团抵达莫斯科进行和平谈判几小时后，乌克兰总统泽伦斯基表示，乌克兰军队的星盾卫星互联网服务遭遇了新一波“严重中断”，削弱了其抵御俄罗斯的能力。

paras.en: “These are not random errors but systematic speed restrictions,” he said in a Telegram post. “For us, this primarily means a significant complication in intercepting Russian jet-powered drones.”
paras.zh: “这些不是随机错误，而是系统性的速度限制，”他在 Telegram 帖子中表示。 “对我们来说，这主要意味着拦截俄罗斯喷气式无人机的过程会变得非常复杂。”

paras.en: His comments came as U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, President Donald Trump’s son-in-law, arrived in the Russian capital for peace talks with President Vladimir Putin, a day after trilateral talks aimed at ending the war were held in the United Arab Emirates.
paras.zh: 他发表上述言论之际，美国特使史蒂夫·威特科夫和唐纳德·特朗普总统的女婿贾里德·库什纳抵达俄罗斯首都与总统弗拉基米尔·普京进行和平谈判，一天前，旨在结束战争的三方会谈在阿拉伯联合酋长国举行。

paras.en: The two-day Abu Dhabi summit, the first such meeting since February, ended with no major breakthrough, although representatives of Russia and Ukraine agreed on a large exchange of prisoners of war.
paras.zh: 为期两天的阿布扎比​​峰会是自二月份以来的首次此类会议，尽管俄罗斯和乌克兰代表同意大规模交换战俘，但峰会没有取得重大突破。

paras.en: In Moscow, Kushner told Putin that Europe wanted a role in future negotiations, according to Russia’s Tass state news agency.
paras.zh: 据俄罗斯塔斯社报道，库什纳在莫斯科告诉普京，欧洲希望在未来的谈判中发挥作用。

paras.en: European countries cut communications with the Kremlin and refused to engage with Russia directly after Putin launched his invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, but have since expressed concern about the Trump administration’s softening stance toward the Kremlin. Kushner last week said he also wanted to address “long-term European security and stability,” signaling a focus beyond just Ukraine that prompted a firm response from European leaders.
paras.zh: 普京于 2022 年 2 月入侵乌克兰后，欧洲国家切断了与克里姆林宫的沟通，并拒绝直接与俄罗斯接触，但此后对特朗普政府对克里姆林宫的软化立场表示担忧。库什纳上周表示，他还希望解决“欧洲的长期安全与稳定”问题，这表明他的关注点不仅仅限于乌克兰，这促使欧洲领导人做出了坚定的回应。

paras.en: Expanding on that theme on Thursday, Kushner said there was a “very strong momentum and desire” from European leaders to “engage together,” adding that “understanding the long-term security between Russia, Ukraine, and Europe is a conversation that we started having with them.”
paras.zh: 库什纳周四进一步阐述了这一主题，表示欧洲领导人有“非常强烈的动力和愿望”“共同参与”，并补充说“了解俄罗斯、乌克兰和欧洲之间的长期安全是我们开始与他们进行的对话。”

paras.en: While representatives from several European countries were in Abu Dhabi, they did not play a direct role in the talks. Russian negotiators have previously opposed their involvement, citing Europe’s support for Kyiv as an obstacle.
paras.zh: 虽然几个欧洲国家的代表在阿布扎比，但他们没有在谈判中发挥直接作用。俄罗斯谈判代表此前曾反对他们的参与，称欧洲对基辅的支持是一个障碍。

paras.en: At the meeting in Moscow, the Interfax news agency reported that Putin proposed a joint Russian-Ukrainian humanitarian mission to the city of Kostiantynivka in eastern Ukraine, similar to the Melania Trump-brokered mission in Oleshky which allowed residents to leave the Russian-controlled town.
paras.zh: 据国际文传电讯社报道，在莫斯科的会议上，普京提议向乌克兰东部的科斯蒂安蒂尼夫卡市派遣俄罗斯和乌克兰联合人道主义特派团，类似于梅拉尼娅·特朗普斡旋的奥列什基特派团，该特派团允许居民离开俄罗斯控制的城镇。

paras.en: Meanwhile in Ukraine, Zelenskyy said military units had for several days reported speed restrictions affecting the entire front line and Russian-occupied parts of the country.
paras.zh: 与此同时，在乌克兰，泽连斯基表示，军事单位连续几天报告称，该国整个前线和俄罗斯占领地区都受到限速。

paras.en: A limit of 100 mph is once again being “imposed on Starshield,” he said of the military version of SpaceX’s Starlink communications service. The system normally runs at a stable speed exceeding around 250 mph.
paras.zh: 他在谈到 SpaceX 星链通信服务的军用版本时表示，“星盾”再次受到 100 英里每小时的限制。该系统通常以超过 250 英里/小时左右的稳定速度运行。

paras.en: “These are not random errors but systematic speed restrictions,” he said. “For us, this primarily means a significant complication in intercepting Russian jet-powered drones.”
paras.zh: “这些不是随机错误，而是系统性的速度限制，”他说。 “对我们来说，这主要意味着拦截俄罗斯喷气式无人机的过程会变得非常复杂。”

paras.en: “Unfortunately, there have already been strikes that got through because our interception systems cannot reach sufficient speeds and are unable to intercept in time,” he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“不幸的是，由于我们的拦截系统无法达到足够的速度并且无法及时拦截，已经发生了一些袭击。”

paras.en: Zelenskyy, who is set to meet with Kushner and Witkoff in Dublin on Friday, added that Ukraine was trying to clarify the reasons for the restriction with the U.S. side.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基将于周五在都柏林会见库什纳和威特科夫，他补充说，乌克兰正试图向美国方面澄清限制的原因。

paras.en: SpaceX did not immediately respond to a request for comment from NBC News.
paras.zh: SpaceX 没有立即回应 NBC 新闻的置评请求。

paras.en: Craig Albert, the graduate director of national defense Studies at Augusta University, said decreasing Starshield’s speed would slow down how fast Ukraine’s offensive drones travel, “which makes them pretty much target practice for faster interceptor drones by the Russians.”
paras.zh: 奥古斯塔大学国防研究研究生主任克雷格·阿尔伯特表示，降低“星盾”的速度将减慢乌克兰进攻性无人机的飞行速度，“这使得它们几乎成为俄罗斯人更快的拦截无人机的目标练习。”

paras.en: It would also slow down Ukrainian interceptor drones and their missile defense systems, meaning “Russian drones can get through their defenses much quicker.”
paras.zh: 它还会减慢乌克兰拦截无人机及其导弹防御系统的速度，这意味着“俄罗斯无人机可以更快地突破其防御系统。”

paras.en: “The Russians can target more infrastructure, and the Ukrainians just don’t have the speed to counteract,” he said, adding that “for the price, the scale, the scale, the speed, the scalability, and the efficiency,” there were no real options other than Starshield.
paras.zh: “俄罗斯人可以瞄准更多的基础设施，而乌克兰人只是没有足够的速度来应对，”他说，并补充说，“就价格、规模、规模、速度、可扩展性和效率而言”，除了星盾之外，没有其他真正的选择。

paras.en: Ukraine first raised the alarm last month about speed limits being imposed on Starshield, which is crucial to its battlefield operations and air defenses.
paras.zh: 乌克兰上个月首次就星盾号的速度限制发出警报，这对其战场行动和防空至关重要。

paras.en: Starlink owner Elon Musk initially put the responsibility for the restrictions on President Donald Trump, who has been trying to pressure Kyiv to make concessions to end the war. The U.S. government said that any such decision could only have been taken by Musk.
paras.zh: 星链所有者埃隆·马斯克最初将这些限制的责任归咎于唐纳德·特朗普总统，后者一直试图向基辅施压，要求其做出让步以结束战争。美国政府表示，任何此类决定只能由马斯克做出。

paras.en: Moscow has so far resisted such efforts to bring Europe to the main negotiating table, something Ukraine has long sought.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，莫斯科一直拒绝将欧洲带入主谈判桌，而这正是乌克兰长期以来所寻求的。

paras.en: The talks came against the backdrop of continued fighting on the front lines, where neither side has achieved significant progress for months.
paras.zh: 这次会谈是在前线持续战斗的背景下进行的，几个月来双方都没有取得重大进展。

paras.en: Instead, the focus has shifted to daily attacks with long-range missiles and drones. Russia has targeted Ukrainian cities, aiming to cut off water and power supplies as winter sets in. Kyiv has resumed attacks on energy infrastructure, a campaign that drew Trump’s ire.
paras.zh: 相反，焦点已转向远程导弹和无人机的日常攻击。俄罗斯以乌克兰城市为目标，旨在在冬季到来时切断水和电力供应。基辅恢复了对能源基础设施的攻击，这一行动引起了特朗普的愤怒。

paras.en: Ukrainian officials said Thursday that five civilians had been killed by Russian strikes on the country overnight, and 29 people injured. The Russian Defense Ministry said it had shot down 71 drones.
paras.zh: 乌克兰官员周四表示，俄罗斯夜间对乌克兰发动的袭击已造成 5 名平民死亡，29 人受伤。俄罗斯国防部称已击落71架无人机。

articles.title: Megaspeed, chip firm at center of Nvidia scandal, pledges to cooperate with U.S. investigation
articles.author: Mithil Aggarwal

paras.en: HONG KONG — Megaspeed, the tech company at the center of the Chinese spy scandal that engulfed Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, said Thursday it will cooperate with the U.S. government’s investigations into the matter.
paras.zh: 香港——英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 陷入中国间谍丑闻的核心科技公司 Megaspeed 周四表示，将配合美国政府对此事的调查。

paras.en: Megaspeed’s statement came hours before the resignation of Huang, one of the leaders of the AI boom, who co-founded the American chipmaker and helped build it into the world’s second most valuable company.
paras.zh: Megaspeed 的声明是在黄仁勋辞职前几个小时发表的。黄仁勋是人工智能热潮的领导者之一，他是这家美国芯片制造商的联合创始人，并帮助其成为全球第二大最有价值的公司。

paras.en: In its first statement since reports emerged about Huang’s extramarital affair with an alleged Chinese spy, raising concerns about U.S. national security and the future of the tech giant, Megaspeed said that it takes its obligation to comply with U.S. export control laws “extremely seriously.”
paras.zh: 自有关黄与一名涉嫌中国间谍的婚外情的报道曝光以来，Megaspeed 首次发表声明，引发了人们对美国国家安全和这家科技巨头未来的担忧。Megaspeed 表示，公司“极其严肃”地履行遵守美国出口管制法的义务。

paras.en: U.S. intelligence agencies determined that Alice Huang had an affair with the Nvidia CEO and was a Chinese intelligence operative, a person with knowledge of the matter told NBC News on Sunday.
paras.zh: 一位知情人士周日告诉 NBC 新闻，美国情报机构确定爱丽丝·黄与英伟达首席执行官有染，并且是一名中国情报人员。

paras.en: She held a senior position at Megaspeed, a Singapore-based company that was one of Nvidia’s biggest customers in Southeast Asia. Megaspeed is under U.S. criminal investigation for allegedly smuggling American-made chips into China in defiance of U.S. export controls.
paras.zh: 她曾在新加坡公司 Megaspeed 担任高级职位，该公司是 Nvidia 在东南亚最大的客户之一。 Megaspeed 因涉嫌违反美国出口管制，将美国制造的芯片走私到中国而受到美国刑事调查。

paras.en: A criminal investigation is ongoing in Singapore, where officials said Thursday Alice Huang had been barred from re-entering the country. The government also issued her with a stern warning after finding that she had knowingly provided police with inaccurate information to downplay her role in the company. It said that Huang was not investigated for espionage.
paras.zh: 新加坡正在进行一项刑事调查，官员周四表示，爱丽丝·黄已被禁止再次入境该国。在发现她故意向警方提供不准确信息以淡化她在公司中的角色后，政府还向她发出了严厉警告。据称，黄没有因间谍罪受到调查。

paras.en: The country’s Ministry of Home Affairs said in a statement that authorities had interviewed Huang and impounded her passport in 2025, but that its requests for cooperation from U.S. authorities had gone unanswered.
paras.zh: 该国内政部在一份声明中表示，当局已约谈了黄女士，并于 2025 年扣押了她的护照，但其向美国当局提出的合作请求却没有得到答复。

paras.en: “Despite these repeated requests, Singapore has to date received limited information or assistance in respect of the company,” it said.
paras.zh: “尽管一再提出要求，新加坡迄今为止收到的有关该公司的信息或援助有限，”它说。

paras.en: Investigators concluded in February that there was “insufficient evidence to establish that Huang had committed any offences,” the statement said, adding that investigations into Megaspeed and six other individuals were continuing, related to the shipment of servers via Singapore.
paras.zh: 声明称，调查人员在 2 月份得出结论，“没有足够的证据证明黄犯有任何罪行”，并补充说，对 Megaspeed 和其他六人的调查仍在继续，涉及通过新加坡运输服务器的问题。

paras.en: Megaspeed, meanwhile, said in the statement Thursday that it has “cooperated with inspections by the U.S. Department of Commerce’s Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) and stands ready to cooperate fully with any other relevant U.S. government authority.” The statement was signed by its chairman and CEO, Tan Yong Pong, who also goes by James Tan.
paras.zh: 与此同时，Megaspeed 在周四的声明中表示，它“已配合美国商务部工业与安全局 (BIS) 的检查，并准备与任何其他相关美国政府机构充分合作。”该声明由其董事长兼首席执行官陈永邦（又名詹姆斯·陈）签署。

paras.en: It said that “Megaspeed is committed to working constructively and transparently with the U.S. government.”
paras.zh: 声明称，“Megaspeed 致力于与美国政府进行建设性且透明的合作。”

paras.en: China has dismissed the spying allegations as “smears.” On Thursday, a Foreign Ministry spokesperson said that “the U.S. side should stop fabricating so-called espionage narratives as a pretext for implementing technological blockades.”
paras.zh: 中国驳斥了这些间谍指控，称其为“诽谤”。周四，外交部发言人表示，“美方应停止编造所谓间谍言论，以此作为实施技术封锁的借口。”

paras.en: Megaspeed did not address the allegations surrounding Alice Huang, but said that “to further reinforce our commitment to compliance, Megaspeed has retained a leading U.S. law firm to lead a comprehensive census of its graphics processing units (GPUs) and independently verify its export control compliance practices.”
paras.zh: Megaspeed 没有回应围绕 Alice Huang 的指控，但表示“为了进一步加强我们对合规的承诺，Megaspeed 聘请了一家领先的美国律师事务所来牵头对其图形处理单元 (GPU) 进行全面普查，并独立验证其出口管制合规做法。”

paras.en: The company added that it “welcomes appropriate government scrutiny and is committed to demonstrating through concrete actions that it operates responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable U.S. laws.”
paras.zh: 该公司补充说，它“欢迎政府适当的审查，并致力于通过具体行动证明其运营负责任、透明且符合适用的美国法律。”

paras.en: Nvidia’s stock price has plunged since its 63-year-old chief admitted over the weekend to being “unfaithful” to his wife.
paras.zh: 自从 Nvidia 63 岁的首席执行官周末承认对妻子“不忠”以来，该公司的股价已经暴跌。

paras.en: Huang quit on Thursday in the wake of reports that he had multiple extramarital relationships. In a statement, Nvidia named its executive vice president and chief financial officer Colette Kress as its interim CEO.
paras.zh: 在有报道称他有多次婚外情后，黄于周四辞职。英伟达在一份声明中任命其执行副总裁兼首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯(Colette Kress)为临时首席执行官。

paras.en: Nvidia’s board met Wednesday night to address Huang’s future at the company, a source familiar with the matter told NBC News, adding that the White House was aware of the meeting.
paras.zh: 一位知情人士告诉 NBC 新闻，英伟达董事会于周三晚间召开会议，讨论黄仁勋在公司的未来，并补充说白宫已知晓此次会议。

paras.en: The scandal has raised questions about how much U.S. government officials knew about Alice Huang and Megaspeed.
paras.zh: 该丑闻引发了人们对美国政府官员对 Alice Huang 和 Megaspeed 的了解程度的质疑。

paras.en: In the spring, Secretary of State Marco Rubio circulated a memo to officials in the Trump administration outlining how U.S. intelligence showed that the Nvidia CEO was in a romantic relationship with a business executive who was an asset of China’s spy service, according to a person familiar with Nvidia and a former national security official with knowledge of the matter. The New York Times and the Financial Times first reported on this memo.
paras.zh: 据一位熟悉英伟达的人士和一位知情的前国家安全官员透露，今年春天，国务卿马可·鲁比奥向特朗普政府官员分发了一份备忘录，概述了美国情报机构如何显示英伟达首席执行官与一名属于中国间谍机构的企业高管之间的恋爱关系。 《纽约时报》和《金融时报》首先报道了这份备忘录。

paras.en: Alice Huang’s precise role and relationship with China’s spy service remain unclear, however. It’s possible she was not a career spy for China’s spy agency, the Ministry of State Security, but was asked to cooperate and share information based on her access to Huang, a former national security official with knowledge of the matter told NBC News.
paras.zh: 然而，黄爱丽的确切角色以及与中国间谍部门的关系仍不清楚。一位知情的前国家安全官员告诉 NBC 新闻，她可能不是中国间谍机构国家安全部的职业间谍，但由于她与黄的接触，被要求合作并分享信息。

paras.en: Rep. Jim Himes, D-Conn., ranking Democrat on the House Intelligence Committee, told NPR that Alice Huang’s role still needed to be clarified.
paras.zh: 众议院情报委员会资深民主党人、康涅狄格州众议员吉姆·海姆斯 (Jim Himes) 告诉 NPR，爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 的角色仍需要澄清。

paras.en: Democrats will soon hold control of both the House and the Senate and, as a result, will have subpoena power.
paras.zh: 民主党很快将控制众议院和参议院，因此将拥有传票权。

paras.en: On Wednesday night, as the Nvidia board met, Sens. Elizabeth Warren, D-Mass., and Chris Coons, D-Del., announced they had written to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick with a request to preserve records on the subject.
paras.zh: 周三晚上，在英伟达董事会召开会议时，马萨诸塞州民主党参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦 (Elizabeth Warren) 和特拉华州民主党参议员克里斯·库恩斯 (Chris Coons) 宣布，他们已致函商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克 (Howard Lutnick)，请求保存有关该主题的记录。

articles.title: Live: Home affairs minister considers backdown on backpacker visa policy
articles.author: Joshua Boscaini

paras.en: Federal politics live: Home affairs minister considers backdown on backpacker visa policy
paras.zh: 联邦政治直播：内政部长考虑放弃背包客签证政策

paras.en: Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke is considering changing the government's backpacker visa policy, which was announced two months ago at the National Press Club.
paras.zh: 内政部长托尼·伯克正在考虑改变政府的背包客签证政策，该政策是两个月前在国家新闻俱乐部宣布的。

paras.en: Follow all the updates in our live blog.
paras.zh: 关注我们实时博客中的所有更新。

paras.en: Choose what information you see below by using filters
paras.zh: 使用过滤器选择您在下面看到的信息

paras.en: National criminal history tracker to enter next phase of rollout
paras.zh: 国家犯罪历史追踪器将进入下一阶段的推出

paras.en: The federal government's long-awaited national criminal history tracker is set to enter the next stage of its rollout.
paras.zh: 联邦政府期待已久的国家犯罪历史追踪系统将进入下一阶段的部署。

paras.en: Once fully operational, the National Continuous Checking Capability (NCCC) will provide near-real time monitoring of national changes to criminal history information on Working with Children Check (WWCC) holders.
paras.zh: 一旦全面投入使用，国家连续检查能力（NCCC）将近乎实时地监控全国儿童工作检查（WWCC）持有者犯罪历史信息的变化。

paras.en: The pilot currently has access to information about Commonwealth and ACT offences and from Monday South Australia's Department of Human Services will connect.
paras.zh: 该试点目前可以获取有关联邦和首都地区犯罪行为的信息，从周一开始，南澳大利亚州公共服务部将进行连接。

paras.en: As previously reported by friend of the blog Claudia Long, the system was called for more than a decade ago in the royal commission into child sexual abuse.
paras.zh: 正如博客的朋友克劳迪娅·朗（Claudia Long）之前报道的那样，十多年前，针对儿童性虐待问题的皇家委员会就调用了该系统。

paras.en: The government has committed $37 million to the NCCC and says the focus will now turn to bringing remaining state and territory agencies on board as soon as possible, with police forces expected to join next year.
paras.zh: 政府已向 NCCC 投入 3700 万美元，并表示现在的重点将转向尽快让剩余的州和领地机构加入，预计警察部队将于明年加入。

paras.en: Home affairs minister considers backpacker backdown
paras.zh: 内政部长考虑让背包客退缩

paras.en: The federal government is considering a backdown on its backpacker visa policy, two months after immigration minister Tony Burke announced sweeping cuts at the National Press Club.
paras.zh: 移民部长托尼·伯克在国家新闻俱乐部宣布大幅削减两个月后，联邦政府正在考虑取消背包客签证政策。

paras.en: As part of its plan to reduce net migration to 225,000 people by 2028, Labor said it would impose a ballot system, cap second-year visa places at 45,000 (down from 57,000 this year) and cap third-year places at 5,000 (down from 31,000 this year).
paras.zh: 作为到 2028 年将净移民人数减少到 225,000 人的计划的一部分，工党表示将实施投票制度，将第二年签证名额上限为 45,000 个（低于今年的 57,000 个），将第三年签证名额上限为 5,000 个（低于今年的 31,000 个）。

paras.en: However, Burke says the government is considering changes to its policy after outcry from the hospitality and agriculture sectors.
paras.zh: 然而，伯克表示，在受到酒店业和农业部门的强烈抗议后，政府正在考虑改变其政策。

paras.en: "The parameters were clear — the total numbers, which I had announced in the Press Club speech, were something that I could not compromise on," Burke says.
paras.zh: “参数很明确——我在新闻俱乐部演讲中宣布的总数是我不能妥协的，”伯克说。

paras.en: "But if we could find a better way of getting a similar immigration outcome with a better outcome for industry, then I wanted us to work to that.
paras.zh: “但是，如果我们能够找到一种更好的方法来获得类似的移民结果，同时为工业带来更好的结果，那么我希望我们为此努力。

paras.en: Similarly, the prime minister last week sought to reinstate regional work obligations on British backpackers after ruling out such a move, after "representations" from industry and WA Premier Roger Cook.
paras.zh: 同样，在业界和西澳州长罗杰·库克的“陈述”后，总理上周排除了这一举措，试图恢复英国背包客的区域工作义务。

paras.en: The Australian is reporting the latest changes could include delaying the backpacker ballot until next year and increasing third-year visas to 25,000.
paras.zh: 《澳大利亚人报》报道称，最新的变化可能包括将背包客投票推迟到明年，并将第三年签证数量增加到 25,000 个。

paras.en: Hello and welcome to our federal politics live blog! It's great to have you here for another day of federal politics news.
paras.zh: 您好，欢迎来到我们的联邦政治实时博客！很高兴您又来到这里聆听联邦政治新闻。

paras.en: I'm Josh Boscaini, joining you live from Parliament House in Canberra, here and ready to bring you all of today's federal politics news.
paras.zh: 我是乔什·博斯卡尼 (Josh Boscaini)，将从堪培拉议会大厦现场直播，准备为您带来今天所有的联邦政治新闻。

paras.en: The home affairs minister is considering backing down on changes to backpacker visas just months after announcing them at the National Press Club.
paras.zh: 在国家新闻俱乐部宣布背包客签证变更几个月后，内政部长正在考虑放弃这一变更。

paras.en: And my colleague Clare Armstrong will have all the latest from the COP31 summit in Türkiye throughout the morning.
paras.zh: 我的同事克莱尔·阿姆斯特朗 (Clare Armstrong) 整个上午都会了解土耳其 COP31 峰会的所有最新消息。

paras.en: It's nearly the end of the working week, so let's get right into the day's news and see what it brings us!
paras.zh: 一周的工作即将结束，让我们直接关注当天的新闻，看看它给我们带来了什么！

articles.title: SA gives green light for gas to help power future data centres
articles.author: James Wakelin

paras.en: South Australia's energy minister says he is "absolutely fine" for gas-generated power to be used to help supply energy to proposed AI data centres across the state.
