The letter concludes by saying that "the administration will not be extorted and will not be cowed by unlawful process, motivated by animus, pettiness, hatred or any other unlawful motive to intimidate, penalize or interfere with the lawful functioning of government." Garcia said Democrats will not be deterred by threats from the Department of Justice or Trump's lawyers.
paras.zh: 白宫警告民主党人，他们计划对政府官员进行的调查可能会跨越“公然犯罪”的界限。白宫法律顾问威尔·沙夫在给明年将领导众议院监督委员会的众议员罗伯特·加西亚的一封信中表示，政府正在监视来自民主党的“滥用和反复无常的威胁”。信中最后表示，“政府不会因敌意、狭隘、仇恨或任何其他非法动机而受到勒索，也不会被非法程序吓倒，从而恐吓、惩罚或干扰政府的合法运作。”加西亚表示，民主党不会被司法部或特朗普律师的威胁吓倒。

paras.en: - 🎧 The administration's arguments may buy time and push Democrats to go to court to enforce their subpoenas, NPR's Tamara Keith says. She adds that the White House letter gives a preview of the legal arguments the administration might use next year. But more importantly, Keith says that it signals that the White House and Justice Department won't accept congressional investigations and oversight without a fight.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的塔玛拉·基思 (Tamara Keith) 表示，政府的论点可能会赢得时间，并促使民主党人上法庭执行传票。她补充说，白宫的信函预览了政府明年可能使用的法律论据。但更重要的是，基思表示，这表明白宫和司法部不会不战而屈人之兵地接受国会的调查和监督。

paras.en: Russia and Ukraine have agreed to a significant prisoner swap after two days of U.S.-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi. Trump's envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff are now in Moscow today to meet with Russian President Vladimir Putin and attempt to make more headway to end the war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 在美国斡旋的阿布扎比​​举行两天会谈后，俄罗斯和乌克兰同意进行重大囚犯交换。特朗普的特使贾里德·库什纳和史蒂夫·威特科夫今天在莫斯科会见俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京，并试图在结束乌克兰战争方面取得更多进展。

paras.en: - 🎧 NPR's Charles Maynes says that, going into the talks in Abu Dhabi, U.S. officials were exploring Article 5-like guarantees for Ukraine, similar to NATO's collective security defense. A move like this would be significant if implemented, but Moscow has already rejected the concept of a "NATO lite" status for Ukraine and its full NATO membership. Kushner said that, in Moscow, he aims to brief Putin directly and persuade him to involve Europeans in discussions about European security. European leaders, concerned about potential deals made without their input, are expected to join Kushner and Witkoff after these talks, when they'll meet with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Ireland.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的查尔斯·梅恩斯 (Charles Maynes) 表示，在阿布扎比举行会谈时，美国官员正在探索对乌克兰提供类似第 5 条的保障，类似于北约的集体安全防御。如果实施的话，这样的举措将意义重大，但莫斯科已经拒绝了乌克兰及其正式北约成员的“北约精简”地位的概念。库什纳表示，他在莫斯科的目标是直接向普京通报情况，并说服他让欧洲人参与有关欧洲安全的讨论。欧洲领导人担心在没有他们参与的情况下达成的潜在协议，预计将在这些会谈后加入库什纳和维特科夫的行列，届时他们将在爱尔兰会见乌克兰总统泽连斯基。

paras.en: Abdul El-Sayed has made history as the first Muslim elected to the U.S. Senate. The 42-year-old progressive from Michigan is already calling for a new direction for his party and urging President Trump to collaborate on actionable solutions. El-Sayed said that voters have temporarily entrusted Democrats with power, but warns that they risk losing that trust if they don't act boldly. As the senator-elect comes into the new role, he is advocating for new Democratic leadership in Congress, an end to the war in Iran, the passage of "Medicare for All" and the abolishment of ICE. While he acknowledges the challenge Senate Democrats face with a majority that's a few seats shy of being filibuster-proof, he remains open to working with his new Republican colleagues. In conversation with Morning Edition's Leila Fadel, El-Sayed reflects on the recent elections, the future of the Democratic Party and the need for impactful legislation in the upcoming years.
paras.zh: 阿卜杜勒·赛义德创造了历史，成为第一位当选美国参议院的穆斯林。这位来自密歇根州的 42 岁进步人士已经在呼吁为他的政党制定新的方向，并敦促特朗普总统合作制定可行的解决方案。埃尔-赛义德表示，选民暂时将权力托付给民主党，但他警告说，如果他们不大胆采取行动，他们就有可能失去这种信任。随着这位当选参议员就任新角色，他主张在国会建立新的民主党领导层、结束伊朗战争、通过“全民医疗保险”以及废除 ICE。虽然他承认参议院民主党面临着多数席位的挑战，距离阻止阻挠议案还差几个席位，但他仍然愿意与他的新共和党同事合作。在与早间版的莱拉·法德尔的对话中，埃尔赛义德反思了最近的选举、民主党的未来以及未来几年制定有影响力的立法的必要性。

paras.en: Watch or listen to the interview or read the article about their discussion.
paras.zh: 观看或收听采访或阅读有关他们讨论的文章。

paras.en: The average price for a new vehicle in the U.S. has hit a record high of $51,109, according to Kelley Blue Book. This figure is about $500 above the previous record set in December 2025. For years, car prices have remained high, primarily due to supply chain issues stemming from the pandemic. But there's some good news: While that new high sets a record, it only represents a 2.1% increase over the past year. This means the price is rising more slowly. If you're in the market for a car, here's what to know:
paras.zh: 根据凯利蓝皮书 (Kelley Blue Book) 的数据，美国新车的平均价格已创下 51,109 美元的历史新高。这一数字比 2025 年 12 月创下的纪录高出约 500 美元。多年来，汽车价格一直居高不下，主要是由于疫情引发的供应链问题。但有一些好消息：虽然这一新高创下了纪录，但仅代表过去一年的 2.1% 增长。这意味着价格上涨速度更加缓慢。如果您正在市场上买车，请了解以下信息：

paras.en: - 🚗 Used cars are also more expensive. The average used car now costs close to $27,00, 6% higher than last year, according to Cox Automotive.
paras.zh: - 🚗 二手车也更贵。据 Cox Automotive 称，现在二手车的平均价格接近 27 美元，比去年上涨 6%。

paras.en: - 🚗 New vehicles cost more partly because it takes more money for automakers to make them. Tariffs on steel, aluminum and imported goods from Canada affect American automakers, who assemble the vehicles on both sides of the border. Computer chips used in sensors and electronics also cost more, thanks to competing demand from data centers.
paras.zh: - 🚗 新车成本更高，部分原因是汽车制造商制造它们需要更多资金。对钢铁、铝和来自加拿大的进口商品征收关税影响了在边境两侧组装车辆的美国汽车制造商。由于数据中心的竞争需求，传感器和电子产品中使用的计算机芯片的成本也更高。

paras.en: - 🚗 Americans tend to prefer larger vehicles, such as SUVs and trucks, which often come with a higher price tag, according to Kelley Blue Book.
paras.zh: - 🚗 根据凯利蓝皮书，美国人往往更喜欢大型车辆，例如 SUV 和卡车，这些车辆的价格通常较高。

paras.en: - 🚗 Drivers today tend not to want entry-level cars. Instead, they are increasingly drawn to more expensive features, like 360-degree cameras, heated seats and parking assist systems.
paras.zh: - 🚗 如今的驾驶员往往不想要入门级汽车。相反，他们越来越被更昂贵的功能所吸引，例如 360 度摄像头、加热座椅和停车辅助系统。

paras.en: - Actor Stacy Keach has died at the age of 85 after a long battle with a serious heart condition and heart failure. His diverse roles included policemen, cowboys and Shakespearean characters.
paras.zh: - 演员史黛西·基奇 (Stacy Keach) 在与严重的心脏病和心力衰竭进行长期斗争后去世，享年 85 岁。他扮演的角色多种多样，包括警察、牛仔和莎士比亚的角色。

paras.en: - In this week's Far-Flung Postcards, NPR's Ricci Shryock sends greetings from Senegal, where breakdancers practice for their country's historic hosting of the Youth Olympic Games.
paras.zh: - 在本周的远方明信片中，NPR 的 Ricci Shryock 从塞内加尔发来问候，那里的霹雳舞者正在为该国历史性地主办青奥会进行练习。

paras.en: - Russia's top independent newspaper, Novaya Gazeta, is shutting down after more than 30 years due to Kremlin pressure from the Ukraine war and censorship laws.
paras.zh: - 由于乌克兰战争和审查法的克里姆林宫压力，俄罗斯顶级独立报纸《新报》在运营了 30 多年后即将关闭。

articles.title: Indonesia's VP resigns as his eligibility and academic credentials are questioned
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Indonesia's VP resigns as his eligibility and academic credentials are questioned
paras.zh: 印度尼西亚副总统因资格和学历受到质疑而辞职

paras.en: JAKARTA, Indonesia — Indonesia's vice president resigned on Thursday as questions grew over his eligibility for the office after recent court rulings disputed his educational credentials.
paras.zh: 印度尼西亚雅加达——印度尼西亚副总统周四辞职，因为最近法院的裁决对他的教育资格提出了质疑，他担任该职位的资格受到越来越多的质疑。

paras.en: Gibran Rakabuming Raka, the 39-year-old son of former President Joko Widodo, submitted his resignation to the leadership of the People's Consultative Assembly, the country's highest legislative body, at the parliament building in the capital, Jakarta.
paras.zh: 前总统佐科·维多多39岁的儿子吉布兰·拉卡布明·拉卡在首都雅加达议会大厦向该国最高立法机构人民协商会议领导层提交了辞呈。

paras.en: Raka didn't comment as he left the meeting.
paras.zh: 拉卡离开会议时没有发表评论。

paras.en: "There will always be political dynamics in public office, that's normal," his father, Widodo, told reporters from his hometown in Solo, adding that he had reminded his son that political positions are temporary.
paras.zh: 他的父亲维多多在家乡梭罗对记者说：“公职中总会有政治动态，这很正常。”他补充说，他曾提醒儿子，政治职位是暂时的。

paras.en: "We will continue to support President Prabowo's government, especially programs that serve the interests of the broader public," he said, referring to Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们将继续支持普拉博沃总统的政府，特别是为更广泛公众利益服务的计划。”他指的是印度尼西亚总统普拉博沃·苏比安托。

paras.en: The academic credentials investigation was apparently not related to investigations into allegations that top police officials had been involved in wiretapping targeting the president.
paras.zh: 学历调查显然与对高级警察官员参与针对总统的窃听的指控的调查无关。

paras.en: Raka had offered to resign Tuesday during a meeting with Prabowo, saying he wanted to avoid a prolonged political controversy. He personally delivered his resignation letter to the president on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 拉卡周二在与普拉博沃会面时提出辞职，称他想避免长期的政治争议。周三，他亲自向总统递交了辞职信。

paras.en: Prabowo addressed the nation Thursday afternoon after holding a meeting with Raka and the parliamentary leadership at the presidential palace.
paras.zh: 普拉博沃周四下午在总统府与拉卡和议会领导层举行会议后向全国发表讲话。

paras.en: Flanked by Raka and top leaders of parliament, a grim-looking Prabowo said that he accepted Raka's resignation "with a heavy heart" and praised the vice president for showing "courage, responsibility and statesmanship" by stepping down.
paras.zh: 在拉卡和议会最高领导人的簇拥下，面色严峻的普拉博沃表示，他“心情沉重”地接受了拉卡的辞职，并称赞副总统下台表现出了“勇气、责任感和政治家风度”。

paras.en: "He chose to resign for the greater interest of the nation, the state and the Indonesian people," Prabowo said in a televised statement. "He has been a great help to me, from our election campaign through the past two years of government. Many of our achievements would not have been possible without his contribution."
paras.zh: 普拉博沃在电视声明中表示：“他选择辞职是为了国家、国家和印度尼西亚人民的更大利益。” “从我们的竞选活动到过去两年的执政，他给了我很大的帮助。如果没有他的贡献，我们的许多成就是不可能实现的。”

paras.en: Prabowo praised Raka's dedication and hard work, highlighting Raka's visits to 35 provinces and 149 regencies and cities to inspect 303 government projects during the past two years as examples of his commitment to public service.
paras.zh: 普拉博沃赞扬拉卡的奉献精神和辛勤工作，并强调拉卡在过去两年里访问了35个省份和149个县市，检查了303个政府项目，以此作为致力于公共服务的例证。

paras.en: "I will continue to support him, and I pray that he and his family are given strength during what is undoubtedly a difficult time," Prabowo said.
paras.zh: 普拉博沃说：“我将继续支持他，我祈祷他和他的家人在这无疑是困难的时期得到力量。”

paras.en: Under the Indonesian Constitution, a vice presidential vacancy doesn't trigger a new election. The office remains vacant until the People's Consultative Assembly elects a replacement from two candidates nominated by the president within 60 days.
paras.zh: 根据印度尼西亚宪法，副总统空缺不会引发新的选举。该职位将一直空缺，直至人民协商会议在 60 天内从总统提名的两名候选人中选出替代者。

paras.en: Long-running allegations over candidacy lead to court disputes
paras.zh: 关于候选人资格的长期指控导致法庭纠纷

paras.en: The Constitutional Court and the Supreme Court ruled last month that the documents that Raka submitted regarding his overseas education didn't meet election requirements.
paras.zh: 宪法法院和最高法院上个月裁定，拉卡提交的有关海外教育的文件不符合选举要求。

paras.en: A subsequent petition, submitted Wednesday to the House leadership by 120 lawmakers from eight political parties, began a parliamentary process that could have led to his impeachment.
paras.zh: 随后，来自 8 个政党的 120 名议员周三向众议院领导层提交了一份请愿书，启动了可能导致他被弹劾的议会程序。

paras.en: The push for his impeachment was driven largely by long-running allegations that Raka's candidacy was enabled by a Constitutional Court ruling that critics see as a conflict of interest and evidence of weak political accountability and dynastic privilege.
paras.zh: 推动弹劾他的主要原因是长期存在的指控，即拉卡的候选资格是由宪法法院的裁决促成的，批评者认为这是利益冲突，也是政治责任和王朝特权薄弱的证据。

paras.en: Before Prabowo chose him as his running mate for the 2024 election, Raka didn't meet the age requirement of 40 for vice presidential candidates. But the court's contentious ruling in October 2023 carved an exception allowing those who served or had been elected as regional leaders to run at a younger age.
paras.zh: 在普拉博沃选择他作为2024年选举的竞选伙伴之前，拉卡没有达到副总统候选人40岁的年龄要求。但法院在 2023 年 10 月做出的​​颇具争议的裁决规定了一个例外，允许那些曾担任或曾当选地区领导人的人在更年轻的年龄参选。

paras.en: Under Indonesian election law, a presidential or vice-presidential candidate must have completed senior high school or an equivalent level of education. Because Raka completed his secondary education overseas, he was required to provide documents showing that his qualifications were equivalent to an Indonesian high school diploma.
paras.zh: 根据印度尼西亚选举法，总统或副总统候选人必须完成高中或同等程度的教育。由于拉卡在海外完成了中学教育，因此他需要提供文件证明其学历相当于印尼高中文凭。

paras.en: Raka was the first vice president of the country to resign before the end of a term since the fall of dictator Suharto and the start of Indonesia's democratic reforms in 1998.
paras.zh: 拉卡是自1998年独裁者苏哈托倒台和印度尼西亚开始民主改革以来第一位在任期结束前辞职的副总统。

paras.en: Parliamentary leaders were due to convene immediately to begin the process of selecting a replacement, Speaker Ahmad Muzani said.
paras.zh: 议长艾哈迈德·穆扎尼表示，议会领导人将立即召开会议，开始选择继任者的程序。

paras.en: "We ask for the prayers and support of all Indonesians so that this democratic process can proceed smoothly and serve as a constructive new precedent in our constitutional system," Muzani told reporters.
paras.zh: 穆扎尼对记者说：“我们请求所有印度尼西亚人的祈祷和支持，以便这一民主进程能够顺利进行，并成为我们宪法制度的建设性新先例。”

articles.title: U.S. envoys meet with Putin in the Kremlin after Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: U.S. envoys meet with Putin in the Kremlin after Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi
paras.zh: 乌克兰在阿布扎比举行会谈后，美国特使在克里姆林宫会见普京

paras.en: MOSCOW — U.S. President Donald Trump's envoys met Thursday with President Vladimir Putin as Washington sought new momentum in peace efforts after two days of U.S.-mediated negotiations between Russian and Ukrainian delegations.
paras.zh: 莫斯科——美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的特使周四会见了弗拉基米尔·普京总统，在美国斡旋的俄罗斯和乌克兰代表团进行了两天的谈判之后，华盛顿寻求和平努力的新动力。

paras.en: Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, who is also Trump's son-in-law, brokered the talks in Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates. Those were the first direct discussions between representatives of Moscow and Kyiv in nine months as the push for peace stalled.
paras.zh: 史蒂夫·威特科夫（Steve Witkoff）和特朗普女婿贾里德·库什纳（Jared Kushner）促成了在阿拉伯联合酋长国首都阿布扎比举行的会谈。这是莫斯科和基辅代表九个月来在和平进程陷入停滞之际首次进行直接讨论。

paras.en: The two days of talks that ended Wednesday produced no major breakthrough, aside from an agreement to swap a large number of prisoners, with the exact figure still to be announced.
paras.zh: 周三结束的两天谈判除了达成了交换大量囚犯的协议外，没有取得重大突破，具体数字仍有待公布。

paras.en: Kushner and Witkoff went straight to the Kremlin to brief Putin in a meeting that lasted about two hours and are scheduled to fly to Dublin, Ireland, for talks with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy as the conflict stretches toward the five-year mark.
paras.zh: 库什纳和维特科夫直接前往克里姆林宫，在一场持续约两个小时的会议上向普京通报情况，并计划飞往爱尔兰都柏林，与乌克兰总统泽伦斯基进行会谈，因为冲突已接近五年。

paras.en: U.S. envoys want Europe at the negotiating table, too
paras.zh: 美国特使也希望欧洲坐在谈判桌上

paras.en: Kushner said that one of the goals of the meeting with Putin was to get the Russian leader's blessing for European representatives to be part of the talks, which are looking at the continent's broader security arrangements.
paras.zh: 库什纳表示，与普京会晤的目标之一是获得俄罗斯领导人的批准，让欧洲代表参加会谈，会谈正在研究欧洲大陆更广泛的安全安排。

paras.en: The U.S. and Zelenskyy want Europe to appoint a single person to negotiate with Moscow.
paras.zh: 美国和泽伦斯基希望欧洲任命一个人与莫斯科进行谈判。

paras.en: But Moscow doesn't want European countries involved in the direct negotiations, complaining they are financing and supplying Ukraine's military effort. The Europeans are concerned about Russia's conduct and broader intentions on the continent.
paras.zh: 但莫斯科不希望欧洲国家参与直接谈判，抱怨他们正在为乌克兰的军事行动提供资金和供应。欧洲人对俄罗斯在欧洲大陆的行为和更广泛的意图感到担忧。

paras.en: Many in Europe see the inclusion of Moscow in discussions about postwar European security as an unwelcome concession to Putin, who has described NATO's eastward expansion as a main security threat to Russia. Putin has demanded the trans-Atlantic alliance's troops be pulled back from Russia's borders.
paras.zh: 许多欧洲人认为，让莫斯科参与有关战后欧洲安全的讨论是对普京的不受欢迎的让步，普京将北约东扩描述为对俄罗斯的主要安全威胁。普京要求跨大西洋联盟的军队从俄罗斯边境撤出。

paras.en: Some analysts say negotiators may be looking to grant Russia concessions on NATO's strategy in return for peace in Ukraine — a possibility that alarms European leaders.
paras.zh: 一些分析人士表示，谈判代表可能寻求让俄罗斯在北约战略上做出让步，以换取乌克兰的和平——这种可能性令欧洲领导人感到震惊。

paras.en: The Russian and Ukrainian delegations in Abu Dhabi "agreed on many of the principles, but are still apart on some of the way to accomplish" peace, Kushner said in Moscow.
paras.zh: 库什纳在莫斯科表示，俄罗斯和乌克兰代表团在阿布扎比“在许多原则上达成了一致，但在实现和平的一些方式上仍然存在分歧”。

paras.en: Putin reaffirmed to the U.S. envoys that any European troops sent to Ukraine after a ceasefire would be "absolutely unacceptable" and Russia would regard the deployment as a security threat and legitimate targets. "In other words, the war would resume immediately," he said.
paras.zh: 普京向美国特使重申，停火后向乌克兰派遣任何欧洲军队都是“绝对不可接受的”，俄罗斯将把这一部署视为安全威胁和合法目标。 “换句话说，战争将立即恢复，”他说。

paras.en: He also said Russia regards its border with Ukraine to be sealed by a prospective peace deal as now extending to cover the four Ukrainian regions that Moscow annexed in 2022 but never fully controlled.
paras.zh: 他还表示，俄罗斯认为，未来的和平协议将封锁与乌克兰的边界，目前边界已扩大到莫斯科于 2022 年吞并但从未完全控制的四个乌克兰地区。

paras.en: Zelenskyy sees a political "window of opportunity"
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基看到了政治“机会之窗”

paras.en: Zelenskyy is in Dublin for a meeting of more than 40 European countries that also includes NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基正在都柏林参加 40 多个欧洲国家参加的会议，其中包括北约秘书长马克·吕特。

paras.en: Rutte said the U.S., Europe and Ukraine are "very much aligned" on what security guarantees should look like, following a meeting in Paris in January. "But now of course we need the peace deal, or at least a ceasefire," Rutte said.
paras.zh: 吕特表示，一月份在巴黎举行会议后，美国、欧洲和乌克兰就安全保障的内容“非常一致”。 “但现在我们当然需要和平协议，或者至少是停火，”吕特说。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said political changes, including Democrats taking over the U.S. Congress in January following midterm elections and balloting in France next year, could bring "a window of opportunity" for a peace deal.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，政治变化，包括民主党在中期选举后一月接管美国国会以及明年法国投票，可能会带来和平协议的“机会之窗”。

paras.en: "The political landscape in Europe could change in 2027. … We also see changes already taking place in the United States," Zelenskyy said in Dublin late Wednesday.
paras.zh: “欧洲的政治格局可能会在 2027 年发生变化……我们也看到美国已经发生了变化，”泽连斯基周三晚间在都柏林表示。

paras.en: He called the proposed prisoner exchange a positive step but also insisted Ukraine won't surrender Russian-occupied territory in return for peace.
paras.zh: 他称拟议的囚犯交换是积极的一步，但也坚称乌克兰不会放弃俄罗斯占领的领土以换取和平。

paras.en: Russia and Ukraine have occasionally swapped prisoners, but both sides remain far apart in their terms for accepting a settlement.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯和乌克兰偶尔会交换囚犯，但双方在接受和解的条款上仍存在很大分歧。

paras.en: Fighting continues as another bitter winter approaches
paras.zh: 又一个严冬临近，战斗仍在继续

paras.en: Amid the negotiations, fighting continues along the 1,200-kilometer (about 750-mile) front line.
paras.zh: 在谈判期间，战斗沿着 1,200 公里（约 750 英里）的前线仍在继续。

paras.en: Russia's bigger army has been held back by dogged Ukrainian resistance while Moscow's drone and missile strikes on Ukraine's energy facilities disrupted heat, electricity and water supplies to Ukrainian cities, sapping public morale in what Kyiv calls a "weaponization of winter."
paras.zh: 俄罗斯规模更大的军队一直受到乌克兰顽强抵抗的阻碍，而莫斯科对乌克兰能源设施的无人机和导弹袭击扰乱了乌克兰城市的供热、电力和供水，削弱了公众士气，基辅称之为“冬季武器化”。

paras.en: Russia's Defense Ministry said its air defenses downed 71 Ukrainian drones overnight. Its forces struck a drone-manufacturing plant in Kyiv and three other facilities producing missile fuel and drone components in the area around the Ukrainian capital, the ministry said.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯国防部表示，俄罗斯防空系统一夜之间击落了 71 架乌克兰无人机。乌克兰国防部表示，其部队袭击了基辅的一家无人机制造厂以及乌克兰首都周边地区的另外三座生产导弹燃料和无人机零部件的设施。

paras.en: Russia launched missiles and 123 drones, 73 of them jet-powered drones, at Ukraine overnight, the Ukrainian air force said. Hits were recorded at 17 locations, it said.
paras.zh: 乌克兰空军表示，俄罗斯连夜向乌克兰发射了导弹和 123 架无人机，其中 73 架是喷气式无人机。据称，有 17 个地点被击中。

paras.en: U.S. Starlink problems return, Zelenskyy says
paras.zh: 泽连斯基称美国星链问题再次出现

paras.en: Ukraine is experiencing another slowdown in the U.S. Starshield system — SpaceX's military-grade version of the Starlink satellite internet service — that the country needs to defend itself against Russian attacks, Zelenskyy said Thursday on social media.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基周四在社交媒体上表示，乌克兰正在经历美国星盾系统（SpaceX 的星链卫星互联网服务的军用级版本）的又一次放缓，该国需要该系统来防御俄罗斯的攻击。

paras.en: Military units have recorded "significant disruptions," including speed restrictions limiting Ukrainian drones to 161 kph (100 mph), Zelenskyy said, adding that a military investigation established that the restrictions weren't random errors.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，军事单位记录了“严重干扰”，包括将乌克兰无人机的速度限制为 161 公里/小时（100 英里/小时），并补充说，军事调查证实这些限制并非随机错误。

paras.en: Ukraine uses Starlink and Starshield for intercepting Russian drones and launching its own strikes.
paras.zh: 乌克兰使用“星链”和“星盾”拦截俄罗斯无人机并发动自己的袭击。

paras.en: Last month, limits on Ukrainian drone speeds severely disrupted operations and alarmed Kyiv officials who fear U.S. support could drop off.
paras.zh: 上个月，对乌克兰无人机速度的限制严重扰乱了行动，并令基辅官员感到震惊，他们担心美国的支持可能会下降。

paras.en: Elon Musk acknowledged that his company SpaceX had throttled the Starlink internet service in Ukraine for about a week, saying the system couldn't be used for offensive strikes against Russia.
paras.zh: 埃隆·马斯克承认，他的公司 SpaceX 已对乌克兰的 Starlink 互联网服务进行了大约一周的限制，并表示该系统不能用于对俄罗斯进行进攻。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said in Dublin that the speed limits cover operations in Russian-occupied parts of Ukraine and that Kyiv is trying to find out from U.S. officials what is going on. "If someone in America is making decisions that basically treat Ukrainian territory as if it is not Ukrainian, then this tells us where things are going," he said.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基在都柏林表示，速度限制涵盖了俄罗斯占领的乌克兰地区的行动，基辅正在试图从美国官员那里了解发生了什么。 “如果美国某人做出的决定基本上将乌克兰领土视为非乌克兰领土，那么这就会告诉我们事情的发展方向，”他说。

paras.en: Russian colonel reportedly killed by a car bomb
paras.zh: 俄罗斯上校据称被汽车炸弹炸死

paras.en: A Russian serviceman was killed in St. Petersburg early Thursday when his vehicle exploded, according to Russia's Investigative Committee, the country's main criminal investigation agency. It didn't identify the victim or say who was behind the bombing.
paras.zh: 据俄罗斯主要刑事调查机构俄罗斯调查委员会称，周四早些时候，一名俄罗斯军人在圣彼得堡的车辆爆炸中丧生。它没有透露受害者的身份，也没有透露谁是爆炸案的幕后黑手。

paras.en: The Fontanka news outlet said the victim was a colonel and that a bomb in his car exploded as he drove off.
paras.zh: 丰坦卡新闻媒体称，受害者是一名上校，他开车离开时，他车里的一枚炸弹爆炸了。

paras.en: Several senior Russian military officers have been killed by bombings and other attacks that Moscow blames on Ukraine. Kyiv has claimed responsibility for some attacks on Russian soil.
paras.zh: 几名俄罗斯高级军官在爆炸和其他袭击事件中丧生，莫斯科将此事归咎于乌克兰。基辅声称对俄罗斯领土上的一些袭击事件负责。

articles.title: Matt Lambert, DC doctor, identified as gunman in deadly attack after HOA feud

paras.en: The gunman involved in Thursday's deadly gym shooting in Washington, D.C., has been identified by law enforcement sources as Dr. Matt Lambert, who had an apparent dispute with his homeowner's association.
paras.zh: 执法部门消息人士已确认参与周四华盛顿特区致命健身房枪击事件的枪手为马特·兰伯特博士，他与房主协会发生了明显的纠纷。

paras.en: Lambert's identity was confirmed by a pair of law enforcement officials and a source familiar with the matter who spoke to The Associated Press on condition of anonymity.
paras.zh: 两名执法官员和一位不愿透露姓名的知情人士向美联社证实了兰伯特的身份。

paras.en: Authorities said the shooter opened fire around 8 a.m. inside Vida gym in D.C.'s Logan Circle neighborhood. One person was killed, and four others were wounded. The gunman was also killed.
paras.zh: 当局称，枪手于上午 8 点左右在华盛顿特区洛根圆环附近的 Vida 健身房内开枪。一人死亡，四人受伤。枪手也被击毙。

paras.en: According to a report from The Associated Press, the shooter had an ongoing issue with building management at his apartment building and filed a lawsuit against the company last year.
paras.zh: 据美联社报道，枪手的公寓楼管理一直存在问题，并于去年对该公司提起诉讼。

paras.en: LISTEN: DC shooting dispatch audio reveals 30 people sheltered in gym basement as gunfire erupted
paras.zh: 听：华盛顿特区枪击事件调度音频显示，枪声爆发时，30 人躲在健身房地下室里

paras.en: Less than 10 minutes before the first calls about the gunfire came in, according to the AP, Lambert appeared to post on an account on X named "OfMiceandMold" and posted "My manifesto is an engineering report" with screenshots of that report.
paras.zh: 据美联社报道，在接到有关枪击事件的第一通电话前不到 10 分钟，兰伯特似乎在 X 上一个名为“OfMiceandMold”的帐户上发帖，并发布了“我的宣言是一份工程报告”以及该报告的屏幕截图。

paras.en: The photos show the dispute between Lambert and the Metropole Condominium Association with problems like "mold" and "water intrusion" issues.
paras.zh: 照片显示兰伯特与Metropole Condominium Association之间因“霉菌”和“水侵入”等问题而发生的纠纷。

paras.en: The account features numerous posts, photos and videos of alleged issues inside the apartment. In a post from the beginning of October, he called out his HOA for what he said was "months of 'Luigi' tactics" and mentioned submitting "an independent engineering report."
paras.zh: 该帐户包含大量有关公寓内涉嫌问题的帖子、照片和视频。在 10 月初的一篇帖子中，他称自己的 HOA 是“数月的‘路易吉’战术”，并提到提交“一份独立的工程报告”。

paras.en: The shooting is still under investigation.
paras.zh: 枪击事件仍在调查中。

articles.title: UN renews Iran's committee seat amid war with US, sparking backlash: 'Morally bankrupt'

paras.en: The United Nations reconfirmed Iran to its seat on the Committee for Programme and Coordination on Wednesday, sparking outrage from member states who believe the country’s record of aggression should disqualify its representatives from the committee’s work to review human rights, women’s rights and counter-terrorism programs.
paras.zh: 周三，联合国再次确认伊朗在计划和协调委员会的席位，这引发了成员国的愤怒，他们认为伊朗的侵略记录应该取消其代表参与委员会审查人权、妇女权利和反恐计划工作的资格。

paras.en: Ahead of the vote, Hillel Neuer, executive director of UN Watch, a human rights watchdog, said he believes the move gives Iran another tool for the regime’s propaganda machine.
paras.zh: 投票前，人权监督机构联合国观察组织执行主任希勒尔·诺伊尔表示，他认为此举为伊朗政权的宣传机器提供了另一个工具。

paras.en: "They use it," Neuer said. "You'll see a headline in Iranian propaganda right away: ‘Hey, look, we were elected to yet another body.' And it sends a signal… As they're killing their own people, what does the world have to say?"
paras.zh: “他们使用它，”诺伊尔说。 “你马上就会在伊朗宣传中看到一个标题：‘嘿，看，我们当选为另一个机构的成员。’”它发出了一个信号……当他们杀害自己的人民时，世界要说什么？”

paras.en: Neuer believes Iran’s continued spot on the committee gives Tehran a nod of international legitimacy amid its ongoing conflict with the U.S., showcasing the UN’s uneven record for creating a forum to deter international violence.
paras.zh: 诺伊尔认为，伊朗继续在该委员会任职，让德黑兰在与美国持续冲突的情况下获得了国际合法性，展示了联合国在创建一个阻止国际暴力的论坛方面的不平衡记录。

paras.en: "Sometimes [the UN] is effective. Sometimes they’re not. Sometimes, even when they’re effective, they’re effective in a bad way. There’s an effect, but it’s to empower dictatorships," Neuer said.
paras.zh: “有时（联合国）是有效的。有时则不然。有时，即使它们有效，但它们的有效方式却很糟糕。效果是有的，但它会增强独裁政权的力量，”诺伊尔说。

paras.en: "The UN spends a lot of its time attacking democracies like America, like Israel. America gets condemned every year for the embargo in Cuba. Last year, there was one resolution on Iran, one on North Korea, one on Myanmar — and 15 on Israel. And Hamas, Islam and Jihad were never mentioned once. That happens a lot at the UN."
paras.zh: “联合国花了很多时间攻击美国和以色列等民主国家。美国每年都会因对古巴的禁运而受到谴责。去年，有一项关于伊朗的决议，一项关于朝鲜的决议，一项关于缅甸的决议，还有 15 项关于以色列的决议。而哈马斯、伊斯兰教和圣战组织从未被提及。这种情况在联合国经常发生。”

paras.en: Iran was reconfirmed with the support of 144 ballots cast by the UN General Assembly.
paras.zh: 联合国大会以144票的支持再次确认伊朗。

paras.en: The Committee for Programme and Coordination consists of 34 member states, each of which is elected to the body for a three-year term. Although it is not one of the UN’s six main committees, it reviews the organization’s plans and priorities, making recommendations on their design, priorities, coordination and effectiveness.
paras.zh: 计划和协调委员会由 34 个成员国组成，每个成员国均当选为该机构成员，任期三年。尽管它不是联合国六个主要委员会之一，但它审查该组织的计划和优先事项，并就其设计、优先事项、协调和有效性提出建议。

paras.en: Iran’s renewal to the post prompted outcry from lawmakers in the U.S. on Tuesday afternoon.
paras.zh: 周二下午，伊朗续任该职位引发了美国立法者的强烈抗议。

paras.en: "The United Nations elected Iran — the world’s biggest exporter of terrorism — to the committee responsible for establishing priorities on disarmament, counterterrorism and women’s rights," the House Foreign Affairs Committee wrote in a statement posted to X.
paras.zh: 众议院外交事务委员会在发给 X 的一份声明中写道：“联合国选举世界上最大的恐怖主义出口国伊朗为负责确定裁军、反恐和妇女权利优先事项的委员会成员。”

paras.en: "The United Nations is morally bankrupt: no sane person can take it seriously."
paras.zh: “联合国在道德上已经破产：任何理智的人都不会认真对待它。”

paras.en: Similarly, Canadian Foreign Minister Anita Anand issued her own statement condemning the move.
paras.zh: 同样，加拿大外交部长安妮塔·阿南德也发表声明谴责此举。

paras.en: "Canada is steadfastly opposed to giving Iran a seat on the UN Committee for Programme and Coordination — and Canada voted against Iran’s inclusion today at the UN. The committee should be comprised of countries entrusted with shaping the work of the United Nations and must uphold the principles of its Charter. The Iranian regime silences dissent at home and fuels instability across the Middle East. We stand with the people of Iran," Anand said.
paras.zh: 阿南德说：“加拿大坚决反对让伊朗在联合国计划和协调委员会中占有一席之地，加拿大今天投票反对伊朗加入联合国。该委员会应该由负责制定联合国工作的国家组成，并且必须维护其宪章的原则。伊朗政权压制国内异议，加剧中东地区的不稳定。我们与伊朗人民站在一起。”

paras.en: Notably, Australia also joined the opposition, voting alongside Canada against Iran’s confirmation.
paras.zh: 值得注意的是，澳大利亚也加入了反对派行列，与加拿大一起投票反对伊朗的确认。

paras.en: "Australia strongly opposes Iran’s nomination to the UN Committee for Programme and Coordination and voted against. Iran’s human rights violations and destabilizing conduct undermine multilateralism," Foreign Minister Penny Wong wrote.
paras.zh: “澳大利亚强烈反对伊朗被提名为联合国计划和协调委员会成员，并投了反对票。伊朗的侵犯人权和破坏稳定的行为破坏了多边主义，”外交部长黄英贤写道。

paras.en: Neuer, director of UN Watch, believes its not just Western countries that will be watching how the UN treats Iran. He noted that aggressors constantly monitor the international field to get a sense for how it might react in the future.
paras.zh: 联合国观察组织主任诺伊尔认为，关注联合国如何对待伊朗的不仅仅是西方国家。他指出，侵略者不断监视国际领域，以了解其未来可能如何反应。

paras.en: "It's like Putin looks when Obama said we 'have a red line in Syria. Use chemical weapons — red line.' Well, Syria used chemical weapons. And Obama... did nothing. That sent a message. Shortly thereafter, Putin invaded Ukraine. I'm not saying that invasions are gonna happen the next day, but these things send messages, and constantly governments are taking the temperature. What is the pushback?" Neuer said.
paras.zh: “这就像奥巴马说我们‘在叙利亚有一条红线。使用化学武器——红线’时普京的表情。”好吧，叙利亚使用了化学武器。而奥巴马……什么也没做。就这样发来了一条消息。此后不久，普京入侵乌克兰。我并不是说第二天就会发生入侵，但这些事情会发出信息，而且政府会不断地测量温度。有什么阻力？”诺伊尔说道。

paras.en: He also observed that although many in the U.S. view the UN with some skepticism, other countries still use the group as a barometer of international consensus.
paras.zh: 他还指出，尽管美国许多人对联合国持怀疑态度，但其他国家仍然将该组织作为国际共识的晴雨表。

paras.en: "The United Nations is considered for many a repository of international legitimacy; it may not be so in the United States… but in many parts of the world it is regarded as the arbiter of international legitimacy," Neuer said.
paras.zh: “联合国被许多人认为是国际合法性的宝库；在美国可能并非如此……但在世界许多地方，它被视为国际合法性的仲裁者，”诺伊尔说。

paras.en: "What is the signal you're giving to the Ayatollah regime? They murdered tens of thousands of people. They're hanging dissidents. They are torturing women who defend their right not to cover every piece of their hair. They beat political prisoners. What message does the world have to send? Did you give them a pat on the back? Or did you? Did you penalize them?"
paras.zh: “你向阿亚图拉政权发出了什么信号？他们谋杀了数万人。他们绞死异见人士。他们折磨那些捍卫不遮盖自己每一根头发的权利的妇女。他们殴打政治犯。世界要传达什么信息？你有没有拍拍他们的背？或者你有吗？你有惩罚他们吗？”

articles.title: Notre Dame head coach Marcus Freeman explains the meaning of his meme-worthy side-eye

paras.en: It seems like on an almost weekly basis, a new meme is born somewhere in the world of sports, and one of the most recent came to us courtesy of Notre Dame head football coach Marcus Freeman.
paras.zh: 似乎几乎每周都会在体育界的某个地方诞生一个新的模因，而最近的模因之一是由圣母大学橄榄球队主教练马库斯·弗里曼提供的。

paras.en: The moment happened during the Fighting Irish's 31-24 win over the Miami Hurricanes, and it quickly became the internet's favorite meme du jour.
paras.zh: 这一刻发生在爱尔兰战斗队 31-24 战胜迈阿密飓风队的比赛中，它很快成为互联网上最受欢迎的热门话题。

paras.en: Freeman was getting an explanation from officials, and pretty clearly wasn't liking what they were saying.
paras.zh: 弗里曼正在从官员那里得到解释，但很明显他不喜欢他们的说法。

paras.en: I felt that look, and I wasn't even involved.
paras.zh: 我感觉到了那种表情，但我什至没有参与其中。

paras.en: It turns out that Freeman's side-eye is a familiar look to his players, and he discussed it alongside Notre Dame safety Luke Talich on the program's "Wake Up the Echoes."
paras.zh: 事实证明，弗里曼的侧眼对他的球员来说很熟悉，他在节目“唤醒回声”中与圣母大学安全卫卢克·塔里奇一起讨论了这一点。

paras.en: "That's the definition of, 'You're tripping,'" Freeman said when asked about the look. "There's some other descriptions I can give, but I'm not going to say it on here."
paras.zh: “这就是‘你绊倒了’的定义，”当被问及外观时，弗里曼说道。 “我还可以给出一些其他的描述，但我不会在这里说。”

paras.en: I think we can all make some assumptions as to what those might be.
paras.zh: 我想我们都可以对这些可能是什么做出一些假设。

paras.en: Freeman also said that Talich has been on the receiving end of that side-eyed glare.
paras.zh: 弗里曼还表示，塔利奇一直是这种目光的接收端。

paras.en: "It's usually on special teams," Talich admitted.
paras.zh: “通常是在特别小组中，”塔利奇承认。

paras.en: He was then asked what goes through his head when his coach fires off that meme-worthy look, and it turns out, it does a pretty good job of communicating its intent.
paras.zh: 然后有人问他，当他的教练做出那种值得模仿的表情时，他的脑子里在想什么，事实证明，它很好地传达了其意图。

paras.en: "Well, I usually know why I'm getting the side eye," he continued. "So I kind of know what I got to do. But yeah, as you said, I'm tripping."
paras.zh: “嗯，我通常知道为什么我会受到侧视，”他继续说道。 “所以我知道我必须做什么。但是，是的，正如你所说，我被绊倒了。”

paras.en: Well, you probably would be tripping way less frequently if you knew that one slip-up (trip-up?) could mean getting cooked with one of the nastiest side-eyes I've ever seen since I refused to give my French Bulldog a chunk of pizza crust.
paras.zh: 好吧，如果你知道一次失误（绊倒？）可能意味着被我自从拒绝给我的法国斗牛犬一块披萨皮以来见过的最令人讨厌的侧眼之一煮熟，你可能会减少绊倒的次数。

articles.title: Putin takes hard line in US talks as Ukraine says Starlink disrupted again
articles.author: Pjotr Sauer and Jennifer Rankin in Dublin

paras.en: Vladimir Putin warned US negotiators that Russia would target any foreign troops deployed to Ukraine, in a series of hardline remarks that came as the Ukrainian military faced renewed disruptions to Elon Musk’s Starlink satellite service.
paras.zh: 弗拉基米尔·普京警告美国谈判代表，俄罗斯将针对部署到乌克兰的任何外国军队，在乌克兰军方面临埃隆·马斯克星链卫星服务再次中断之际发表一系列强硬言论。

paras.en: During the talks at the Kremlin with the US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff on Thursday, the Russian president refused to soften his territorial demands, insisting on full control over four Ukrainian regions that Moscow claims to have annexed.
paras.zh: 周四在克里姆林宫与美国特使贾里德·库什纳和史蒂夫·威特科夫举行会谈时，俄罗斯总统拒绝软化其领土要求，坚持完全控制莫斯科声称已吞并的四个乌克兰地区。

paras.en: He also ruled out accepting the deployment of foreign peacekeeping troops in Ukraine, describing such a move as a “continuation of war”.
paras.zh: 他还排除接受在乌克兰部署外国维和部队的可能性，称此举是“战争的延续”。

paras.en: Putin’s comments appeared to severely dampen hopes that a peace deal could be within reach, after Volodymyr Zelenskyy said there was a “window of opportunity” to reach an agreement before the end of 2026.
paras.zh: 弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基表示，在 2026 年底之前存在达成协议的“机会之窗”，普京的言论似乎严重打击了人们对和平协议能够达成的希望。

paras.en: The latest trip to Moscow by Witkoff and Kushner, who have made numerous visits to Russia, was partly aimed at securing European participation in future negotiations, according to two people familiar with the talks.
paras.zh: 据两位知情人士透露，威特科夫和库什纳曾多次访问俄罗斯，他们最近访问莫斯科的部分目的是确保欧洲参与未来的谈判。

paras.en: Speaking after the meeting, Witkoff confirmed that European representatives would join the next round of talks. “They’re our partners, and it’s important for them to be involved,” he told reporters as he boarded a plane leaving Moscow.
paras.zh: 威特科夫在会后发表讲话时确认，欧洲代表将参加下一轮会谈。 “他们是我们的合作伙伴，他们的参与很重要，”他在登上离开莫斯科的飞机时告诉记者。

paras.en: The US envoys will now travel to Dublin, Ireland, where they will meet Zelenskyy and debrief him on the Moscow meeting.
paras.zh: 美国特使现在将前往爱尔兰都柏林，在那里会见泽伦斯基并向他汇报莫斯科会议的情况。

paras.en: Amid a flurry of diplomatic activity, including the recent talks in Abu Dhabi, the Kremlin appears to have succeeded in reframing negotiations over the war in Ukraine as part of a broader discussion about European security.
paras.zh: 在包括最近在阿布扎比举行的会谈在内的一系列外交活动中，克里姆林宫似乎成功地重新构建了有关乌克兰战争的谈判，将其作为有关欧洲安全的更广泛讨论的一部分。

paras.en: But Europe is wary of Russian attempts to focus discussions on a European security architecture, while Moscow continues to pound Ukraine with bombs and missiles.
paras.zh: 但欧洲对俄罗斯试图将讨论重点放在欧洲安全架构上持谨慎态度，而莫斯科则继续用炸弹和导弹袭击乌克兰。

paras.en: The EU foreign policy chief, Kaja Kallas, told reporters: “We already have a European security architecture in place.” Kallas pointed to the cold war-era Helsinki accords and the Budapest memorandum, which guaranteed the territorial integrity of Ukraine. “The problem is that Russia is not keeping to those agreements, so right now the focus should be that Russia actually keeps to their obligations … and they don’t attack another country again.” Focusing on a European security architecture was a “distraction” without a ceasefire, she added.
paras.zh: 欧盟外交政策负责人卡贾·卡拉斯告诉记者：“我们已经建立了欧洲安全架构。”卡拉斯指出，冷战时期的赫尔辛基协议和布达佩斯备忘录保证了乌克兰的领土完整。 “问题是俄罗斯没有遵守这些协议，所以现在的重点应该是俄罗斯实际上遵守了他们的义务……他们不会再攻击另一个国家。”她补充说，在没有停火的情况下，专注于欧洲安全架构是一种“干扰”。

paras.en: Both Washington and Moscow have been urging European leaders to appoint a single representative to lead negotiations on their behalf.
paras.zh: 华盛顿和莫斯科一直敦促欧洲领导人任命一名代表代表他们领导谈判。

paras.en: “Once a representative is appointed, a chief negotiator authorised to speak on Europe’s behalf, there will be a four-way dialogue,” Putin said on Thursday.
paras.zh: 普京周四表示：“一旦任命了一位代表，一位被授权代表欧洲发言的首席谈判代表，就会进行四方对话。”

paras.en: EU leaders are due to discuss the issue of who speaks for Europe on Friday, but so far have declined to nominate one person to speak for the bloc. One EU official said the EU would be represented by its institutions when issues concerning the union were on the table, but played down any imminent appointment. They said: “Do I expect an agreement on a special representative? My answer is no, I don’t.”
paras.zh: 欧盟领导人定于周五讨论谁代表欧洲发言的问题，但迄今为止尚未提名一人代表欧盟发言。一位欧盟官员表示，当有关欧盟的问题摆在桌面上时，欧盟将由其机构代表，但淡化了任何即将到来的任命。他们说：“我期望就特别代表达成协议吗？我的答案是否定的，我不期望。”

paras.en: Kallas suggested she – as the EU’s high representative for foreign and security policy – should represent the EU in talks, alongside António Costa, the president of the European Council.
paras.zh: 卡拉斯建议，作为欧盟外交和安全政策高级代表，她应该代表欧盟与欧洲理事会主席安东尼奥·科斯塔一起参加谈判。

paras.en: More than 45 European leaders are meeting in Dublin for the European Political Community summit, a gathering that brings together nearly every country on the continent, apart from the leaders of Belarus and Russia.
paras.zh: 超过 45 位欧洲领导人齐聚都柏林，参加欧洲政治共同体峰会，除了白俄罗斯和俄罗斯领导人外，欧洲大陆几乎所有国家都参加了此次峰会。

paras.en: The French president, Emmanuel Macron, played down the importance of having a single European negotiator, saying “the content determines the format”. “There is no more US support. So there [are] some mediations, fine,” he said, referring to the process led by Kushner and Witkoff. “But at the end of the day we will be the one to define and decide for our future security as Europeans.”
paras.zh: 法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙淡化了单一欧洲谈判代表的重要性，称“内容决定形式”。 “美国不再提供支持。所以有一些调解，很好，”他说，指的是库什纳和威特科夫领导的进程。 “但最终，我们将成为欧洲人未来安全的定义和决定者。”

paras.en: The German chancellor, Friedrich Merz, said it was first necessary to get Putin to the negotiating table before deciding on a European envoy. Merz said: “It’s not about individuals. What matters is that Putin is prepared to hold talks.”
paras.zh: 德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨表示，在决定欧洲特使之前，首先需要让普京坐到谈判桌前。默茨说：“这与个人无关。重要的是普京准备举行会谈。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, Zelenskyy accused Musk’s Starlink satellite service of damaging Ukraine’s ability to defend itself against Russian drone attacks, after Ukrainian military officials reported new restrictions on the system.
paras.zh: 与此同时，在乌克兰军方官员报告对该系统实施新的限制后，泽伦斯基指责马斯克的星链卫星服务损害了乌克兰抵御俄罗斯无人机袭击的能力。

paras.en: According to Zelenskyy, Starshield, a military version of Starlink funded by the Pentagon, has for several days been subject to speed limits of 100mph (161km/h) along the frontline and in Russian-occupied territory.
paras.zh: 据泽连斯基称，由五角大楼资助的星链军用版本“星盾”已经连续几天在前线和俄罗斯占领区受到 100 英里/小时（161 公里/小时）的限速。

paras.en: Similar restrictions last month prompted confusion over who had ordered them, with Musk and the Trump administration pointing fingers at each other before the service was partly restored.
paras.zh: 上个月的类似限制引发了人们对谁下令的困惑，马斯克和特朗普政府在服务部分恢复之前互相指责。

paras.en: The latest restrictions had made it harder for Ukrainian forces to intercept Russia’s increasingly sophisticated jet-powered drones, Zelenskyy said, accusing the service of “helping the Russians kill more Ukrainians and carry out more accurate strikes against Ukraine”.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示，最新的限制措施使乌克兰军队更难拦截俄罗斯日益先进的喷气式无人机，并指责该部队“帮助俄罗斯杀死更多乌克兰人并对乌克兰进行更准确的打击”。

paras.en: Kyiv has contacted Washington to seek an explanation for the disruption, which Zelenskyy said appeared to be deliberate rather than a technical fault.
paras.zh: 基辅已联系华盛顿寻求对这次中断的解释，泽连斯基表示这似乎是故意的，而不是技术故障。

articles.title: Lewis Hamilton says ‘Israel’s genocide in Gaza is appalling’ after Rafah visit
articles.author: Agencies and Guardian sport

paras.en: Formula One driver Lewis Hamilton said on Wednesday that Israel must allow aid trucks into Gaza, a day after he visited the Rafah border crossing in Egypt.
paras.zh: 一级方程式赛车手刘易斯·汉密尔顿周三表示，以色列必须允许援助卡车进入加沙，一天前他访问了埃及的拉法过境点。

paras.en: Hamilton, a seven-time world champion, arrived in El Arish on Tuesday, where he was briefed on how aid is prepared and coordinated before it is sent into Gaza, as he toured the Rafah crossing and the Egyptian Red Crescent’s aid warehouses.
paras.zh: 七届世界冠军汉密尔顿于周二抵达阿里什，在参观拉法过境点和埃及红新月会的援助仓库时，他听取了有​​关援助在运往加沙之前如何准备和协调的简报。

paras.en: He has frequently posted on social media about children killed in Israeli airstrikes in Gaza and called for a ceasefire. A ceasefire agreement reached last year has halted major combat operations in Gaza, but the amount of aid reaching the territory continues to fall far short of the agreed-upon minimum of 600 trucks a day.
paras.zh: 他经常在社交媒体上发布有关以色列在加沙空袭中丧生的儿童的信息，并呼吁停火。去年达成的停火协议已经停止了加沙的主要战斗行动，但运抵该地区的援助物资数量仍然远远低于商定的每天 600 辆卡车的最低限度。

paras.en: “The past three years of Israel’s genocide in Gaza is appalling. It’s an injustice for people to be denied their freedom, their safety and their dignity. No human being should be treated as though their life matters less,” the Ferrari driver wrote on Instagram.
paras.zh: “过去三年以色列在加沙发生的种族灭绝令人震惊。人们被剥夺自由、安全和尊严，这是不公正的。任何人都不应该被视为生命不那么重要，”这位法拉利车手在 Instagram 上写道。

paras.en: Israel strongly denies accusations of genocide and says its military campaign in Gaza targets Hamas militants.
paras.zh: 以色列强烈否认种族灭绝指控，并表示其在加沙的军事行动针对的是哈马斯武装分子。

paras.en: Hamilton described seeing food trucks lined up and ready to go at the border that were regularly held up or faced major delays.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿描述说，他看到食品卡车在边境排队准备出发，但经常被滞留或面临严重延误。

paras.en: “I saw walls stretching for miles, built to keep them in. Standing there, outside what felt like an open-air prison, all I could think about was getting in to help,” he said in the post. “At the Rafah border, I saw food trucks lined up ready to go, but they’re regularly not allowed in or face major delays. The first driver in line that I spoke to had already been waiting over 12 hours. At the nearby logistics centre, I saw the hard work of the aid workers, but I also saw what gets rejected for crazy reasons. Sleeping bags, first aid kits, medical equipment, wheelchairs even footballs for kids.
paras.zh: “我看到绵延数英里的围墙，是为了把他们关在里面而建的。站在那儿，在感觉就像露天监狱的外面，我所能想到的就是进去帮忙，”他在帖子中说。 “在拉法边境，我看到食品卡车排队准备出发，但它们经常不被允许进入或面临严重延误。我采访的第一位排队的司机已经等待了 12 个小时以上。在附近的物流中心，我看到了援助人员的辛勤工作，但我也看到了一些东西因疯狂的原因被拒绝。睡袋、急救箱、医疗设备、轮椅甚至儿童足球。

paras.en: “Israel needs to fulfil its obligations under the ceasefire and let the aid trucks in. I know so many people feel that same helplessness. That same need to do something rather than just watch. No excuse. I don’t want us to get used to their suffering. I don’t want us to look away.”
paras.zh: “以色列需要履行停火义务，让援助卡车进入。我知道很多人都感到同样的无助。同样需要做点什么，而不仅仅是袖手旁观。没有借口。我不想让我们习惯他们的痛苦。我不想让我们把目光移开。”

paras.en: Hamilton, 41, is an advocate for humanitarian causes. In 2021 he founded Mission 44, a charity that supports young people and works to improve their access to education and employment.
paras.zh: 41 岁的汉密尔顿是人道主义事业的倡导者。 2021 年，他创立了 Mission 44，这是一家支持年轻人并致力于改善他们受教育和就业机会的慈善机构。

paras.en: “I think we need to make sure we’re pushing to free Congo, free Sudan, free Syria, free Palestine,” Hamilton said last month. “I think there’s a lot of peace that I’m hoping we get to at some stage.”
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿上个月表示：“我认为我们需要确保我们正在推动解放刚果、解放苏丹、解放叙利亚、解放巴勒斯坦。” “我认为我们希望在某个阶段能够实现很多和平。”

paras.en: At the crossing on Tuesday, Hamilton greeted aid workers with “Assalamu alaikum” a widely used Arabic greeting meaning “peace be upon you”. He shook hands and briefly spoke to workers and officials.
paras.zh: 周二在过境点，汉密尔顿用“Assalamu alaikum”向援助人员打招呼，这是一种广泛使用的阿拉伯语问候语，意思是“愿你平安”。他与工人和官员握手并简短交谈。

paras.en: Hamilton is fourth in the drivers’ championship. Mercedes’ Kimi Antonelli has won the title with three races to go. The Las Vegas Grand Prix is 21 November before the Qatar Grand Prix on 29 November and the season-ending Abu Dhabi Grand Prix on 6 December.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿在车手积分榜上排名第四。梅赛德斯车队的基米·安东内利在还剩三场比赛的情况下赢得了冠军。拉斯维加斯大奖赛将于 11 月 21 日举行，之后是 11 月 29 日卡塔尔大奖赛和 12 月 6 日赛季结束的阿布扎比​​大奖赛。

articles.title: Two men found guilty of helping Iran try to ‘eliminate’ UK-based journalists
articles.author: Rajeev Syal Home affairs editor

paras.en: Two men of Iranian origin who were hired through social media as part of a plan to “eliminate” journalists in the UK have been found guilty of assisting Tehran’s intelligence services.
paras.zh: 作为“消灭”英国记者计划的一部分，两名伊朗裔男子通过社交媒体受雇，被判犯有协助德黑兰情报部门的罪名。

paras.en: Mostafa Sepahvand, 41, and Farhad Javadi Manesh, 46, carried out surveillance and reconnaissance between August 2024 and March last year in an attempt to inflict violence on “subjects” in the UK.
paras.zh: 41 岁的 Mostafa Sepahvand 和 46 岁的 Farhad Javadi Manesh 在 2024 年 8 月至去年 3 月期间进行监视和侦察，试图对英国的“主体”施加暴力。

paras.en: These subjects included two journalists for the London-based Persian broadcaster Iran International, Mojtaba Pourmohsen and Kambiz Hosseini, and a founder member of UK Lawyers for Israel, Jonathan Turner.
paras.zh: 这些对象包括总部位于伦敦的波斯广播公司伊朗国际的两名记者 Mojtaba Pourmohsen 和 Kambiz Hosseini，以及英国以色列律师协会的创始人乔纳森·特纳。

paras.en: The defendants visited addresses linked to their targets, took photos and videos and used platforms such as ChatGPT to research them online. They appear to be part of a growing new tactic used by hostile states in which “proxies” are hired to work for foreign security forces, with often little idea who they are targeting or why.
paras.zh: 被告访问了与其目标相关的地址，拍摄照片和视频，并使用 ChatGPT 等平台进行在线研究。它们似乎是敌对国家使用的一种日益增长的新策略的一部分，在这种策略中，“代理人”被雇佣为外国安全部队工作，而他们往往不知道他们的目标是谁或为什么。

paras.en: Last month the Norwegian teenager Johannes Natland, 19, was jailed for life after he agreed to carry out a hit in Huddersfield for the Foxtrot Network, a Swedish organised crime group backed by the Iranian regime.
paras.zh: 上个月，19 岁的挪威少年约翰内斯·纳特兰 (Johannes Natland) 因同意在哈德斯菲尔德为 Foxtrot Network（一个由伊朗政权支持的瑞典有组织犯罪集团）实施袭击而被判终身监禁。

paras.en: The Iranian men came to the UK illegally between 2016 and 2022 – Sepahvand in the back of a lorry and Manesh in a small boat.
paras.zh: 这两名伊朗男子在 2016 年至 2022 年间非法来到英国，其中塞帕万德 (Sepahvand) 乘坐卡车，马内什 (Manesh) 乘坐小船。

paras.en: Sepahvand used the AI platform ChatGPT to find the home address of Pourmohsen, who worked for the London-based Persian language broadcaster Iran International. He hoped to be paid £150,000 to carry out a violent attack and help to “finish off” Pourmohsen.
paras.zh: Sepahvand 使用人工智能平台 ChatGPT 找到了 Pourmohsen 的家庭住址，Pourmohsen 供职于伦敦的波斯语广播公司伊朗国际。他希望获得 15 万英镑的报酬来实施暴力袭击并帮助“终结”普尔莫森。

paras.en: Sepahvand chatted on WhatsApp to his handler, an Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps commander called Amin, as he spied on Pourmohsen in December 2024, Woolwich crown court heard.
paras.zh: 伍尔维奇皇家法庭获悉，塞帕万德在 2024 年 12 月监视普尔莫森时，通过 WhatsApp 与他的上司、伊斯兰革命卫队指挥官阿明聊天。

paras.en: Amin wrote: “These are new pictures of the guy/bloke.”
paras.zh: 阿明写道：“这些是这个人的新照片。”

paras.en: Referring to a picture, Amin said: “And that dot is their office?”
paras.zh: 阿明提到一张照片说：“那个点是他们的办公室？”

paras.en: Sepahvand said: “Love you brother, I’ll go there tomorrow.”
paras.zh: Sepahvand 说：“爱你兄弟，我明天就去那里。”

paras.en: The pair also discussed surveillance of the Iranian satirist Kambiz Hosseini, who eventually had to leave home because of the threats made against him.
paras.zh: 两人还讨论了对伊朗讽刺作家卡姆比兹·侯赛尼（Kambiz Hosseini）的监视，后者因受到威胁而最终不得不离家出走。

paras.en: Bill Emlyn Jones KC, prosecuting, said Iran and its rulers did not and could tolerate dissent. “One organisation critical to the regime, and therefore very much in its sights, is Iran International, a news organisation which has come under particular attack because of its explicit support for opposition groups and its editorial stance, which is anti-Islamic Republic of Iran.
paras.zh: 起诉人比尔·埃姆林·琼斯 (Bill Emlyn Jones KC) 表示，伊朗及其统治者没有也可以容忍异议。 “伊朗国际是一个对该政权至关重要的组织，因此也受到其关注，该新闻机构因其明确支持反对派团体及其反伊朗伊斯兰共和国的编辑立场而受到特别攻击。

paras.en: “Eliminating hostile, critical or dissident actors overseas is a staple policy of the Islamic republic. Together, the defendants were engaged in what is very obviously a form of spying,” Jones said.
paras.zh: “消除海外敌对、批评或持不同政见者是伊斯兰共和国的一项主要政策。被告一起参与了非常明显的间谍活动，”琼斯说。

paras.en: Hosseini, 51, had to leave home and stop work as a standup comedian as a result of the threats he received. He was sent a message with a picture of his car saying the next time he started the engine it would blow up. Hosseini’s family in Iran also received threats, and his family had to leave the country.
paras.zh: 51 岁的胡塞尼因收到威胁而不得不离开家并停止单口喜剧演员的工作。他收到一条带有汽车照片的信息，称下次他启动发动机时，汽车就会爆炸。胡赛尼在伊朗的家人也受到威胁，他的家人不得不离开该国。

paras.en: The court heard Sepahvand had been convicted of theft in Iran and was drawn into the plan to “eliminate” dissidents in the hope of reducing his criminal record.
paras.zh: 法庭获悉，塞帕万德在伊朗被判犯有盗窃罪，并被卷入“消灭”持不同政见者的计划，以期减少他的犯罪记录。

paras.en: He told his Iranian handlers he was prepared to escalate from surveillance to violence, the court heard.
paras.zh: 法庭获悉，他告诉伊朗上司，他准备将监控升级为暴力。

paras.en: He hoped to receive a final payment of £150,000 for “finishing the job”, a reference to killing one of the journalists, the court was told. “If the person [the target] is inside, they pay the £150,000, and I’ll finish him off,” said Sepahvand in a voice note.
paras.zh: 法庭获悉，他希望获得 15 万英镑的最终付款，以“完成工作”，指的是杀害一名记者。 “如果那个人（目标）在里面，他们会支付 15 万英镑，我会把他干掉，”塞帕万德在语音中说。

paras.en: Sepahvand claimed his family was being threatened and that he never intended to go through with the hit. He also denied plotting to kill Turner.
paras.zh: 塞帕万德声称他的家人受到了威胁，而且他从来没有打算经历这次袭击。他还否认密谋谋杀特纳。

paras.en: Manesh claimed he took a picture of the Iran International site because it was “a beautiful building” and did not know they were working with the Iranian intelligence services.
paras.zh: 马内什声称，他拍摄了伊朗国际网站的照片，因为它是“一座美丽的建筑”，并且不知道他们正在与伊朗情报部门合作。

paras.en: Earlier this year, Roman Lavrynovych, 22, and Stanislav Carpiuc, 27, were jailed at the Old Bailey for seven and two years respectively for arson attacks on property connected to Keir Starmer. An anonymous Russian-speaking figure named El Money had recruited Lavrynovych and Carpiuc on Telegram.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，22 岁的罗曼·拉夫里诺维奇 (Roman Lavrynovych) 和 27 岁的斯坦尼斯拉夫·卡尔皮乌克 (Stanislav Carpiuc) 因纵火袭击与凯尔·斯塔默 (Keir Starmer) 有关的财产而分别在老贝利监狱被判入狱七年和两年。一位名叫 El Money 的匿名俄语人士在 Telegram 上招募了 Lavrynovych 和 Carpiuc。

paras.en: Last year, six Britons were jailed for their parts in a Russian-ordered arson attack on a London warehouse providing aid to Ukraine. The ringleader, Dylan Earl, was recruited by the Wagner group, a mercenary organisation that acts on behalf of the Russian state.
paras.zh: 去年，六名英国人因参与俄罗斯下令纵火袭击伦敦向乌克兰提供援助的仓库而被监禁。头目迪伦·厄尔是代表俄罗斯国家的雇佣军组织瓦格纳集团招募的。

paras.en: Sepahvand was convicted by the jury of assisting a foreign intelligence service and preparatory conduct. Manesh was convicted of assisting a foreign intelligence service, but cleared of preparatory conduct.
paras.zh: 陪审团判定塞帕万德犯有协助外国情报部门和筹备行为罪。马内什因协助外国情报部门而被定罪，但洗清了准备行为的罪名。

paras.en: Shapoor Noori, 57, of Ealing, was cleared by the jury of assisting a foreign intelligence service and preparatory conduct.
paras.zh: 陪审团裁定，57 岁的伊灵人沙普尔·努里 (Shapoor Noori) 没有协助外国情报部门和筹备活动。

paras.en: Sepahvand, Manesh and Noori had claimed asylum in the UK and received temporary leave to remain. None of them had regular full-time employment.
paras.zh: 塞帕万德、马内什和努里已在英国申请庇护并获得临时居留权。他们都没有正式的全职工作。

paras.en: It is understood they met by chance and were then directed by Sepahvand and his contacts in Iran. There appeared to be no evidence of any wider plot.
paras.zh: 据了解，他们是偶然认识的，然后受到塞帕万德及其在伊朗的联系人的指挥。似乎没有证据表明有任何更广泛的阴谋。

paras.en: Mrs Justice Cheema-Grubb remanded Sepahvand and Manesh before sentencing at the Old Bailey on 17 December.
paras.zh: 12 月 17 日，Cheema-Grubb 法官在老贝利法院宣判前将 Sepahvand 和 Manesh 还押候审。

articles.title: Hegseth awards medal to war memorial guard who reprimanded him and group

paras.en: US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth has awarded a medal to the guard who reprimanded his group at Arlington National Cemetery.
paras.zh: 美国国防部长皮特·赫格斯向在阿灵顿国家公墓斥责其团队的警卫颁发了一枚奖章。

paras.en: A video of a Veterans Day observance event on Wednesday showed Hegseth, his wife, and senior advisers laughing and talking while posing for photos in front of the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier before the guard told them to be quiet.
paras.zh: 周三退伍军人节纪念活动的视频显示，赫格斯、他的妻子和高级顾问在无名烈士墓前有说有笑地摆姿势拍照，随后警卫让他们保持安静。

paras.en: In a statement, the Pentagon later announced that Hegseth had given Specialist Thomas Iglesias a Joint Service Commendation Medal "for the execution of his duties at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier".
paras.zh: 五角大楼后来在一份声明中宣布，赫格塞斯授予专家托马斯·伊格莱西亚斯联合服役嘉奖奖章，以表彰他“在无名烈士墓中履行的职责”。

paras.en: Photos shared on the defence secretary's X account showed him presenting the medal to Iglesias.
paras.zh: 国防部长 X 账户上分享的照片显示，他向伊格莱西亚斯颁发了奖章。

paras.en: He was accompanied by others whom the Pentagon identified as members of the 3rd US Infantry Regiment, known as the Old Guard, which is responsible for holding vigil over the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier.
paras.zh: 陪同他的还有其他人，五角大楼确认他们是美国第三步兵团的成员，该团被称为“老卫士”，负责为无名烈士墓守夜。

paras.en: "We love soldiers. We love standards. Well done, Specialist. Carry on Patriots," the accompanying text on Hegseth's post reads.
paras.zh: “我们热爱士兵。我们热爱标准。干得好，专家。继续爱国者，”赫格斯帖子上的附文写道。

paras.en: In the video, the army sentinel on duty later identified as Iglesias can be seen stepping towards Hegseth's group and shouting: "All visitors will maintain an atmosphere of silence and respect at all times."
paras.zh: 在视频中，可以看到后来被确认为伊格莱西亚斯的军队哨兵走向赫格斯的队伍，并喊道：“所有访客将始终保持沉默和尊重的气氛。”

paras.en: The Arlington National Cemetery etiquette requests that visitors speak quietly and do not engage in disrespectful or disorderly conduct.
paras.zh: 阿灵顿国家公墓礼仪要求游客安静说话，不要做出不尊重或扰乱秩序的行为。

paras.en: The tomb, which is one of the country's most sacred war memorials, marks the final resting place of an unknown soldier who was killed in World War I.
paras.zh: 这座坟墓是该国最神圣的战争纪念碑之一，标志着一位在第一次世界大战中阵亡的无名士兵的最后安息之地。

paras.en: Chief Pentagon spokesman Sean Parnell later said in a statement: "While commemorating this solemn day, a soldier correctly and respectfully reminded everyone to maintain decorum."
paras.zh: 五角大楼首席发言人肖恩·帕内尔后来在一份声明中表示：“在纪念这个庄严的日子时，一名士兵正确而恭敬地提醒大家保持礼仪。”

paras.en: "The Secretary and the entire Department have always honoured - and will always honour - the sacrifices our military men and women have made to keep America safe."
paras.zh: “国务卿和整个部门一直尊重并将永远尊重我们的军人为保护美国安全而做出的牺牲。”

paras.en: A service member from the 3rd Infantry Regiment stands watch over the tomb 24 hours a day and has done so since 1948.
paras.zh: 自 1948 年以来，第 3 步兵团的一名军人每天 24 小时守卫这座坟墓。

paras.en: It is not unusual for them to admonish visitors to the site, according to the BBC's US partner CBS News. They reportedly do so a few times a day.
paras.zh: 据英国广播公司美国合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司新闻报道，他们警告该网站的访问者并不罕见。据报道，他们每天都会这样做几次。

paras.en: Earlier, President Donald Trump, Vice-President JD Vance and other top officials attended the annual wreath-laying ceremony at the cemetery.
paras.zh: 此前，美国总统特朗普、副总统万斯等高级官员出席了在公墓举行的一年一度的敬献花圈仪式。

paras.en: During his speech at the ceremony, Trump offered his gratitude to uniformed service members who have fought for the country. He also touted what he sees as his administration's success in the Iran war.
paras.zh: 在仪式上的讲话中，特朗普向为国家而战的军人表示感谢。他还称赞他的政府在伊朗战争中取得了成功。

paras.en: "Under this administration, and it was about time, somebody fought back. All of us fought back," he said.
paras.zh: “在本届政府的领导下，是时候有人反击了。我们所有人都反击了，”他说。

paras.en: "And we won," Trump said of the Iran war. "It's just a question of when we want to end it. We want to make sure we have a total victory, not a 93% victory."
paras.zh: “我们赢了，”特朗普谈到伊朗战争时说道。 “这只是我们什么时候结束的问题。我们要确保我们取得全面胜利，而不是93%的胜利。”

paras.en: Trump also pointed out Hegseth during the ceremony, saying he's done a "fantastic job" as defence secretary.
paras.zh: 特朗普还在仪式上指出赫格斯塞斯，称他作为国防部长的工作“非常出色”。

paras.en: Trump has repeatedly defended Hegseth amid Democratic lawmakers' push to impeach him. On Tuesday, an effort to impeach the defence secretary under accusations that he waged war on Iran without congressional authorisation failed on Capitol Hill.
paras.zh: 在民主党议员推动​​弹劾赫格塞斯的过程中，特朗普多次为赫格塞斯辩护。周二，国会山弹劾国防部长的努力失败了，指控他未经国会授权对伊朗发动战争。

paras.en: Hegseth has called the impeachment efforts a "farce" and a "stunt".
paras.zh: 赫格斯称弹劾努力是一场“闹剧”和“噱头”。

articles.title: Suspected bomb hoax threats force fresh evacuations of Italian schools

paras.en: Schools across Italy have received bomb threats for the second day in a row, sparking fresh panic and evacuations.
paras.zh: 意大利各地的学校连续第二天收到炸弹威胁，引发新的恐慌和疏散。

paras.en: Some 3,778 schools, from Milan in the north to Sicily in the south, reported similar threats to one that created chaos on Wednesday - even though no explosive devices have been found.
paras.zh: 从北部的米兰到南部的西西里岛，约有 3,778 所学校报告了与周三造成混乱的一所学校类似的威胁，尽管没有发现爆炸装置。

paras.en: The government has advised schools that "in the absence of concrete evidence beyond the simple receipt of a mass email indicating a danger, buildings must not not be evacuated". Unlike a day earlier, only 77 schools were evacuated on Thursday, authorities say.
paras.zh: 政府建议学校“在没有具体证据的情况下，除了简单地收到表明存在危险的大量电子邮件之外，不得不疏散建筑物内的人员”。当局称，与前一天不同，周四只有 77 所学校被疏散。

paras.en: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni says her government will come up with "sector-specific" advice to help those facing this kind of threat.
paras.zh: 总理乔治亚·梅洛尼表示，她的政府将提出“针对特定部门”的建议，以帮助那些面临此类威胁的人。

paras.en: Schools in Scotland and Northern Ireland received threats on Wednesday, too. It is unclear whether the incidents are connected.
paras.zh: 苏格兰和北爱尔兰的学校周三也收到了威胁。目前尚不清楚这些事件是否有关联。

paras.en: On Thursday morning, a bomb alert at a Calais rail station delayed international and national train services in northern France.
paras.zh: 周四早上，加莱火车站的炸弹警报导致法国北部的国际和国内火车服务延误。

paras.en: The latest incidents follow a series of bomb hoaxes last week against airports and airlines in a number of European countries.
paras.zh: 最新事件是在上周针对一些欧洲国家的机场和航空公司发生一系列炸弹恶作剧之后发生的。

paras.en: Although a number of threats were claimed by an extremist misogynistic group, it later denied any link to the false warnings.
paras.zh: 尽管一个极端厌女团体声称发出了一些威胁，但该组织后来否认与虚假警告有任何联系。

paras.en: Wednesday's email threat - sent to 6,300 out of a total of 7,476 Italian state schools - was said to be from a certain "Mikhail Andropov, leader of Vilayat di Misoginistan".
paras.zh: 周三的电子邮件威胁——发送给意大利 7,476 所公立学校中的 6,300 所——据说来自某位“米索吉尼斯坦省领导人米哈伊尔·安德罗波夫”。

paras.en: Some officials say it originated in Taiwan.
paras.zh: 有官员称其起源于台湾。

paras.en: A similar message sent to Italian schools on Thursday, again signed by Mikhail Andropov, is said to have been sent from the account of a teacher in the Philippines whose account is believed to have been hacked.
paras.zh: 周四，一封同样由米哈伊尔·安德罗波夫（Mikhail Andropov）签署的类似信息发送给意大利学校，据说是从菲律宾一名教师的账户发出的，据信该教师的账户已被黑客入侵。

paras.en: Many parents, though, are concerned and have been demanding clarity and action from the government.
paras.zh: 然而，许多家长对此表示担忧，并一直要求政府澄清并采取行动。

paras.en: La Repubblica newspaper reports that protests have been held against a decision by the headmaster of a secondary school in Rome who did not take any action, saying she had realised the threatening message to contain typos and therefore be "fake".
paras.zh: 据《共和报》报道，罗马一所中学校长的决定引发了抗议，校长没有采取任何行动，称她已经意识到威胁信息包含拼写错误，因此是“假的”。

paras.en: According to the newspaper, protesters want new national guidelines to be issued.
paras.zh: 据该报报道，抗议者希望发布新的国家指导方针。

articles.title: Jensen Huang has resigned, what's next for Nvidia?

paras.en: Jensen Huang has resigned, what's next for Nvidia?
paras.zh: 黄仁勋辞职了，英伟达的下一步是什么？

paras.en: Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO of tech giant Nvidia, the company's board says, with chief financial officer Colette Kress appointed interim boss.
paras.zh: 科技巨头英伟达董事会表示，黄仁勋已辞去首席执行官一职，首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯被任命为临时老板。

paras.en: The company's shares have recovered some ground after plummeting more than 13% when US markets opened shortly after news of Huang's resignation.
paras.zh: 在黄仁勋辞职的消息传出后不久，美国股市开盘时，该公司股价暴跌超过 13%，目前已收复部分失地。

paras.en: The BBC's North America correspondent Samira Hussain explains what's next for the company.
paras.zh: BBC 北美记者萨米拉·侯赛因 (Samira Hussain) 解释了该公司的下一步计划。

articles.title: CELEBRATING 100 YEARS

paras.en: MEDINA, OH (January 6, 2025) – Carlisle Brake & Friction (CarlisleCBF), a global leader in brake and friction technology and part of the CentroMotion family of brands, has reached a momentous milestone – its 100th anniversary.
Since its founding in 1925, the company has lived up to its tagline, "Braking New Ground," by consistently pioneering innovative solutions that have propelled industries forward.

"For 100 years, Carlisle has been synonymous with groundbreaking innovation and unwavering reliability in the braking industry," says Tom Vanderlaan, Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) of CentroMotion. "This milestone is a testament to the dedication of our employees, the trust of our customers, and the enduring strength of our products. As we celebrate our centennial, we reaffirm our commitment to continuous innovation, strong partnerships, and giving back to the communities we serve."
A Century of Innovation in Motion Control

For a century, CarlisleCBF has been at the forefront of motion control, pushing the boundaries of performance with its industry-leading brakes and friction materials. Through unwavering commitment to R&D, the company has earned the trust of customers worldwide, establishing itself as a cornerstone of reliability.
Celebrating 100 Years of Braking New Ground: A Digital Celebration

To commemorate this historic milestone, CarlisleCBF is launching a comprehensive digital celebration. This virtual experience will allow customers, employees and industry partners to delve into the company’s rich history, groundbreaking innovations and commitment to excellence through historical photographs and stories.

A core aspect of the celebration is fostering a sense of community. CarlisleCBF invites customers, employees and industry partners to join the journey by visiting their dedicated anniversary webpage, www.CarlisleCBF.com, and following their story on social media.
The webpage and social media channels will serve as a virtual time capsule, showcasing CarlisleCBF's rich history, ground-breaking milestones and product innovations.

To encourage participation and celebrate the impact CarlisleCBF has had, a social media campaign is launching with the hashtag #CarlisleCBF100. Participants are encouraged to share stories, photos and memories that illustrate how CarlisleCBF products have impacted their lives or businesses. The most engaging submissions will be featured on the company's social media channels and website.
By combining digital storytelling with interactive social media, CarlisleCBF aims to create a lasting legacy for its first century of service, while fostering a spirit of community and appreciation.

Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of CarlisleCBF's brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, and wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications, as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: CentroMotion designs and delivers highly engineered products that enhance the safety, reliability and productivity of equipment used in transportation, agriculture, construction, mining and demanding industrial environments. Our innovative team works collaboratively with customers through our family of trusted, established brands, bringing deep subject-matter expertise in complementary technologies.

This expertise, combined with our exceptional scale and geographic reach, makes us a reliable partner to help our customers achieve their goals, and provide end users with the best equipment possible. Our well-known brands include Power-Packer for hydraulic motion control and stabilization systems; CrossControl and maximatecc for operator information and human-machine interface systems; Elliott Manufacturing and Weasler Engineering for power and force transmission through flexible and rigid driveline systems; Gits Manufacturing for high-performance engine thermal and emission control solutions; and Carlisle Brake & Friction for materials and mechatronic solutions for off-highway brake and transmission products. Learn more about CentroMotion at www.centromotion.com.

articles.title: bauma 2025

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction is one of five CentroMotion brands exhibiting at bauma, April 7–13 in Munich, booth A2, 402.
CentroMotion is a global manufacturing company specializing in friction, information and controls, mechanical power transmission, and thermal and motion control products.
Our teams will showcase various products that serve the construction market:
Sharing product highlights from their industry-leading brake, transmissions/clutch and motion control systems.
Showcasing display and on-board computing platforms.
