articles.title: Fewer hours and higher wages – or more burnout and surveillance: employers told to prepare for AI
articles.author: Josh Butler

paras.en: Entry-level jobs will be the first to be automated due to AI, but it could mean fewer hours and higher wages for ordinary workers – or make jobs tougher with more burnout and workplace surveillance – the government has warned employers.
paras.zh: 政府已警告雇主，入门级工作将是因人工智能而率先实现自动化的工作，但这可能意味着普通劳动者工作时间缩短、工资提高——或者工作变得更加艰苦，导致更多人出现职业倦怠，并受到更多工作场所的监视。

paras.en: While major companies like Qantas and Canva slash their workforces in restructures spurred by AI changes, workplace relations minister Amanda Rishworth said employers must give workers “a clear plan” about how automation could affect their jobs, and the opportunity to move into new roles.
paras.zh: 在澳航和Canva等大型公司因人工智能变革而进行重组并大幅裁员之际，澳大利亚劳资关系部长阿曼达·里什沃思（Amanda Rishworth）表示，雇主必须向员工提供“明确的计划”，说明自动化将如何影响他们的工作，并为他们提供转岗的机会。

paras.en: As she launched a new government guide on AI and employment – which cautioned that younger, older and First Nations workers, along with women and people with a disability faced “disproportionate impacts” – another Labor MP, Ed Husic, questioned what workers will get from the AI revolution.
paras.zh: 在她发布一份关于人工智能与就业的新政府指南时——该指南警告称，年轻、年长和原住民工人，以及女性和残疾人面临“不成比例的影响”——另一位工党议员埃德·胡西克（Ed Husic）质疑工人将从人工智能革命中获得什么。

paras.en: “Who receives the benefits of higher productivity?” Husic, the former industry minister, told a parliamentary hearing examining the big four banks.
paras.zh: “谁能从更高的生产力中受益？” 前工业部长胡锡在审查四大银行的议会听证会上表示。

paras.en: “Does it mean better services and lower prices for customers, secure jobs with higher wages for workers, or just lower labour costs and higher returns?”
paras.zh: “这是否意味着为顾客提供更好的服务和更低的价格，为工人提供更稳定的工作和更高的工资，还是仅仅意味着更低的劳动力成本和更高的回报？”

paras.en: Rishworth on Thursday launched a “best practice guide on the adoption of AI in the workplace”, saying the new technology must benefit both businesses and employees.
paras.zh: 里什沃思于周四发布了“工作场所采用人工智能的最佳实践指南”，表示新技术必须使企业和员工都受益。

paras.en: The guide paints an optimistic picture of AI, saying wider takeup could improve productivity, service quality and profitability for businesses, as well as boost wages, offer shorter and more flexible working hours, or provide more meaningful work for employees.
paras.zh: 该指南对人工智能描绘了一幅乐观的蓝图，指出更广泛的采用可以提高企业的生产力、服务质量和盈利能力，还可以提高工资、提供更短且更灵活的工作时间，或为员工提供更有意义的工作。

paras.en: But deeper within the document, it also concedes there are “potential hazards” of AI, including “intrusive worker surveillance, poor rostering practices, intensified or unrealistic performance standards” and potential discrimination.
paras.zh: 但该文件在更深层次上也承认人工智能存在“潜在危害”，包括“对员工的侵入式监控、不当的排班做法、加码或不切实际的绩效标准”以及潜在的歧视。

paras.en: It suggests that, if basic tasks are automated, humans will be left with more intense and complex tasks – and that some employers could use greater monitoring capabilities for performance management.
paras.zh: 报告指出，如果基本任务实现自动化，人类将承担更繁重、更复杂的工作，而一些雇主可能会利用更强大的监控能力来进行绩效管理。

paras.en: In a speech to a business forum in Sydney, Rishworth said some firms had used AI to automate tedious tasks to save time and money, but warned that firms simply adding AI to their company without properly consulting workers could actually increase workloads, as humans have to navigate an added step.
paras.zh: 里什沃思在悉尼的一个商业论坛上发表演讲时表示，一些公司已经使用人工智能来自动化繁琐的任务，以节省时间和金钱，但她警告说，如果公司只是在没有与员工充分沟通的情况下将人工智能引入公司，实际上可能会增加工作量，因为人类必须应对一个额外的步骤。

paras.en: “I’ve spoken to many workers who have told me that they are willing to adopt AI at work where they can see that it will improve their working life. But that willingness cannot be taken for granted,” Rishworth said.
paras.zh: “我与许多员工交谈过，他们告诉我，如果他们能看到人工智能能够改善他们的工作生活，他们就愿意在工作中采用人工智能。但这种意愿不能想当然。”Rishworth表示。

paras.en: “Will they receive support and opportunities to build new skills? Will their knowledge and expertise still be valued? Will they share in the benefits being created? Without answers to these questions, workers will naturally lose trust in the process and become reluctant to engage with new technologies,” she said.
paras.zh: “他们是否会获得支持和机会来培养新技能？他们的知识和专业技能是否仍将受到重视？他们是否将分享所创造的利益？如果得不到这些问题的答案，员工自然会对这一过程失去信心，不愿意接触新技术。”她说道。

paras.en: Greens leader David Shoebridge accused the government of “watching from the sidelines” while big companies slashed their workforce, demanding protection against surveillance and job cuts.
“When the government talks about asking employers nicely to consult staff, what it is really saying is that a worker who loses their job to an algorithm will have no legal recourse at all.
“We have seen Qantas, Canva, NAB and ANZ all firing Australian workers as part of offshoring and an AI rollout – it’s clear the time for optional guidelines has passed,” he said.
“Sharing the benefits of AI through better pay and shorter hours is a good idea, and it is exactly why it needs to be written into law instead of left to the goodwill of employers.”
The Reserve Bank this week reported it had seen “little evidence to date” of AI disrupting Australia’s labour market, but said the size and type of future impacts were “highly uncertain”.

The RBA – which last week warned the construction of datacentres and AI investment was fuelling inflation – said it saw “tentative signs” of impacts on certain roles, like clerks, computer programmers and call centre workers.

Qantas this week announced 850 job cuts which would target finance, human resources and marketing roles. Meanwhile, National Australian Bank announced 2,500 job losses and while Canva announced 1,200 layoffs.
All have been linked partly to the growth in AI.

Rishworth’s workplace guide says little about potential redundancies linked to AI, but warns employers they should be consulting with workers about the takeup of AI and what it might mean for their jobs. It especially raises concern about “entry-level work”, which the guide said may be “the first to be automated”.

articles.title: New York building collapse kills at least two, officials say

paras.en: At least two people have died and more than 17 others are injured after a building in New York City collapsed into an open construction site, officials have said.
paras.zh: 官员表示，纽约市一栋建筑坍塌至一个露天建筑工地，造成至少两人死亡，另有17人受伤。

paras.en: It sparked a massive search-and-rescue operation, with more than 250 first responders at the scene in Brooklyn, trying to find survivors who may have been trapped under the rubble of the three-storey building.
paras.zh: 这起事件引发了一场大规模的搜救行动，250多名急救人员赶赴布鲁克林现场，试图寻找可能被困在三层楼建筑废墟下的幸存者。

paras.en: Hours later, aerial video showed firefighters pulling a survivor, covered in dust, out of the debris on a stretcher.
paras.zh: 数小时后，一段航拍视频显示，消防员用担架将一名满身尘土的幸存者从废墟中抬出。

paras.en: Authorities are yet to determine what caused the sudden collapse at about 16:00 local time (21:00 GMT) on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 当局尚未确定周三当地时间16:00（格林尼治标准时间21:00）左右发生突然坍塌的原因。

paras.en: The rescue mission has been described as "extremely dangerous" by New York City Fire Department (FDNY) Commissioner Lillian Bonsignore.
paras.zh: 纽约市消防局（FDNY）局长莉莲·邦西尼奥雷（Lillian Bonsignore）将此次救援行动描述为“极其危险”。

paras.en: She added that people from the collapsed building and also the construction site had been trapped.
paras.zh: 她还说，倒塌建筑内的人以及建筑工地的人都被困住了。

paras.en: "Members have been working methodically and haven't stopped since they arrived this afternoon," Bonsignore said.
paras.zh: “队员们一直在有条不紊地工作，自今天下午抵达以来就没有停歇过。”Bonsignore说。

paras.en: Some pictures of the collapsed building, on Flatbush Avenue in Brooklyn, show an entire side of it gone, with bedrooms and closets exposed. Among the debris, smashed concrete and twisted metal, are household items and clothes.
paras.zh: 一些位于布鲁克林弗拉特布什大道的坍塌建筑的照片显示，该建筑的一整面墙已经不见了，卧室和衣橱都暴露在外。在碎石、破碎的混凝土和扭曲的金属中，夹杂着家居用品和衣物。

paras.en: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani joined emergency responders at the scene, praising them for their rapid response.
paras.zh: 纽约市市长佐兰·马姆达尼（Zohran Mamdani）赶赴现场，与应急救援人员一同应对紧急情况，并赞扬他们反应迅速。

paras.en: They "arrived in under a minute and have spent hours working in dangerous and highly technical conditions to rescue New Yorkers," he later wrote on X.
paras.zh: 他后来在X上写道，他们“在一分钟内赶到现场，并在危险和高技术条件下工作了数小时，以营救纽约市民”。

paras.en: The Brooklyn building was built in 1930, city records show, according to the BBC's US partner CBS News.
paras.zh: 据英国广播公司的美国合作伙伴CBS新闻报道，城市档案显示，这栋布鲁克林大楼建于1930年。

articles.title: Ukraine's power supply close to critical as Russian strikes bring darkness and cold

paras.en: Daryna Kulchytska is a mum under pressure. A single parent in a seventh floor flat in Kyiv trying to feed two lively kids and ensure they do their homework. But Daryna also faces the added strain of a deadline she can't even be certain of.
paras.zh: 达琳娜·库尔奇茨卡是一位承受着压力的母亲。她是一名单亲妈妈，住在基辅一栋七层楼的公寓里，努力养活两个活泼的孩子，并督促他们完成家庭作业。但达琳娜还面临着一个她甚至无法确定的截止日期带来的额外压力。

paras.en: All she knows is soon the lights will go out, the sockets will lose power, the wi-fi will drop, and the taps will run dry. Tonight, the electricity has kept flowing an hour longer than advertised, but Daryna's still racing to serve dinner and finish her own work from home.
paras.zh: 她只知道，很快电灯就会熄灭，插座就会断电，无线网络就会中断，水龙头就会干涸。今晚，电力比通知的时间多供应了一个小时，但达琳娜仍在争分夺秒地准备晚餐，并完成自己的居家办公任务。

paras.en: "The last few days it was only four or five hours we had power, but it's not at the same times. For two hours we have electricity, then for eight hours we don't."
paras.zh: “过去几天，我们只有四五个小时有电，但供电时间并不固定。我们有电的时候只有两个小时，然后就八个小时没电。”

paras.en: This rolling schedule of planned power cuts has been in place since October, as Russia intensified attacks on Ukraine's energy grid. Ukraine has responded by striking Russian oil refineries.
paras.zh: 自10月以来，随着俄罗斯加紧对乌克兰能源电网的袭击，这一轮番实施的计划性停电安排就已到位。乌克兰的回应是打击俄罗斯的炼油厂。

paras.en: Officials are concerned that life will quickly become unsustainable for millions of Ukrainians if power supplies cannot be maintained for at least four hours per day. Some privately warn that's close already, as some families are living with outages of up to 20 hours in Kyiv.
paras.zh: 官员们担心，如果每天无法维持至少四小时的电力供应，数百万乌克兰人的生活将很快变得无法持续。一些人私下警告说，这种情况已经迫在眉睫，因为基辅的一些家庭每天停电时间长达20个小时。

paras.en: The power cuts were introduced earlier this year than last winter, and they're already lasting longer - making homes like Daryna's darker and colder. She's wrapped in layers of clothing and a heavy coat - the temperature is dropping, indoors and out.
paras.zh: 今年的停电比去年冬天来得更早，而且持续时间更长，这让达琳娜家的房子变得更加黑暗和寒冷。她裹着好几层衣服和一件厚外套——室内外气温都在下降。

paras.en: Just before 7:30pm, there's a click and that's it - darkness until dawn.
paras.zh: 就在晚上 7 点 30 分之前，一声咔哒声响起，然后就什么都没有了——一片黑暗，直到黎明。

paras.en: The lift doesn't work, the water will stop flowing because electricity is needed to pump it to their flat. So the torches and LED candles come out and Daryna, her son Kyryll and daughter Olena gather for a card game of Uno before an early night.
paras.zh: 电梯不工作，水也会停流，因为需要用电才能将水泵到他们的公寓。于是，手电筒和 LED 蜡烛派上了用场。Daryna、她的儿子 Kyryll 和女儿 Olena 聚在一起玩了一局 Uno 纸牌游戏，然后就早早入睡了。

paras.en: Twelve-year-old Kyryll, speaking perfect English learned during two years living in the US, is frank about the disruption.
paras.zh: 12岁的基里尔（Kyryll）在美国生活了两年，英语说得很流利，他坦率地谈论了生活被打乱的经历。

paras.en: "There's no light, no water, no heat, no electricity. And no fun. All the fun got sucked out with the electricity," he says. "We have a lot of board games. We have a whole shelf, but we've played them like a hundred thousand times already."
paras.zh: “没有灯光，没有水，没有暖气，没有电。也没有乐趣。所有的乐趣都随着电一起消失了。”他说。“我们有很多棋盘游戏。我们有一整架的棋盘游戏，但我们已经玩过不下十万次了。”

paras.en: Many families sit in the shadows as blackouts sweep entire neighbourhoods, smothering homes and streets in darkness.
paras.zh: 当停电席卷整个街区，使房屋和街道陷入黑暗时，许多家庭只能坐在阴影中。

paras.en: "You look outside and sometimes you see nothing. You have a big city around but you see nothing because there's no light," Daryna says.
paras.zh: “你往外看，有时什么也看不到。你周围是一座大城市，但你什么也看不到，因为没有光。”Daryna说。

paras.en: Kyiv has been worst hit - its metro trains and trolleybuses at times brought to a standstill. Nationwide, hundreds of thousands of Ukrainians have gone without power in recent weeks.
paras.zh: 基辅受到的影响最严重——地铁列车和无轨电车有时会停运。近几周来，乌克兰全国有数十万民众经历过停电。

paras.en: We saw why on a visit to one of Ukraine's largest power stations, barely standing after a recent ballistic missile strike - the most powerful and devastating attack of Russia's campaign against Ukrainian energy targets.
paras.zh: 我们参观了乌克兰最大的发电站之一，亲眼目睹了原因所在。该发电站刚刚遭受了一次弹道导弹袭击，几乎摇摇欲坠。这是俄罗斯针对乌克兰能源目标发动的行动中最猛烈、最具破坏性的袭击。

paras.en: The enormous plant - which we've been asked not to name for security reasons - has been reduced to a pile of twisted metal and broken pipes, its turbines buried in rubble, taking the site completely off line.
paras.zh: 这座巨大的发电厂——出于安全原因，我们被要求不透露其名称——已沦为一堆扭曲的金属和破裂的管道，涡轮机被埋在瓦砾之下，整个厂区已完全瘫痪。

paras.en: Volodymyr Kovalenko was on duty in the control room keeping the plant working when the missiles hit at 3am.
paras.zh: 凌晨3点导弹袭来时，弗拉基米尔·科瓦连科正在控制室值班，负责维持电厂的正常运转。

paras.en: "It was a very powerful attack. We'd never experienced anything like it. We'd had strikes before â part of the roof had collapsed, it was pretty grim. But this time it was particularly severe."
paras.zh: “这是一次非常猛烈的袭击。我们从未经历过这样的事情。我们以前也经历过空袭，屋顶有一部分塌了，情况相当严峻。但这次特别严重。”

paras.en: Kovalenko, who followed in his parents' footsteps and has worked at the site for 25 years, says the damage is heartbreaking, though he's confident it can be repaired.
paras.zh: 科瓦连科追随父母的脚步，在核电站工作了25年。他表示，看到这些破坏令人心碎，但他相信可以修复。

paras.en: But the work is being hampered by air raids every 15-30 minutes â seven times during our four-hour visit. Each warning of drones and further missiles forces teams to down tools and dive for cover, though during our visit all were shot down or flew on towards other targets.
paras.zh: 但每隔15-30分钟就会有一次空袭，工作因此受到阻碍——在我们四小时的探访期间，空袭发生了七次。每次有无人机和更多导弹的警报响起，施工队都不得不放下工具，躲到掩体中。不过，在我们探访期间，所有这些无人机和导弹都被击落或飞向了其他目标。

paras.en: If there isn't time to reach the site's main shelter, the workers hide in the foundations of its towering chimneys.
paras.zh: 如果来不及到达厂区的主避难所，工人就会躲进高耸烟囱的地基中。

paras.en: "It's very difficult," says Vadym Bobyr, who is leading the recovery effort. "You've mentally prepared yourself to do a particular job, and thenâ¦ the air raid siren goes off, and you have to get out as quickly as possible."
paras.zh: “这非常困难，”负责领导恢复工作的瓦迪姆·博比尔（Vadym Bobyr）说道。“你已经在心理上做好准备要完成某项工作，然后……空袭警报响起，你必须尽快撤离。”

paras.en: The 39-year-old, who has worked here half his life, is dwarfed by the mangled ruins and daunted by the challenge of rebuilding the plant.
paras.zh: 这位39岁的男子在这里工作了大半辈子，在满目疮痍的废墟面前显得渺小，重建工厂的艰巨任务令他望而生畏。

paras.en: "It's emotionally difficult, because we've already repaired all this, got it running again, and now it's happened all over again. It hurts, but we keep working and getting things done."
paras.zh: “这在情感上很艰难，因为我们已经修好了所有这些东西，让它们重新运转起来，现在又重蹈覆辙了。这很让人难过，但我们仍要继续工作，把事情做好。”

paras.en: As we speak there's another alert - an incoming Banderol cruise missile.
paras.zh: 就在我们说话的时候，又有一个警报——一枚Banderol巡航导弹正飞来。

paras.en: The workers dart through the maze of passages and pipework but there isn't time to reach a shelter - one of the plant's thickest walls will have to do for cover. The missile was eventually intercepted 5km (3 miles) away.
paras.zh: 工人们穿过错综复杂的通道和管道，但没有时间跑到防空洞——只能以工厂最厚的一堵墙作为掩护。这枚导弹最终在5公里（3英里）外被拦截。

paras.en: Energy workers are at enormous risk. Since August there have been almost daily attacks on power facilities, claiming several lives every week. And it's getting more dangerous.
paras.zh: 能源工人面临着巨大的风险。自8月以来，电力设施几乎每天都遭到袭击，每周都有数人丧生。而且情况正变得越来越危险。

paras.en: On the edge of the site, with the latest threat over, a team returns to reinstating the power lines feeding the national grid. But they won't be carrying electricity from the shattered plant before the end of this winter, at least.
paras.zh: 在厂区边缘，随着最新威胁的解除，一支队伍返回现场，恢复向国家电网输电的输电线路。但至少在今年冬天结束之前，他们不会从这座损毁的电厂输送电力。

paras.en: President Volodymyr Zelensky says Ukraine still has enough generating capacity to meet electricity demand - the problem is getting it to homes and businesses when so many power lines and substations have been hit. Russia is using "waiter drones" that cling to pylons and cables and go undetected until Russia decides to detonate them.
paras.zh: 弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基总统表示，乌克兰仍有足够的发电能力来满足电力需求，问题在于当如此多的输电线路和变电站遭到袭击时，如何将电力输送到家庭和企业。俄罗斯正在使用“伺机型无人机”，它们会附着在输电塔和电缆上，直到俄罗斯决定引爆它们时才会被发现。

paras.en: Maxim Timchenko, CEO of DTEK, Ukraine's largest private energy company, said Russia was already putting the degraded electricity grid under even greater pressure than last year, and that overstretched air defences were unable to protect all of Ukraine's critical infrastructure.
paras.zh: 乌克兰最大私营能源公司DTEK的首席执行官马克西姆·蒂姆琴科（Maxim Timchenko）表示，俄罗斯已经对本已恶化的电网施加了比去年更大的压力，而不堪重负的防空系统无法保护乌克兰的所有关键基础设施。

paras.en: "What is different is the scale of attacks and the different types of weapons used in these attacks. This is what is the difference - they've doubled in power and in scale".
paras.zh: “不同之处在于袭击的规模以及这些袭击中使用的不同类型的武器。这就是区别所在——它们的威力规模都翻了一番。”

paras.en: He said rebuilding the damaged power station would take at least until next summer, because workers under sustained attack were limited to only one or two productive hours per day.
paras.zh: 他说，重建受损的发电站至少要到明年夏天，因为在持续袭击下，工人们每天只能工作一两个小时。

paras.en: "We are fighting for survival of not only the whole country but ordinary people, especially during winter," Timchenko says.
paras.zh: “我们不仅是在为整个国家的生存而战，也是在为普通民众的生存而战，尤其是在冬季。”季姆琴科说。

paras.en: Kovalenko echoes the sense of mission about trying to keep the lights on. "Energy is the foundation of everything - people's lives, the state. Nothing can function without it. I've dedicated my entire life to this".
paras.zh: 科瓦连科也表达了努力维持电力供应的使命感。“能源是一切的基础——人们的生活、国家。没有能源，一切都无法运转。我把毕生精力都奉献给了这项事业。”

paras.en: Many are choosing to leave the capital, or Ukraine altogether, to avoid months of bitter cold. Daryna, Kyryll and Olena know the winter has barely begun.
paras.zh: 许多人选择离开首都，甚至离开乌克兰，以躲避数月的严寒。达琳娜、基里尔和奥莱娜知道，冬天刚刚开始。

paras.en: "It's the worst feeling" Kyryll says. "When I get home from school, I'm tired. I lay in my bed. Bam! Air alarm. Bam! No lights. Bam! A lot of homework. Bam!"
paras.zh: “这是最糟糕的感觉，”Kyryll说。“我放学回家时很累。我躺在床上。突然！防空警报。突然！没电了。哎呀！还有一大堆作业。哎呀！”

paras.en: When the children are in bed Daryna confides her thoughts of moving to somewhere safer, or warmer. She's torn by the desire to stay at home - close to friends and relatives - and the worry of how unbearable life may become.
paras.zh: 孩子们上床睡觉后，达琳娜吐露了自己想搬到更安全或更温暖的地方的想法。她既想留在家里，和亲朋好友待在一起，又担心生活可能会变得难以忍受，因此内心十分矛盾。

paras.en: The strain is damaging her mental health, she tells me, and she fears the impact on Kyryll and Olena, who suffers nightmares. Still, Daryna remains defiant despite the darkness.
paras.zh: 她告诉我，这种压力正在损害她的心理健康，她担心这对基里尔和奥莱娜造成影响，奥莱娜经常做噩梦。尽管如此，Daryna仍旧不屈不挠，无惧黑暗。

paras.en: "I don't want to live without light. But actually people in Ukraine say, OK, without light, but without Russians. Yes, we're scared, we're scared a lot. But better for us to be without power, but [also] without Russians."
paras.zh: “我不想过没有电的生活。但实际上，乌克兰人说，好吧，没有电可以，但不能有俄国人。是的，我们害怕，我们非常害怕。但对我们来说，宁愿没有电，[也不要]有俄国人。”

paras.en: Additional reporting by Anastasiia Levchenko, Kamila Hrabchuk and Daniel Wittenberg
paras.zh: Anastasiia Levchenko、Kamila Hrabchuk和Daniel Wittenberg补充报道

articles.title: Israeli strike on hospital kills at least five Palestinians, Gaza civil defence agency says

paras.en: At least five Palestinians have been killed after an Israeli airstrike hit a building at Nasser Hospital in southern Gaza, an official from the Hamas-run Civil Defence agency has told the BBC.
paras.zh: 哈马斯下属的民防机构的一名官员向BBC透露，在以色列空袭加沙南部纳赛尔医院的一栋建筑后，至少有五名巴勒斯坦人丧生。

paras.en: Eyewitnesses said that a single missile, fired from a warplane that briefly flew over the area, struck a building housing the hospital's surgical wards and intensive care units. Twenty others were injured, the civil defence spokesman said.
paras.zh: 目击者称，一架战机短暂飞越该地区，发射了一枚导弹，击中了医院外科病房和重症监护病房所在的大楼。民防发言人表示，另有20人受伤。

paras.en: A surgeon is reported to be among those who were killed during the strike early on Thursday.
paras.zh: 据报道，周四早些时候的空袭中有一名外科医生遇难。

paras.en: The Israeli military says it struck a senior Hamas member and other militants who were using the hospital "as a command center for military and terrorist activities".
paras.zh: 以色列军方表示，他们袭击了一名哈马斯高级成员和其他武装分子，这些人正在利用该医院“作为军事和恐怖活动的指挥中心”。

paras.en: In a joint statement, the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) and Israel Security Agency (ISA) said that they strongly condemn Hamas exploiting "civilian and medical infrastructure for military purposes".
paras.zh: 以色列国防军（IDF）和以色列安全局（ISA）在一份联合声明中表示，他们强烈谴责哈马斯“将平民和医疗基础设施用于军事目的”。

paras.en: They added that "steps were taken to mitigate harm to civilians, including the use of precision munitions and aerial surveillance".
paras.zh: 他们还表示，“已采取措施来减轻对平民的伤害，包括使用精确制导弹药和空中侦察”。

paras.en: Under international law, hospitals have a protected status, but they have been repeatedly targeted during the Gaza war.
paras.zh: 根据国际法，医院享有受保护的地位，但在加沙战争期间，医院却屡次成为袭击目标。

paras.en: Israel accuses Hamas, which continues to retain its weapons and maintain security control over the Gaza Strip, of using hospitals for military purposes. It says the group stores weapons and runs command and control rooms in hospitals, which Hamas denies.
paras.zh: 以色列指责哈马斯将医院用于军事目的。哈马斯仍保留着武器，并对加沙地带保持着安全控制。以色列称，该组织在医院储存武器并设有指挥和控制室，但哈马斯对此予以否认。

paras.en: Earlier, civil defence spokesperson Mahmoud Basal told news agency AFP that six people had been killed. The BBC is prevented by Israel from reporting independently from inside the Gaza Strip, and is unable to verify details of the incident.
paras.zh: 早些时候，民防发言人马哈茂德·巴萨尔（Mahmoud Basal）告诉法新社，有六人丧生。以色列阻止英国广播公司（BBC）在加沙地带境内独立报道，因此BBC无法核实该事件的细节。

paras.en: Recovery work is carried out by the Civil Defence in Gaza, which operates under the Hamas-run interior ministry. Its efforts have been supported by the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC).
paras.zh: 遗体挖掘工作由加沙的民防部门开展，该部门隶属于哈马斯领导的内政部。其工作得到了红十字国际委员会（红十字委员会）的支持。

paras.en: Videos shared by activists showed thick smoke inside the building and extensive destruction on the second floor, where medical equipment and beds had been scattered by the blast.
paras.zh: 活动人士分享的视频显示，大楼内浓烟滚滚，二楼遭到大规模破坏，爆炸导致医疗设备和病床散落一地。

paras.en: Local activists have also circulated claims that the strike may have targeted a senior Hamas security figure who was hiding inside the building.
paras.zh: 当地活动人士还散布消息称，这次空袭的目标可能是藏身于该建筑物内的一名哈马斯高级安全官员。

paras.en: Speaking to reporters in the aftermath of the strike, the director of Nasser Medical Complex said the building had been hit in a vertical strike, causing extensive damage to the intensive care and surgical departments for both men and women.
paras.zh: 纳赛尔医疗综合体主任在空袭结束后向记者表示，该建筑遭到垂直空袭，导致男女重症监护科和外科受到严重破坏。

paras.en: Nasser Hospital, the largest in southern Gaza, was hit by a double Israeli strike in August 2025, which killed at least 20 people, including journalists and health workers.
paras.zh: 2025年8月，加沙南部最大的纳赛尔医院遭到以色列的双重空袭，造成至少20人死亡，其中包括记者和医护人员。

paras.en: Israeli strikes on Gaza have continued despite a ceasefire agreement in October last year. More than 1,600 people have been killed since then, according to Gaza's Hamas-run health ministry, whose figures are considered reliable by the UN.
paras.zh: 尽管去年10月达成了停火协议，但以色列对加沙的空袭仍在继续。据加沙由哈马斯掌控的卫生部称，自那以后已有超过1600人丧生，联合国认为该部的数据是可靠的。

paras.en: Israel and Hamas have accused each other of violating the ceasefire.
paras.zh: 以色列和哈马斯相互指责对方违反停火协议。

paras.en: The humanitarian crisis in Gaza has also worsened from recent heavy rains that reportedly flooded tens of thousands of tents that were housing displaced families.
paras.zh: 加沙的人道主义危机也因最近的暴雨而加剧，据报道，暴雨淹没了数万顶帐篷，这些帐篷是流离失所家庭的住所。

paras.en: The Gaza war was triggered by the Hamas-led attack on southern Israel on 7 October 2023, when about 1,200 people were killed and 251 others were taken hostage.
paras.zh: 加沙战争是由哈马斯领导的对以色列南部的袭击引发的，袭击发生在2023年10月7日，造成约1200人死亡，另有251人被劫持为人质。

paras.en: Since then, more than 74,645 people have been killed in Gaza, the health ministry says.
paras.zh: 加沙卫生部表示，自那以后，已有超过74645人丧生。

articles.title: How Paper-Based Friction Materials Power Modern Machinery

paras.en: How Paper-Based Friction Materials Power Modern Machinery

Have you ever wondered what enables everything from roaring construction machinery to agricultural machinery plowing the fields to industrial equipment shuttling through factories—the precise starting, smooth operation, and reliable braking they achieve?

The answer lies in a seemingly insignificant yet crucial core component: friction material. It acts as the "safety guard" and "power link" of machinery, ensuring every brake is safe and effective, and every power transmission is smooth and flawless.

Among the vast family of friction materials, wet friction materials are becoming the new favorite in modern machinery due to their exceptional reliability, safety, and exceptionally long lifespan. Among wet materials, paper-based friction materials stand out as a leading force thanks to their excellent overall performance, cost-effectiveness, and broad application prospects.
Today, let's delve deeper into the fascinating world of this "unsung hero"—paper-based friction materials.
What is Paper-Based Friction Material? — A Sponge-Like Power Core
Imagine a "sponge" with countless tiny pores—that's the most intuitive image of paper-based friction material.

It is a material with a reticular porous structure composed of three core components: reinforcing fibers, functional fillers, and a binder resin. This unique structure gives it extraordinary capabilities:
- Oil Storage Capacity: The porous structure acts like a miniature "oil depot," capable of storing large quantities of lubricant.

- Dynamic Lubrication: When the friction plate and mating plate engage and are subjected to pressure, the lubricant within the material is instantly squeezed onto the friction surface, forming a tough lubricant film, enabling smooth, gentle "wet" friction.
- Self-Recovery: When the friction plates separate, the material rebounds like memory foam, "absorbing" the lubricant back into the pores, ready for the next operation.

It is this dynamic cycle of "oil storage-oil squeezing-oil return" that allows paper-based friction materials to perform well in an oil bath environment, achieving a perfect combination of high durability and stable friction performance.
Exploring Core Performance: How Do Three Key Factors Affect It?

The performance of paper-based friction materials is not static. Like a top athlete, its performance is influenced by the "field," "equipment," and "condition." Let's examine how these three key factors shape its performance.
Factor 1: The "Stage Effect" of Lubricants

Paper-based friction materials are highly sensitive to lubricants, and different lubricants create distinct "stages" for their performance. Even the same friction material can exhibit significantly different friction characteristics (especially the kinetic friction coefficient) when exposed to different lubricants.
Figure 1: Kinetic friction coefficient curve for a paper-based friction material in gear oil
Figure 2: Dynamic friction coefficient curve of the same material in hydraulic oil

Interpretation: The above chart clearly shows that the same material behaves very differently in gear oil and hydraulic fluid. Furthermore, various additives added to lubricating oils (such as dispersants and anti-wear agents) can interact complexly with the material surface, further affecting its friction properties. Therefore, choosing the right oil for paper-based friction materials is the first step in achieving optimal performance.
Density is a trump card for paper-based friction materials. It is directly related to the material's porosity, leading to a delicate balancing act in terms of performance.

High density (low porosity) means a denser material, resulting in better strength and thermal conductivity, lower wear rate, and longer life. However, the downside is reduced oil storage capacity, which can lead to a lower coefficient of friction and compromise power transmission.

Low density (high porosity) means the material is more porous, resulting in greater oil storage capacity and a higher coefficient of friction, which can provide greater braking force or transmit torque. However, the downside is reduced mechanical strength and wear resistance, shortening service life.
Figure 3: Comparison of the dynamic coefficient of friction for materials of varying densities (Type 2 to Type 6, increasing density)
Figure 4: Comparison of wear rates of materials with different densities

Interpretation: Figures 3 and 4 vividly illustrate this balancing act. There's no such thing as absolute good or bad, only suitability. When selecting a paper-based friction material, the optimal trade-off between friction coefficient and durability must be determined based on specific application requirements (e.g., high torque versus long life).
Factor 3: Extreme Challenges of Operating Conditions

In addition to oil type and density, actual operating conditions, such as surface pressure, sliding speed, and oil temperature, pose extreme challenges to paper-based friction materials. These factors directly affect the temperature of the friction interface, the thickness and stability of the oil film, and thus dynamically alter the coefficient of friction.

Therefore, please remember: the coefficient of friction of a particular paper-based friction material is not a fixed value, but rather a performance range determined through extensive and repeated testing under specific operating conditions.
Broad Applications: Injecting a Powerful "Heart" into Machinery

Thanks to its excellent overall performance and customizability, Carlisle Brake & Friction's paper-based friction materials have been successfully applied to the core components of various heavy-duty machinery, becoming their powerful and reliable "heart."
We understand that different machines and applications require significantly different friction materials. For example:
- Service brakes for construction machinery (such as excavators and loaders) require materials that provide a stable, powerful braking force under high loads to ensure safety.
- Powershift transmissions for agricultural machinery (such as tractors) require materials that provide smooth engagement and excellent heat resistance to handle frequent shifting.
- Clutches for industrial machinery require materials that respond quickly and have a long lifespan to ensure continuous and efficient operation of production lines.

To this end, Carlisle Brake & Friction has developed a series of special paper-based friction materials for different application scenarios, providing each customer with the most suitable and reliable solution.
Continuous Innovation, Driving the Future
Technological advancement is endless. To meet increasingly demanding application requirements and broaden market prospects, Carlisle Brake & Friction remains at the forefront of innovation.

We are not only continuously optimizing the formulation and processing of paper-based friction materials to push their performance limits, but are also actively exploring next-generation wet friction materials with even higher performance. These R&D efforts have made significant progress, aiming to provide global customers with more diverse and advanced options, driving the infinite possibilities of future machinery.

articles.title: Milwaukee Tool Named Exclusive National Tool Partner of Be Pro Be Proud
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Be Pro Be Proud has named Milwaukee Tool its exclusive National Tool Partner, bringing professional-grade tools and technology into interactive career exploration experiences designed to introduce students across the country to opportunities in the skilled trades.

Through the partnership, Milwaukee Tool products will be integrated into Be Pro Be Proud’s Mobile Workshops, virtual reality (VR) simulators and student recognition events. Students will gain exposure to the tools and technology used in skilled trades careers, including carpentry, electrical work, heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC), plumbing, water technology and diesel technology.

“A career feels real when a student can picture themselves doing the work,” said Andrew Parker, executive director of Be Pro Be Proud. “With Milwaukee Tool, we’re integrating industry-leading equipment into our Mobile Workshops, making career exploration more tangible and engaging while helping students envision a future in a high-demand technical profession.”

The investment will help enhance Be Pro Be Proud’s VR simulators, aligning the virtual tools students use with actual Milwaukee Tool products across six career modules. Milwaukee Tool equipment will also be integrated into Mobile Workshop experiences, including the National Mobile Workshop scheduled to launch in 2027.

The partnership will also extend to student recognition events, including Signing Days and Draft Days, where selected students will receive Milwaukee Tool products as they take the next steps toward careers in the skilled trades.

“The future of our industry depends on inspiring more young people to see what’s possible in the skilled trades,” said Scott Teson, senior vice president of Jobsite Solutions for Milwaukee Tool. “Milwaukee has built our business around understanding the people who work in these professions and developing solutions that help them succeed. Through Be Pro Be Proud, we’re helping students experience that innovation firsthand and discover rewarding career paths they may never have considered.”

The partnership builds on Milwaukee Tool’s broader commitment to strengthening America’s skilled trades workforce. The company expects to invest $200 million in U.S. skilled trades workforce development by 2030, supporting initiatives that introduce young people to the trades and help equip the next generation of skilled professionals.

Since launching in 2016, Be Pro Be Proud has reached more than 600,000 students nationally through its Mobile Workshops, which introduce students to technical careers across construction, manufacturing, transportation, and utilities.
For more information on Be Pro Be Proud, visit beprobeproud.org.

articles.title: IDEAS Collide: What would you do if vehicles stopped crashing?
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: What if advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) prevent collisions entirely, eliminating vehicle crashes? How would you bring business into your shop?

That was the food for thought from Justin Allen, Hunter Engineering regional trainer, one of seven speakers in this year’s Society of Collision Repair Specialists (SCRS) IDEAS Collide Showcase. The showcase was held Nov. 4 during this year’s SEMA Show in Las Vegas.
Allen encourages collision repair shops to be proactive and use their imagination so they’re prepared if business slows drastically.

“We’re in a major time of disruption,” Allen said. “I don’t think anybody would argue with that idea. ADAS stuff is changing the game. It’s changing the trade, changing the things we have to be prepared for.

“Currently, we’re dependent upon vehicles colliding with things, trees, houses, cars… When did that start happening? 135 years ago. So the collision business has been active for a long, long time. 1891 was the first time that occurred. And when did they start crashing even more? …the advent of that doggone cell phone. It’s not just for selfies; it’s for distractions while driving.”
Allen shared that by the early 2000s, more than 50% of households had cell phones, noting that now, everybody’s got one in their pocket.
Comparatively, only about a third of vehicles on the road use ADAS technology, he said.

“What does it mean for us that ADAS technology is getting better? We know fewer vehicles are actually being in collisions,” Allen said. “There’s more technology required… That’s creating more costs and repairs, and yet there’s more total vehicles. There’s an evolution occurring; change is taking place. We just get to decide what on Earth are we going to do about it?”
Allen suggests shops think of work to bring in-house rather than subletting.

“I want to encourage you to choose excitement,” he said. “You’ve got an opportunity to not be worried about what’s going to change in a negative direction. How can we capitalize on some good things going on here? Certainly, the automotive industry as a whole is struggling to get people to do the good work, so there’s no shortage of opportunity to bring some of that good work in-house. I don’t know exactly what it is, but I know that we can do it.
“It’s an interesting time. Make the most of it. Let’s strategize. Let’s be proactive. …Let’s not get caught unprepared.”
Featured image: Justin Allen of Hunter Engineering speaks during the 2026 SCRS IDEAS Collide Showcase on Nov. 4. (Lurah Lowery/Repairer Driven News)

articles.title: Texas adopts final right to appraisal rules with changes following comments
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: The Texas Department of Insurance (TDI) has adopted its final appraisal rules with some changes after receiving more than 1,000 letters from Texans, according to the TDI Advocates website ran by Auto Claims Specialists.

Changes include giving the insured the right to choose the umpire selection method at the time of dispute. Another change gives the insured the contractual option to seek judicial appointment of an umpire.
TDI’s original proposed rule received pushback from the collision industry and consumers who said it stripped the bill of proponents’ intentions.
The state Legislature passed a right to appraisal (RTA) bill last year. The bill directs TDI to adopt rules for the code change.

Robert McDorman, Auto Claims Specialists’ general manager and Auto Body Assocation of Texas (ABAT) representative, previously told RDN that the proposed rule removed the consumer’s judicial right to have a court-appointed umpire.

The proposed rule authorized insurers to include, in addition to judicial appointment, other methods of umpire appointment. A TDI explanation said that some residential property appraisal provisions currently provide for the umpire to be chosen by an independent vendor if the appraisers cannot agree.
According to the explanation, the insurer would have to include at least two vendors and let the policyholder select the vendor or allow only the policyholder to invoke this option.
Auto Claims Specialists’ campaigned for four changes to the proposed rule. Two of the four changes were made by TDI prior to approval.

One of the changes not adopted by TDI would have required insurers to disclose financial relationships with listed vendors in the policy. The other change not adopted would have required that if a vendor mechanism was used, the insurer bears the full cost, not the insured.

“TDI declined to shift vendor or umpire costs to insurers and declined to cap umpire fees, saying the policyholder-only trigger for the vendor option already addresses the cost and fairness concern,” TDI Advocates’ webpage states.
Insurance companies have until March 1, 2027, to comply with the new rule.

articles.title: BodyShop Marketing CEO gives three tips for marketing to AI during IDEAS Collide
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Daniel Burkholder, BodyShop Marketing CEO and founder, provided three steps collision shops can take to help AI apps recommend their business to consumers during the SCRS IDEAS Collide showcase at the 2026 SEMA Show in Las Vegas.
AI is changing the way that consumers find collision shops, Burkholder said. He said for 20 years or more, the game has been ranking.
This included getting on the map pack and learning search engine optimization (SEO), he said.
“I’m going to tell you right now that it’s not wasted,” he said. “That is the foundation. But we now have a new layer on top.”
He added that this isn’t the first time technology has changed marketing.
“How many of you remember the good old Yellow Pages?” Burkholder asked the crowd.
It was replaced with Google and search engines, he added. Another change happened with mobile devices and then Google and Apple maps revolutionized how people search.
“AI is the next big one,” he said. “I would dare say it’s bigger than all the others put together in how people are going to find your shop someday and how people are finding your shop today.”
AI is now doing the heavy lifting for customers, Burkholder said.

“They [consumers] don’t have to go to your website,” he said. “They don’t have to see your reviews. You have people that are calling you that may have never seen your website or your reviews. They might not even know your name. They’re just calling because their AI said that’s the thing to do.”
Answer engine optimization (AEO) is a new term being used, he said.
“SEO helps to get you into the list, AEO helps to get you into the answer, and you need both of those at this point,” Burkholder added.
Consumers are no longer asking simple searches, he said. He explained they are asking longer, conversational types of searches.
“Do I have to use the shop my insurance recommends?” he gave as an example. “I was just in an accident with my Honda Civic, what’s the best Honda repair shop near me.”
AI tends to ask for more information. This could include what insurance carrier they use and what vehicle needs to be repaired.
AI only knows what is written about your shop, he said.
“AI goes out and starts doing the research for these customers,” Burkholder said. “If your website has the answers to these questions, you become the authority.”
Burkholder provided an example of a statement found on a collision shop website: “We offer full-service collision repair with state-of-the-art equipment and a commitment to quality.”
AI learns nothing from the statement, he said.
In another example, the statement said, “We repair Honda, Toyota and Subaru vehicles at our downtown Las Vegas shop. Every repair follows the manufacturer’s procedures.”
The two sentences provide examples of makes that are repaired at the shop, the location and a repair standard.
“The best scenario is having a web page for each of your services, so you can give very thorough, in-depth content to AI so it fully understands what you do,” Burkholder said.

Audience members were asked to test whether AI can find them by telling their favorite app that they had just been in an accident and then asking what the best repair shop is in the city their shop is located.
Many responded that AI did refer to their shop.
For those whom AI didn’t mention, Burkholder gave these three tips:
The answers to the questions that consumers are asking your front desk, should be on your website, he said. He said consumers are asking the same questions of AI.
“If you have those answers on your website, it gives the authority to your website when AI goes looking,” Burkholder said.
Information such as your business name and phone number should be the same on Google, Carwise, your website and Yelp, he said.
ABC Collision on one site and ABC Collision Center on another site look like two different shops to a machine, he said.
“AI trusts what others say about you more than what you say about yourself,” Burkholder said.
Automakers listing a shop as a certified shop on their website can help AI recommend a shop, he said.
Customer reviews also play a role in how AI sees you, he said.

“I’m not going to give you any to-do list,” he said. “You have plenty of those. But when you get back home, I’d like you to just pull up your website and find one big sentence and start with one sentence, and then rewrite it so a machine knows what you fix, where you fix it, and why you’re qualified to fix it.”
For a free AI visibility check visit https://aicheck.bodyshopmarketing.io/
Daniel Burkholder, BodyShop Marketing CEO and founder, speaks during IDEAS Collide at the 2026 SEMA Show in Las Vegas. (Lurah Lowery/RDN)

articles.title: Are You Retorquing Lug Nuts?
articles.author: Christian Hinton

paras.en: The new tires are installed, but the job may not be finished. A lug nut torque check after about 30 miles helps verify that wheel fasteners remain tightened to the vehicle manufacturer’s specifications.

During installation, technicians should tighten every lug nut in the proper sequence and to the specified torque. After approximately 30 miles of driving, customers should return for a recommended torque check.
Why a Lug Nut Torque Check Is Recommended
Once the vehicle returns to the road, normal driving forces can reveal whether the wheel and fasteners have fully settled.
During the follow-up inspection, technicians should check each lug nut for movement. They should bring any fastener back to the correct torque only if needed.
This quick follow-up supports a secure wheel installation and provides customers with additional peace of mind.

articles.title: The A6MF1 Transmission: How It Works
articles.author: Wayne Colonna

paras.en: Originally, due to how inexpensive it was to buy a reman transmission from Hyundai or Kia, rebuilding and A6MF1 transmission didn’t make sense. But lately, the cost to buy one from Hyundai has been increasing. Between this and the fact that these transmissions getting older, it’s beginning to make sense to take on a rebuild.

Using a component application chart to assist in diagnosing whether this transmission (Figure 1, above) needs to be disassembled for an internal inspection, there is an aspect to its operation that needs to be clarified (see Figure 2).

Notice how the low/reverse brake clutch is on during the initial launch of the vehicle. After approximately 5 MPH, it turns off, allowing the low one-way clutch to hold. There are two reasons for this. The first is that the low/reverse brake provides additional holding during the torque required to launch the vehicle from a stop. The second is that it provides a non-sequential shift from first to second and most importantly, from second to first. This eliminates coast downshift bumps and clunks.

Sequential shifts rely heavily on adaptation to control both upshifts and downshifts in timing the proper kiss point of the off-coming and on-coming clutch. With it being non-sequential, the shifts are smoother. Knowing this can assist in diagnosing a harsh 1-2 upshift, for example. Since it is a non-sequential upshift, we know it is not due to an adaption issue; it is due to either a faulty variable force solenoid controlling the apply of the clutch, or there is a mechanical fault of some kind. In most cases, it is a faulty solenoid.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: One question to ask is: which solenoid turns the low/reverse brake on and off? Looking at a solenoid application chart loke the one shown in Figure 3, you can see that there is no specifically designated solenoid for the low/reverse brake.

However, notice how the solenoid which controls the overdrive clutch is a normally high solenoid. This means when it is off, the clutch is on. When it is turned on, the clutch turns off. And these are variable force solenoids so they duty cycle control the rate of apply and release of the clutch. And the overdrive solenoid is initially off in first gear applying a clutch and then turns on at approximately 6 MPH. This suggests that the overdrive solenoid is in some way controlling the apply and release of the low/reverse clutch. How can the overdrive solenoid double as the low/reverse solenoid?
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Looking again at the solenoid application chart in Figure 3, notice how shift solenoid A is on in Park, Reverse, Neutral and first gear. Also notice that the overdrive solenoid is off during these times. When looking at the component application in Figure 2, it shows that the low/reverse brake is applied during these times. This clearly shows that shift solenoid A is responsible for enabling the overdrive solenoid to double as a low/reverse solenoid.
Figure 4 is a partial hydraulic schematic showing first gear before 5 MPH.

In this hydraulic, you can trace shift solenoid A output pressure in brown going to a valve in the valve body called the OD/LR Shift Valve. This allows the overdrive solenoid output pressure (when the solenoid is off), to be routed to the low/reverse brake. The hydraulic schematic shown in Figure 5 shows shift solenoid A turning off while the overdrive solenoid turns on releasing the apply of the low/reverse clutch, allowing the low one-way clutch to hold before a 1-2 shift. And with the OD/LR shift valve closed, it is ready for the overdrive solenoid to duty cycle off to apply the overdrive clutch in fourth gear.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: There is a failsafe built into the hydraulics to safeguard against shift solenoid A failing when it is on. This could cause a shift into first when fourth gear is commanded. Without this failsafe, at this speed, the driver will be kissing the steering wheel. And if someone is driving close behind, the gap between the two cars will close quickly.
Figure 6 is a partial hydraulic showing one aspect of the failsafe valve in how it provides line pressure to the spring side of the OD/LR Shift Valve to ensure it stays closed.
However, if shift solenoid A fails closed, this can cause a fourth gear start and, at 6 MPH, it will drop to first gear.
These are some insights to the way this transmission functions to assist in diagnostics.

articles.title: Understanding Mercedes-Benz TPMS
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: On different Mercedes-Benz models, you will see two types of TPMS systems. Low-line systems do not display individual tire pressures – these systems just monitor inflation and alert the driver if there is an under-inflation or over-inflation problem with one antenna. Mid-line systems display the individual pressures, and some systems have four antennas mounted near the wheel wells.

Low-line systems can’t detect a low tire pressure until the sensors in the wheels are activated by movement. Mid-line systems can “poke” the sensors with a low-frequency radio signal to get them to transmit information when the vehicle is first started or when prompted by the phone app. But, both systems use the wheel speed sensor to detect a sudden loss of pressure when the vehicle is moving.

Mercedes-Benz and other German vehicle manufacturers make the assumption that people here in the U.S. adjust their tire pressure for the number of people in the vehicle and for the speed they intend to drive. They include the U.S. DOT-mandated tire pressure placard on the driver’s side door jamb, but also behind the gas filler door is the “Luftdruck” sticker, which gives the recommended tire pressure.

This sticker allows the driver set the correct tire pressure for the load and type of driving. If the driver intends to drive at 100 mph with four people in the vehicle, the sticker will advise them to add four more PSI in some cases. This mentality is also part of German tire pressure monitoring systems (TPMS) that require a reference pressure to set during a relearn.

Like all TPMS vehicles, the TPMS light illuminates continuously if one or more of the tires is significantly under or overinflated. If the TPMS light flashes for 60 seconds and then stays illuminated, the TPMS system itself is not operating properly and further diagnostics should be performed. If a condition causing the TPMS to malfunction develops, it may take up to 10 minutes for the system to start flashing a TPMS light.

With almost all Mercedes-Benz vehicles, you should use an auto relearn procedure that is activated by menus in the instrument cluster. The proper menu can vary by model. But, no matter the model or system, always inflate the tires to the recommended pressure before starting any relearn or reset procedure.

When the vehicle is in the restart mode, it is listening for the sensors. During this time, it is looking for the four or five signals that occur on the test drive to determine if a signal is coming from one of the sensors on the vehicle. The tires need to be set at the correct pressure first. This is called the “reference pressure” by Mercedes. If the inflation is not properly set, it could cause the tire pressure alert to come on.

When the restart mode is activated, the display should read, “Tire Pressure Monitor Active,” or “Adopt Current Pressures as New Guidance Values.” Press OK to accept the new values. Or, the display will then issue the message “Use Current Pressures as New Reference Values.” Press OK and then it should show the message, “Tire Press Monitor Restarted.”

Drive the vehicle for at least 10 minutes as the system verifies that the current tire inflation pressures are within the specified range. During the drive, the current tire inflation pressures are accepted as reference values and inflation changes are based on this value.

Mid-line systems will typically require less time to restart or relearn a sensor’s position and start to display pressure values. Low-line systems may require at least 10 minutes of driving to complete the restart.
If a relearn process can’t be completed, use a TPMS tool to activate a sensor to make sure it is active and transmitting. If not, replace the sensor.

articles.title: Autel Awards Five Automotive Education Scholarships
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Autel announced five recipients of its second annual Awarding Excellence Scholarships. The scholarships are part of Autel Cares, the company’s philanthropic initiative supporting automotive education and community causes.
The 2026 program awards five $5,000 scholarships, totaling $25,000. The awards support students pursuing education and training in automotive repair and service.
Recipients can use the scholarships for tuition, tools, books, supplies and other education-related expenses. The students are preparing for careers in the automotive repair industry.
This year, Autel expanded eligibility beyond recent high school graduates. Adult learners returning to school or transitioning from another career also qualified.

The 2026 recipients represent students at different stages of life and training. Their interests include automotive technology, collision repair, manufacturer-level service and automotive cybersecurity.

“Last year, selecting our first scholarship recipients was difficult. This year was even more challenging because we received so many outstanding applications from students with compelling stories, clear goals, and a genuine commitment to automotive education,” said Chloe Hung, CEO of Autel U.S.

“The five recipients selected this year reflect the many different paths people take into the automotive repair industry, from students beginning their training to adults continuing or returning to school. Autel is proud to support their education and invest in the skilled professionals who will help shape the future of automotive repair.”
The 2026 Autel Awarding Excellence Scholarship recipients are:

- Shawn Clark, of Deer Lodge, Montana, attends Highlands College of Montana Tech. Clark is beginning a new chapter in automotive education at age 50. He is pursuing an associate degree in automotive technology. His application reflects this year’s expanded eligibility for adult learners returning to school. Clark plans to build a new career in automotive repair.

- Jacob Heinrichs, of Austin, Texas, attends Universal Technical Institute of Texas Inc. Heinrichs already works in the field and has three years of experience as an automotive technician. His selection reflects Autel’s support for working technicians seeking additional training. Heinrichs aims to advance his skills and career opportunities.

- Marisa Rueger, of Harleysville, Pennsylvania, attends Automotive Training Center-Warminster. Rueger is pursuing collision repair and holds a 4.0 GPA. In her application, she described collision repair as her art. She also emphasized her desire to continue learning, growing and succeeding in the field.

- Logan Mercier, of Claremont, California, attends Universal Technical Institute of California Inc. Mercier aims to complete school with a 4.0 GPA. He also plans to build advanced diagnostic skills and work toward becoming a master technician. His application focuses on academic achievement, professional growth and building a career in automotive repair.

- Kristof Adam, of Stillwater, Minnesota, attends Century College. Adam is pursuing a career in automotive cybersecurity. He has a strong interest in hands-on vehicle work and advanced automotive technology. His application highlights the growing importance of technical education as vehicles become more connected, complex and software-driven.
Applicants submitted either a 500- to 600-word essay or a two- to three-minute video. They described the path that led them to pursue automotive repair education.
Applicants also explained how the scholarship would support their training. They discussed their goals, obstacles and planned careers in the automotive repair industry.

articles.title: Understanding the Tesla FSD System
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: Tesla’s Full Self-Driving (FSD) system can steer, accelerate, brake, change lanes and navigate many roads, but the driver remains responsible for the vehicle. Technicians will need to keep this in mind because a customer report may describe either an expected operating limitation or a condition that needs diagnosis.

System behavior also varies by model, year, hardware and software version. FSD is available on some Cybertruck, Model 3, Model S, Model X, and Model Y vehicles. Always confirm the applicable VIN-specific service information before performing service.

FSD (Supervised) uses the vehicle’s cameras to build a model of the surrounding area. The vehicle’s computer processes that input and uses it to make driving decisions. Depending on the software and vehicle configuration, FSD can follow road curves, respond to traffic lights and stop signs, make turns, change lanes, navigate highway ramps and roundabouts, and follow a route to a destination. The touchscreen displays a visualization of some detected road users and objects, but that display is not a complete representation of every input the system uses.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The driver can set a destination or allow the vehicle to select a likely route. Speed-profile settings influence speed and lane-change frequency. FSD can be engaged from a stop or while driving, subject to system availability and vehicle conditions. During operation, it may slow for traffic, stop at traffic controls, maneuver around a vehicle partially blocking the lane when space allows, and make lane changes without requiring driver confirmation. The driver can intervene at any time by steering, braking, accelerating or disengaging the system.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The cabin camera monitors driver attentiveness while FSD is engaged. If the system detects repeated inattention or the driver does not respond to prompts, it can issue escalating warnings and suspend access. Repeated ignored warnings may count as strikeouts and temporarily disable FSD. A driver-initiated disengagement is expected and is not, by itself, improper use.

Before diagnosing a complaint, establish what the vehicle was doing, where it was, the software version, the selected speed profile, the camera and road conditions, and whether the driver received a warning. Confirm that the system was enabled and available, and inspect the touchscreen for messages. Check for clean, unobstructed cameras and current map data. Rain, snow, fog, direct sun, darkness, faded lane markings and camera obstruction can limit performance. A rear-mounted hitch accessory, bike rack or trailer may block a camera or degrade function.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Some unavailability is expected. FSD may not engage if the driver is not seated with the seat belt fastened, a door or frunk is open, a charge cable is connected, the tailgate is down, or the vehicle is in a mode that restricts the feature. On the Cybertruck, headlights must be set to On or Auto; FSD may disengage or be unavailable if they are Off. A camera obstruction or incomplete calibration can also prevent use.

FSD may need immediate driver intervention on narrow roads, at complex intersections, around construction, during unprotected turns with fast cross traffic, in heavy-traffic merges, near debris, or when road curvature is high. Interactions with pedestrians, cyclists and other road users can also require intervention. The vehicle may brake, steer or change lanes unexpectedly, even when conditions appear straightforward. Visibility is especially important, and poor weather or lighting can significantly degrade performance.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: A complaint that the system is unavailable during one of these conditions may reflect a limitation rather than a failed component. The same may be true if the driver was repeatedly prompted to look at the road, apply slight steering force or take over. If FSD disengages, the driver should receive an alert and chime; determine whether the reported event was a normal disengagement, a warning that went unanswered, or a repeatable fault.

Do not dismiss every report of unexpected behavior as normal. Tesla’s warnings require the driver to supervise, but they do not establish that every maneuver is acceptable. Ask for the exact location, route, road markings, signal state, weather and time of day. Check available vehicle alerts, camera status, calibration state, software and service history. A report of proceeding against a red light, entering an opposing lane or taking a wrong-way turn deserves careful documentation and escalation under applicable service procedures.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: One note: NHTSA opened a preliminary evaluation in October 2025 covering an estimated 2.88 million FSD-equipped vehicles after reports of traffic-law violations, including red-light entry and travel against the proper direction. The agency said it would assess FSD’s ability to detect signals, lane markings and wrong-way signs, along with the warnings and response time provided to drivers. NHTSA notes that an investigation is not a recall determination.
Camera Calibration and the 100-Mile Drive

Camera calibration may be required before some self-driving features are available for the first time or after certain repairs. Cybertruck owner information says calibration usually completes after about 20 to 25 miles, although distance varies with conditions. Clear lane markings, multiple visible lanes, a straight road and light traffic help the process complete. The manual recommends a multi-lane highway, preferably with several lanes and clear markings.

After camera or windshield service, or if a camera has shifted from its calibrated position, the procedure directs the technician to clear calibration through Controls > Service > Camera Calibration > Clear Calibration. The vehicle then repeats its self-calibration process while being driven. Confirm the camera and windshield installation, camera view and relevant service work before the road test; clearing calibration does not correct a physical obstruction or misaligned camera.

Monitor the touchscreen for calibration progress and feature-availability messages. If calibration has not completed after approximately 100 miles driven in suitable conditions, the Cybertruck owner information says to schedule service. Treat 100 miles as the point at which continued failure merits diagnosis. The menu path, conditions and calibration logic can vary by model and software, so verify the procedure for the vehicle being serviced.

Calibration is not a substitute for verifying camera position. If the camera or windshield was replaced, inspect the mounting and optical path and follow the applicable service procedure. A camera that is physically out of specification may repeatedly fail to calibrate or provide unreliable input even after the software calibration has been cleared.

The supplied forward-facing camera pitch procedure is labeled a draft, although it says it has been validated. Confirm the latest procedure and applicability by VIN before starting; do not treat its steps as universal to every Tesla model.

If performing this adjustment on a Cybertruck, the procedure calls for setting ride height to Medium, placing the vehicle in Service Mode, unlocking the Gateway and parking on a flat surface with at least 3.5 feet of clearance in front. Position the camera calibration target against the front fascia, centered on the vehicle, with its bottom 3 feet from the ground. Verify the target is level, then apply red tape at the specified 165-centimeter reference height.

In the touchscreen’s Service Mode, open Driver Assist > Cameras > Camera Preview > Pitch Verification > Main Camera > Wide Camera. Review the main and wide camera images. The top of the tape should align with the blue horizontal line; if it falls between the green lines, pitch is within specification.

If adjustment is required, remove the rearview-mirror beauty cover. The procedure then directs the technician to clear camera calibration, reset DAS and ping DAS using the specified Service Mode Plus functions, followed by adjustment with the pitch-adjustment wrench. Clockwise rotation pitches the camera upward; counterclockwise rotation pitches it downward. Tesla’s procedure states that one rotation can change pitch by approximately 0.5 to 1.5 degrees. Re-check the camera images and repeat the adjustment until the reference falls within the green lines. Reinstall the cover, remove the target, exit Service Mode and complete any required calibration. Use the specified tools and follow the full current procedure, including its safety precautions.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Two recalls are especially relevant to FSD and camera service. In 2023, recall 23V-085 covered certain Model S, Model X, Model 3 and Model Y vehicles equipped with FSD Beta. The recall addressed certain driving maneuvers that could violate traffic laws or customs; Tesla’s remedy was an over-the-air software update. Recall 23V-489 covered certain 2023 Model S, Model X and Model Y vehicles with forward-facing camera pitch outside specification, which could make certain active-safety features unavailable without alerting the driver. The remedy was inspection and, if needed, pitch adjustment. Check recall status by VIN and confirm completion before diagnosing related complaints.

articles.title: Top 5 Suspension Problems That Shops and DIYers Commonly Misdiagnose
articles.author: TrakMotive

paras.en: Struts, racks, and alignments get blamed for a lot of problems they didn’t cause. In many cases the real cause is a worn chassis part: a sway bar link, a ball joint, a tie rod end, a control arm bushing, or a strut mount. Here are five common misdiagnoses, and how to find the part that’s actually worn.
- A clunk over bumps blamed on struts or shocks

Worn struts usually make a vehicle bouncy or floaty. They rarely clunk. One of the most common sources is a sway bar end link or sway bar bushing, which is a much cheaper part. Worn strut mounts, ball joints, and control arm bushings are also common culprits. A loose exhaust hanger or heat shield can sound like any of them. To find it, grab each end link and try to twist it with the car on the ground. Then have a helper rock the car while you listen and feel at each component.
An alignment that checks out but still pulls is a common source of comebacks. Before you re-align, rule out these causes. Two of them are worn chassis parts:
- Radial tire pull: if swapping the front tires left to right reverses the pull, the tire is the cause.
- A sticking brake caliper: after a drive, one wheel will be noticeably hotter than the other.
- A worn lower control arm bushing: it lets the wheel shift under braking or acceleration.
- A binding strut mount: it causes “memory steer,” where the car pulls in the direction of the last turn.
3. Loose steering or wander blamed on the steering rack

Play at the wheel often comes from somewhere else: a ball joint, control arm bushings, or a worn wheel bearing. How you check matters. Grab the tire at 9 and 3 o’clock and rock it. Play points to tie rods or the rack. Play when you rock it at 12 and 6 points to ball joints or a wheel bearing. Have a helper watch each joint so you can see where the movement actually is. When checking ball joints, remember that a load-carrying joint has to be unloaded before its play will show. If the coil spring sits on the lower control arm, support the lower arm near the joint. On strut designs, lift by the frame. When the spring sits on the upper arm, lift by the frame and wedge a block between the upper arm and the frame. Lifting at the wrong point can hide the wear. If the joint has a wear indicator, use it.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: 4. Tire wear blamed on alignment when the alignment is in spec
The printout is all green, but the tires keep wearing on the inside or feathering. Often the cause is a worn chassis part that the alignment rack can’t detect.

- Bushing deflection: A worn control arm, trailing arm, or subframe bushing can hold correct specs on the alignment rack but still let toe shift under braking, acceleration, or cornering. The rack measures a static car, while the tire wears dynamically. Pry gently on each arm and look for rubber that is cracked, torn, or pushed off center.

- The rear axle gets ignored: Many shops do a front-only alignment on vehicles with adjustable or independent rear suspension. Rear toe or thrust angle that’s off makes the car “dog track,” and the front tires wear while the driver holds a slight steering correction.

- Other factors: Running tires underinflated, carrying heavy loads (which changes camber and toe), skipping rotations, and worn shocks (which cause cupping) all produce wear patterns that look like an alignment problem.
5. Heavy steering or poor return-to-center blamed on the power steering pump, rack, or motor

When steering feels stiff, notchy, or doesn’t straighten itself after a turn, the pump, rack, or electric assist motor usually gets replaced first. Often the real cause is binding in the steering linkage or front suspension, which the power steering system then has to fight. A tie rod end or ball joint costs a fraction of what a new rack does.

- Seized or dry tie rod ends and ball joints. A joint can have no play at all, so it passes a play check, and still be stiff. A stiff joint makes the wheel feel heavy and keeps it from returning to center. Inspectors check for looseness but rarely check for binding. To check, disconnect the joint and move the stud by hand. It should move smoothly, with no notches or tight spots.

- Binding upper strut mount bearings. These cause stiff or notchy steering, often with a creak, pop, or “boing” from the coil spring when turning at low speed. The steering also tends to stay where you leave it after a turn instead of straightening out.

- Low or uneven caster. Caster is the main thing that makes the wheel return to center. A bent control arm or strut tower, a shifted subframe, or a worn radius rod or control arm bushing can reduce it. Uneven caster side to side also causes a pull toward the side with less caster.

Before you replace the strut, the rack, or the alignment, check the chassis. Most of the culprits on this list are worn control arms, ball joints, tie rod ends, sway bar links, bushings, or strut mounts, and Suspensia engineers every one of them to meet or exceed OE specifications.

articles.title: FORVIA HELLA Introduces Modular LED Lighting Kit
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: FORVIA HELLA is introducing the Lighting Kit, a modular front lighting platform that brings new LED technology to the established 90 mm format. The system primarily targets manufacturers of agricultural and construction machinery, buses, trucks, light commercial vehicles and motorhomes.

Building on more than 30 years of experience developing 90 mm modules, FORVIA HELLA designed the Lighting Kit to improve light performance. The new system also reduces installation space requirements and simplifies integration.

“With the new Lighting Kit, we are transferring our technology leadership into the 90 mm format – and in doing so realizing the most compact LED light module FORVIA HELLA has ever developed,” says Dirk Sossenheimer, responsible for the Front & Signal Lighting product line at FORVIA HELLA.
The company plans to begin series production in spring 2027.
FORVIA HELLA Develops More Compact Optical System
The Lighting Kit features a new optical system that uses high-precision freeform optics to maximize light output while minimizing installation space.

The system combines uniform illumination with high optical efficiency and a smaller design. Compared with its predecessor, the Bi-LED Module Generation 3, the Lighting Kit achieves approximately 50% higher optical efficiency while weighing 70% less.
The weight reduction lowers material usage, supporting more efficient resource use. The new system also reduces installation depth by almost half.

Manufacturers must integrate sensors, electronics and thermal management alongside lighting technology within limited vehicle front-end space. The Lighting Kit provides greater design flexibility and simplifies integration, FORVIA HELLA said.
Modular Platform Supports Multiple Lighting Requirements

The modular platform architecture allows manufacturers to develop multiple front lighting variants from a single shared design. These include a Bi-LED version with integrated low and high beams. The company said this approach reduces the need for additional development for individual applications.

FORVIA HELLA also plans to expand the platform with additional lighting and signal functions, along with customer-specific geometries. The architecture gives original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) a compact lighting solution that combines optical performance with reduced development requirements. It also supports faster product development and market introduction.
Lighting Kit Offers Direct Halogen Replacement

The Lighting Kit allows manufacturers to directly replace existing 90 mm halogen solutions without modifying mounting points or interfaces. The system meets UN, SAE, CCC and Indian homologation standards, allowing OEMs to adopt LED technology without additional development work.
FORVIA HELLA said the direct replacement design enables manufacturers to transition from halogen lighting while retaining existing installation configurations.

articles.title: Northwood Announces 2027 Full Tank Automotive Camp
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Northwood University will host Full Tank Automotive Camp from June 27-July 2, 2027. The camp offers high school students an opportunity to explore the automotive industry.

At Northwood’s campus in Midland, Michigan, the summer camp combines hands-on learning, behind-the-scenes industry access and recreational activities. Campers will explore careers in automotive marketing, sales, engineering, design, operations and more. They will also build friendships and experience college life at Northwood University.
Northwood Camp Introduces Students to Automotive Careers

“Full Tank Automotive Camp introduces students to an industry filled with opportunities that extend far beyond the driver’s seat,” said Elgie Bright, chair of Northwood’s Automotive Marketing and Management Program. “Whether their interests lie in engineering, entrepreneurship, marketing or management, campers get to explore how their talents can help shape the future of the automotive industry. Just as importantly, they develop confidence, make meaningful connections and discover what it means to learn by doing.”

“Serving as general chair of the 2026 Northwood University International Auto Show showed me just how many opportunities exist in this incredible industry,” Southwick said. “I’m excited to work with Breanne and Isabella to help bring that same energy to Full Tank Automotive Camp and give high school students experiences that could inspire their future careers. They will also meet Northwood faculty and current students. The experience introduces campers to the business principles and leadership skills that drive success across the industry.
What to expect at Full Tank Automotive Camp:
- Hands-on workshops and creative team challenges to explore automotive careers and business operations
- Behind-the-scenes dealership tours and automotive-related field trips
- Opportunities to learn from industry professionals, Northwood faculty and current automotive students

articles.title: ASE Education Foundation Launches $25M Federal Apprenticeship Grant
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: The award comes through the Department’s Pay-for-Performance Incentive Payments Program, and the idea behind it is simple: reward registered apprenticeship sponsors for hiring apprentices and coaching them through the make-or-break first year on the job. Program sponsors — dealer groups, shop associations, franchise operators and similar organizations — can receive $3,500 for every apprentice they bring on and keep, paid in two parts as the new technician reaches 90 and 270 days on the job.

“This launch of this program lets us do something the industry has needed for a long time: open a clear, paid path into the trade, and give employers a proven way to invest in and grow the people who keep this country moving,” said Mike Coley, President, ASE Education Foundation. “We’re not just filling jobs. We’re building careers that can support a family for a lifetime, strengthening the shops and dealers that serve their communities, and protecting the motoring public who trusts all of us every time they start their car.”

articles.title: NTN Employees Volunteer at Local Food Pantry
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: NTN Bearing Corporation of America recently held a Community Spirit & Engagement Event at the Elk Grove Township Food Pantry in Elk Grove Village, Illinois. On Oct. 27, 12 NTN employees volunteered to help combat food insecurity and support local families ahead of Thanksgiving. Volunteers spent the morning assembling approximately 400 Thanksgiving food bags for distribution to families throughout the community. Team members followed a “trick-or-treat”-style shopping process, collecting and packing items at various food stations. Items included cooking oil, canned vegetables, canned pumpkin, mashed potatoes, macaroni and cheese, gravy, brownie mix and other household necessities.
